<script>
/* Debug box: add ?debug=1 to the kiosk link to see what the page is doing
   (background loading and any errors). Off for everyone else. */
var kioskDebugLines = [];
// A small note in the corner (Settings saved / not saved).
function kioskToast(text, ok) {
  var el = document.getElementById('kioskToast');
  if (!el) {
    el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'kioskToast';
    el.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483646;max-width:420px;' +
      'padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;font:600 15px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;' +
      'box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:opacity .3s';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
  }
  el.textContent = text;
  el.style.background = ok ? '#20733b' : '#990000';
  el.style.opacity = '1';
  clearTimeout(el._hide);
  el._hide = setTimeout(function () { el.style.opacity = '0'; }, ok ? 2500 : 12000);
}

function kioskDebug(text) {
  var line = new Date().toLocaleTimeString() + '  ' + text;
  kioskDebugLines.push(line);
  var box = document.getElementById('kioskDebugBox');
  if (box) box.textContent = kioskDebugLines.slice(-40).join('\n');
}
window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
  kioskDebug('ERROR: ' + (e.message || e.type) + (e.lineno ? ' (line ' + e.lineno + ')' : '') +
    (e.target && (e.target.src || e.target.href) ? ' ' + String(e.target.src || e.target.href).slice(0, 80) : ''));
}, true);
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (e) {
  kioskDebug('ERROR (promise): ' + String(e.reason && e.reason.message || e.reason));
});
try {
  google.script.url.getLocation(function (where) {
    if (!where || !where.parameter || where.parameter.debug !== '1') return;
    var box = document.createElement('pre');
    box.id = 'kioskDebugBox';
    box.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:2147483647;max-width:60vw;' +
      'max-height:45vh;overflow:auto;margin:0;padding:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);color:#9f9;' +
      'font:12px/1.4 monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;border-radius:8px;user-select:text';
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.textContent = kioskDebugLines.join('\n') || 'Debug box on.';
  });
} catch (err) {}
</script>
<script>
/* The kiosk opens plain, then shows the last background this device showed
   (kept in the browser's IndexedDB, which holds big pictures) right away,
   before the Sheet answers. The saved choice from the Sheet still wins
   once it arrives. */
var kioskLastBackground = (function () {
  function open(done) {
    try {
      var req = indexedDB.open('hallPassKiosk', 1);
      req.onupgradeneeded = function () { req.result.createObjectStore('kv'); };
      req.onsuccess = function () { done(req.result); };
      req.onerror = function () { done(null); };
    } catch (err) { done(null); }
  }
  return {
    save: function (name, kind, value) {
      if (!name || !value) return;
      open(function (db) {
        if (!db) return;
        try {
          db.transaction('kv', 'readwrite').objectStore('kv')
            .put({ name: name, kind: kind, value: value, at: Date.now() }, 'lastBackground');
        } catch (err) {}
      });
    },
    load: function (done) {
      open(function (db) {
        if (!db) return done(null);
        try {
          var get = db.transaction('kv').objectStore('kv').get('lastBackground');
          get.onsuccess = function () { done(get.result || null); };
          get.onerror = function () { done(null); };
        } catch (err) { done(null); }
      });
    }
  };
})();

kioskLastBackground.load(function (last) {
  kioskDebug('Device memory: ' + (last ? '"' + last.name + '" (' + last.kind + ', ' + Math.round(String(last.value).length / 1024) + ' KB)' : 'no saved background'));
  // Only if nothing has been painted yet.
  if (!last || document.body.style.backgroundImage || document.body.style.background) return;
  if (last.kind === 'css') {
    document.body.style.background = last.value;
  } else {
    document.body.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + String(last.value).replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '")';
    document.body.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
    document.body.style.backgroundPosition = 'center center';
    document.body.style.backgroundAttachment = 'fixed';
  }
});
</script>

  <script>
/* Background watchers call this to skip "changes" that change nothing.
   Re-adding a class that is already there (classList.add) or setting the
   same style again still reports a change, which kept the layout fitters
   running about 8 times a second forever. Observers using this need
   attributeOldValue: true. */
function kioskRealChange(records) {
  for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
    var r = records[i];
    if (r.type === 'childList') {
      if (r.addedNodes.length || r.removedNodes.length) return true;
    } else if (r.type === 'attributes') {
      if (r.target.getAttribute(r.attributeName) !== r.oldValue) return true;
    } else {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
</script>

    var activePasses = [];
    var activePassServerEmptyConfirmTimer = null;

    function activePassListSignature(list) {
      return (list || [])
        .map(function(pass) {
          return [
            String(pass.row || ''),
            String(pass.name || ''),
            String(pass.displayName || ''),
            String(pass.destination || ''),
            String(pass.timeOutMs || ''),
            String(!!pass.pending)
          ].join('|');
        })
        .sort()
        .join('||');
    }

    function applyActivePassServerSnapshot(
      serverPasses,
      allowConfirmedEmpty
    ) {
      var incoming =
        typeof filterRecentlyReturnedPasses === 'function'
          ? filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(
              serverPasses || []
            )
          : (serverPasses || []);

      var currentSignature =
        activePassListSignature(
          activePasses
        );

      var incomingSignature =
        activePassListSignature(
          incoming
        );

      /* Nothing structurally changed. Leave the existing cards completely
         alone so they don't disappear/rebuild during routine polling. */
      if (
        incomingSignature ===
        currentSignature
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      /* A single empty polling response is not allowed to wipe visible
         out-of-classroom cards. Confirm it once before clearing them. */
      if (
        !allowConfirmedEmpty &&
        activePasses &&
        activePasses.length &&
        !incoming.length
      ) {
        clearTimeout(
          activePassServerEmptyConfirmTimer
        );

        activePassServerEmptyConfirmTimer =
          setTimeout(function() {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(
                function(confirmPasses) {
                  applyActivePassServerSnapshot(
                    confirmPasses,
                    true
                  );
                }
              )
              .getActivePasses();
          }, 650);

        return false;
      }

      clearTimeout(
        activePassServerEmptyConfirmTimer
      );

      activePasses = incoming;
      renderActivePasses();

      return true;
    }

    ];

    function pickImmediateAttendanceEmoji() {
      if (!attendanceEmojiOptions.length) {
        return '🐸';
      }

      /* Every enabled attendance emoji/stamp has the same chance.
         Jaq and Joey are no longer given special bonus odds. */
      return attendanceEmojiOptions[
        Math.floor(
          Math.random() *
          attendanceEmojiOptions.length
        )
      ];
    }

    function attendanceDailyEmojiKey(student) {
      var d = new Date();
      var day = [
        d.getFullYear(),
        String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
        String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      ].join('-');

      return attendanceStudentKey(student) + '|' + day;
    }

    /* Today's emoji for every student, made by the Sheet
       (getDailyEmojiPlan): nobody shares an emoji all day, and nobody
       gets their own emoji from yesterday. */
    var attendanceEmojiPlan = { date: '', emojis: {} };
    var attendanceEmojiPlanLoading = false;

    function attendanceTodayKey() {
      var d = new Date();
      return [
        d.getFullYear(),
        String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
        String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      ].join('-');
    }

    function applyEmojiPlan(plan) {
      if (!plan || !plan.emojis) return;
      attendanceEmojiPlan = {
        date: String(plan.date || ''),
        emojis: plan.emojis
      };
    }

    function attendanceEmojiPlanIsToday() {
      return attendanceEmojiPlan.date === attendanceTodayKey();
    }

    // Kiosks left on overnight fetch the new day's emojis.
    function refreshEmojiPlanIfNewDay() {
      if (attendanceEmojiPlanIsToday() || attendanceEmojiPlanLoading) return;

      attendanceEmojiPlanLoading = true;
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(plan) {
          attendanceEmojiPlanLoading = false;
          applyEmojiPlan(plan);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          attendanceEmojiPlanLoading = false;
        })
        .getDailyEmojiPlan();
    }

    setInterval(refreshEmojiPlanIfNewDay, 60000);

    // Only used if today's plan has not arrived yet. Avoids emojis the
    // plan has already given out; the Sheet still saves the planned one.
    function pickFallbackAttendanceEmoji() {
      var taken = {};
      if (attendanceEmojiPlanIsToday()) {
        Object.keys(attendanceEmojiPlan.emojis).forEach(function(k) {
          taken[attendanceEmojiPlan.emojis[k]] = true;
        });
      }
      Object.keys(attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey).forEach(function(k) {
        taken[attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[k]] = true;
      });

      var free = attendanceEmojiOptions.filter(function(e) {
        return !taken[e];
      });

      return free.length
        ? free[Math.floor(Math.random() * free.length)]
        : pickImmediateAttendanceEmoji();
    }

    function getAttendanceAssignedEmoji(student) {
      var key = attendanceStudentKey(student);
      var dailyKey = attendanceDailyEmojiKey(student);
      var savedState = attendanceStateByKey[key];

      if (savedState && savedState.emoji) {
        attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey] = savedState.emoji;
        return savedState.emoji;
      }

      if (
        attendanceEmojiPlanIsToday() &&
        attendanceEmojiPlan.emojis[key]
      ) {
        attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey] =
          attendanceEmojiPlan.emojis[key];
        return attendanceEmojiPlan.emojis[key];
      }

      refreshEmojiPlanIfNewDay();

      if (!attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey]) {
        attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey] =
          pickFallbackAttendanceEmoji();
      }

      return attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey];
    }

    function attendanceAvatarBackground(value, student) {
      if (value === 'CUSTOM_WHITE_DOG') {
        return '#365a7a';
      }

      if (value === 'CUSTOM_YORKIE') {
        return '#dbeeff';
      }

      var palette = [
        '#dff4ff',
        '#ffe3ed',
        '#e8e1ff',
        '#dcf4e3',
        '#fff0bd',
        '#ffe4ce',
        '#dff2ee',
        '#f2e2ff'
      ];

      var source =
        String(value || '') + '|' +
        attendanceStudentKey(student);
      var hash = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < source.length; i += 1) {
        hash = ((hash * 31) + source.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
      }

      return palette[hash % palette.length];
    }

              )
        );

      avatar.appendChild(box);
    }

    function primeBirthdaySound() {
      try {
        var AudioContextCtor =
          window.AudioContext ||
          window.webkitAudioContext;

        if (!AudioContextCtor) {
          return;
        }

        if (
          !window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio
        ) {
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio =
            new AudioContextCtor();
        }

        if (
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio.state ===
            'suspended' &&
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio.resume
        ) {
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio.resume();
        }
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function playBirthdaySound() {
      try {
        var ctx =
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio;

        if (
          kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled === false ||
          !ctx ||
          !birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer
        ) {
          return;
        }

        var source =
          ctx.createBufferSource();

        var gain =
          ctx.createGain();

        source.buffer =
          birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer;

        gain.gain.value =
          1;

        source.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);

        source.start(0);
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function preloadBirthdayVideoAsset() {
      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled === false ||
        birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl ||
        birthdayVideoRequested
      ) {
        return;
      }

      birthdayVideoRequested = true;

      birthdayVideoLoadError = '';

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(asset) {
          asset = asset || {};

          birthdayVideoRequested = false;

          birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl =
            String(
              asset.dataUrl || ''
            );

          birthdayVideoLoadError =
            birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl
              ? ''
              : 'Birthday video returned empty.';
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          birthdayVideoRequested = false;
          birthdayVideoLoadError =
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : 'Birthday video could not be loaded.';
        })
        .getBirthdayVideoAsset();
    }

    function decodeBirthdayAudioDataUrl(
      audioDataUrl
    ) {
      if (!audioDataUrl) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        var commaIndex =
          audioDataUrl.indexOf(',');

        var encoded =
          commaIndex >= 0
            ? audioDataUrl.slice(
                commaIndex + 1
              )
            : '';

        if (!encoded) {
          return;
        }

        var binary =
          atob(encoded);

        var bytes =
          new Uint8Array(
            binary.length
          );

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < binary.length;
          i += 1
        ) {
          bytes[i] =
            binary.charCodeAt(i);
        }

        var AudioContextCtor =
          window.AudioContext ||
          window.webkitAudioContext;

        if (!AudioContextCtor) {
          return;
        }

        if (
          !window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio
        ) {
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio =
            new AudioContextCtor();
        }

        var ctx =
          window.__attendanceBirthdayAudio;

        var bufferCopy =
          bytes.buffer.slice(0);

        var decoded =
          ctx.decodeAudioData(
            bufferCopy,
            function(buffer) {
              birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer =
                buffer;
            },
            function() {}
          );

        if (
          decoded &&
          typeof decoded.then ===
            'function'
        ) {
          decoded
            .then(function(buffer) {
              birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer =
                buffer;
            })
            .catch(function() {});
        }
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function preloadBirthdaySoundAsset() {
      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled === false ||
        birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer ||
        birthdaySoundRequested
      ) {
        return;
      }

      birthdaySoundRequested = true;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(asset) {
          asset = asset || {};

          birthdaySoundRequested = false;

          decodeBirthdayAudioDataUrl(
            String(
              asset.dataUrl || ''
            )
          );
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          birthdaySoundRequested = false;
        })
        .getBirthdaySoundAsset();
    }

    function preloadBirthdayConfettiGif() {
      preloadBirthdayVideoAsset();
      preloadBirthdaySoundAsset();
    }



    function showBirthdayCheckInCelebration(
      student
    ) {
      var old =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceBirthdayCelebration'
        );

      if (old) {
        old.remove();
      }

      var layer =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      layer.id =
        'attendanceBirthdayCelebration';

      layer.className =
        'attendance-birthday-celebration attendance-birthday-gif-layer';

      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false &&
        birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl
      ) {
        var video =
          document.createElement(
            'video'
          );

        video.className =
          'attendance-birthday-overlay-video';

        video.src =
          birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl;

        video.autoplay = true;
        video.muted = true;
        video.playbackRate = 1;
        video.playsInline = true;
        video.loop = false;
        video.preload = 'auto';

        layer.appendChild(
          video
        );

        try {
          video.currentTime = 0;

          var playPromise =
            video.play();

          if (
            playPromise &&
            typeof playPromise.catch ===
              'function'
          ) {
            playPromise.catch(function() {});
          }
        } catch (error) {}
      } else if (
        kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false
      ) {
        /* If video is enabled but the asset has not finished loading,
           do not delay the student's check-in. */
        var symbols = [
          '🎈','🎉','✨','🎊','🎈',
          '✨','🎉','🎈','🎊','✨',
          '🎈','🎉','✨','🎊','🎈'
        ];

        symbols.forEach(function(symbol, index) {
          var item =
            document.createElement(
              'div'
            );

          item.className =
            index % 3 === 0
              ? 'attendance-birthday-balloon'
              : 'attendance-birthday-confetti';

          item.textContent =
            symbol;

          item.style.left =
            (
              4 +
              (
                index * 6.1
              ) % 92
            ) + '%';

          item.style.animationDelay =
            (
              (index % 5) * 0.08
            ).toFixed(2) + 's';

          layer.appendChild(item);
        });

        preloadBirthdayConfettiGif();
      }

      var title =
        document.createElement(
          'div'
        );

      title.className =
        'attendance-birthday-celebration-title';

      title.textContent =
        birthdayCheckInMessage(
          student
        );

      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false
      ) {
        layer.appendChild(title);
      }

      document.body.appendChild(
        layer
      );

      playBirthdaySound();

      setTimeout(function() {
        layer.classList.add(
          'attendance-birthday-celebration-out'
        );
      }, 5000);

      setTimeout(function() {
if (layer.parentNode) {
          layer.remove();
        }
      }, 5400);
    }

    function runBirthdayCelebrationPreview() {
      var button =
        document.getElementById(
          'previewBirthdayCelebrationButton'
        );

      var status =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdayPreviewStatus'
        );

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      if (status) {
        status.textContent =
          'Loading celebration...';
        status.style.color =
          '#647386';
      }

      /* User clicked this button, so use the gesture to unlock audio. */
      primeBirthdaySound();

      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false
      ) {
        preloadBirthdayVideoAsset();
      }

      if (
        kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false
      ) {
        preloadBirthdaySoundAsset();
      }

      var startedAt =
        Date.now();

      function waitForBirthdayPreviewAssets() {
        var videoReady =
          kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled === false ||
          !!birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl;

        var soundReady =
          kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled === false ||
          !!birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer;

        if (
          videoReady &&
          soundReady
        ) {
          if (status) {
            status.textContent =
              'Playing preview...';
            status.style.color =
              '#7b145f';
          }

          showBirthdayCheckInCelebration({
            birthdayObservedToday: true,
            birthdayMessage:
              'Happy Birthday!'
          });

          setTimeout(function() {
            if (button) {
              button.disabled = false;
            }

            if (status) {
              status.textContent =
                'Preview finished.';
              status.style.color =
                '#24743a';
            }
          }, 5600);

          return;
        }

        if (
          Date.now() - startedAt >
          45000
        ) {
          if (button) {
            button.disabled = false;
          }

          if (status) {
            status.textContent =
              birthdayVideoLoadError ||
              'The preview took too long to load. Try again.';
            status.style.color =
              '#990000';
          }

          return;
        }

        setTimeout(
          waitForBirthdayPreviewAssets,
          120
        );
      }

      waitForBirthdayPreviewAssets();
    }

    function setAttendanceAvatar(card, student, value) {
      if (!card) return;

      var avatar = card.querySelector('.attendance-avatar');
      if (!avatar) return;

      var assigned =
        value || getAttendanceAssignedEmoji(student);
      var dailyKey = attendanceDailyEmojiKey(student);

      attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[dailyKey] = assigned;

      if (
        isBirthdayCheckInStudent(
          student
        )
      ) {
        setAttendanceBirthdayMessage(
          avatar,
          student
        );

        avatar.style.background =
          'linear-gradient(180deg,#fff6c9 0%,#ffe0f5 100%)';
      } else {
        setAttendanceCover(
          avatar,
          assigned
        );

        avatar.style.background =
          attendanceAvatarBackground(
            assigned,
            student
          );
      }

      avatar.classList.remove('attendance-avatar-hidden');
      avatar.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(card) {
      if (!card) return;

      var avatar = card.querySelector('.attendance-avatar');
      if (!avatar) return;

      avatar.innerHTML = '';
      avatar.style.color = '';
      avatar.classList.add('attendance-avatar-hidden');
      avatar.classList.remove('attendance-slot-spinning');
      avatar.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function animateAttendanceEmojiReveal(card, student, finalEmoji) {
      if (!card) return;

      var avatar = card.querySelector('.attendance-avatar');
      if (!avatar) return;

      var key = attendanceStudentKey(student);
      if (attendanceEmojiSpinTimers[key]) {
        clearInterval(attendanceEmojiSpinTimers[key].interval);
        clearTimeout(attendanceEmojiSpinTimers[key].timeout);
      }

      avatar.classList.remove('attendance-avatar-hidden');
      avatar.classList.add('attendance-slot-spinning');

      var birthdayMode =
        isBirthdayCheckInStudent(
          student
        );

      var ticks = 0;
      var maxTicks =
        birthdayMode ? 11 : 5;

      var interval =
        setInterval(function() {
          ticks += 1;

          var preview =
            pickImmediateAttendanceEmoji();

          setAttendanceCover(
            avatar,
            preview
          );

          avatar.style.background =
            attendanceAvatarBackground(
              preview,
              student
            );

          if (ticks >= maxTicks) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }
        }, birthdayMode ? 75 : 55);

      var timeout =
        setTimeout(function() {
          clearInterval(interval);

          setAttendanceAvatar(
            card,
            student,
            finalEmoji
          );

          avatar.classList.remove(
            'attendance-slot-spinning'
          );

          var state =
            attendanceStateByKey[key];

          if (state) {
            state.revealEmoji = true;
            state.emoji = finalEmoji;
          }

          if (birthdayMode) {
            showBirthdayCheckInCelebration(
              student
            );
          }

          delete attendanceEmojiSpinTimers[key];
        }, birthdayMode ? 900 : 330);

      attendanceEmojiSpinTimers[key] = {
        interval: interval,
        timeout: timeout
      };
    }

    function setAttendanceCover(cover, value) {
      if (!cover) return;

      cover.innerHTML = '';

      var stampUrl =
        attendanceCustomStamps[value];

      if (stampUrl) {
        var img = document.createElement('img');
        img.className =
          'attendance-custom-stamp';
        img.src = stampUrl;
        img.alt = '';
        cover.appendChild(img);
      } else {
        cover.textContent = value || '🐸';
      }
    }

    function preloadAttendanceCustomStamps() {
      Object.keys(attendanceCustomStamps)
        .forEach(function(key) {
          var img = new Image();
          img.src =
            attendanceCustomStamps[key];
        });
    }

    // Wire the three critical fixed controls immediately. Function
    // declarations are hoisted, so these remain available even if a
    // later optional feature has an initialization error.
    (function wireCriticalControlsImmediately() {
      var gear = document.getElementById('gearButton');
      var back = document.getElementById('backButton');
      var restart = document.getElementById('resetPersonButton');

      if (gear) {
        gear.onclick = function(event) {
          return openSettings(event);
        };
      }

      if (back) {
        back.onclick = function(event) {
          if (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
          }
          goBackOneStep();
          return false;
        };
      }

      if (restart) {
        restart.onclick = function(event) {
          if (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
          }
          resetStudentFlow(true);
          return false;
        };
      }
    })();

    function settingsEqual(a, b) {
      return (
        Number(a.greenThroughMinutes) === Number(b.greenThroughMinutes) &&
        Number(a.yellowThroughMinutes) === Number(b.yellowThroughMinutes) &&
        String(a.studentMenuStyle) === String(b.studentMenuStyle) &&
        String(a.topTitle || "") === String(b.topTitle || "") &&
        String(a.mainTitle || "") === String(b.mainTitle || "") &&
        String(a.backgroundName || "") === String(b.backgroundName || "") &&
        String(a.customBackgroundUrl || "") === String(b.customBackgroundUrl || "") &&
        String(a.fontName || "") === String(b.fontName || "") &&
        String(a.titleOrder || "Small First") === String(b.titleOrder || "Small First") &&
        String(a.classSelectionMode || "Manual") === String(b.classSelectionMode || "Manual") &&
        (a.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false) === (b.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false) &&
        (a.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false) === (b.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false) &&
        (a.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false) === (b.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false) &&
        String(a.birthdayCustomVideoFileId || "") === String(b.birthdayCustomVideoFileId || "") &&
        String(a.birthdayCustomSoundFileId || "") === String(b.birthdayCustomSoundFileId || "")
      );
    }

    function normalizeLiveBellScheduleUrl(value) {
      var url = String(value || '').trim();

      if (!url) {
        return "https://bell.plus/907263";
      }

      if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
        url = 'https://' + url;
      }

      try {
        var parsed = new URL(url);

        if (
          parsed.protocol !== 'http:' &&
          parsed.protocol !== 'https:'
        ) {
          return "https://bell.plus/907263";
        }

        return parsed.href;
      } catch (error) {
        return "https://bell.plus/907263";
      }
    }

    function applyDisplayPanelSettings() {
      var attendancePanel =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSidePanel'
        );

      if (attendancePanel) {
        attendancePanel.classList.toggle(
          'display-panel-disabled',
          !attendanceSettings.enabled
        );
      }

      var outPanel =
        document.querySelector(
          '.active-pass-stage.out-room-rail'
        );

      if (outPanel) {
        outPanel.classList.toggle(
          'display-panel-disabled',
          kioskSettings.outOfClassroomEnabled === false
        );
      }

      var scheduleCard =
        document.getElementById(
          'schedulePreviewCard'
        );

      if (scheduleCard) {
        scheduleCard.classList.toggle(
          'display-panel-disabled',
          kioskSettings.displayedBellScheduleEnabled === false
        );
      }

      var dayPicker =
        document.getElementById(
          'dayTypeControl'
        );

      if (dayPicker) {
        dayPicker.classList.remove(
          'display-panel-disabled'
        );
        dayPicker.style.display = '';
        dayPicker.style.visibility =
          'visible';
      }

      var liveSchedule =
        document.getElementById(
          'bellPlusEmbed'
        );

      if (liveSchedule) {
        liveSchedule.classList.toggle(
          'display-panel-disabled',
          kioskSettings.liveBellScheduleEnabled === false
        );

        var frame =
          liveSchedule.querySelector(
            'iframe'
          );

        if (
          frame &&
          kioskSettings.liveBellScheduleEnabled !== false
        ) {
          var wantedUrl =
            normalizeLiveBellScheduleUrl(
              kioskSettings.liveBellScheduleUrl
            );

          if (
            frame.getAttribute('src') !==
            wantedUrl
          ) {
            frame.setAttribute(
              'src',
              wantedUrl
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }


    function applyKioskSettings(settings) {
      if (!settings) return;

      kioskSettings = {
        greenThroughMinutes: Number(settings.greenThroughMinutes || 5),
        yellowThroughMinutes: Number(settings.yellowThroughMinutes || 8),
        studentMenuStyle: settings.studentMenuStyle || "Student Cards",
        topTitle: String(settings.topTitle || ""),
        mainTitle: String(settings.mainTitle || ""),
        backgroundName: String(settings.backgroundName || "School- Supplies"),
        customBackgroundUrl: String(settings.customBackgroundUrl || ""),
        fontName: String(settings.fontName || "Arial"),
        titleOrder:
          String(settings.titleOrder || "Small First") === "Big First"
            ? "Big First"
            : "Small First",
        classSelectionMode:
          String(settings.classSelectionMode || "Manual") === "Bell Schedule"
            ? "Bell Schedule"
            : "Manual",
        outOfClassroomEnabled:
          settings.outOfClassroomEnabled !== false,
        displayedBellScheduleEnabled:
          settings.displayedBellScheduleEnabled !== false,
        liveBellScheduleEnabled:
          settings.liveBellScheduleEnabled !== false,
        liveBellScheduleUrl:
          normalizeLiveBellScheduleUrl(
            settings.liveBellScheduleUrl ||
            "https://bell.plus/907263"
          ),
        birthdayVideoEnabled:
          settings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false,
        birthdaySoundEnabled:
          settings.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false,
        birthdayMessageEnabled:
          settings.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false,
        birthdayCustomVideoFileId:
          String(settings.birthdayCustomVideoFileId || ""),
        birthdayCustomSoundFileId:
          String(settings.birthdayCustomSoundFileId || ""),
        birthdayCustomVideoFileName:
          String(settings.birthdayCustomVideoFileName || ""),
        birthdayCustomSoundFileName:
          String(settings.birthdayCustomSoundFileName || "")
      };

      renderTitles();
      applyKioskFont();
      applyBackground();
      renderStudentMenuStyle();
      updateLiveTimers();
      applyDisplayPanelSettings();

      var dayControl = document.getElementById('dayTypeControl');

      if (dayControl) {
        // Bell schedule display is independent of how the teacher chooses
        // the active class. Manual class selection can still show today's
        // bell schedule on the right.
        dayControl.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      refreshBellScheduleStatus();

      if (settingsPanelOpen && !settingsSaveInProgress) {
        populateSettingsForm();
      }
    }

    function renderTitles() {
      var topEl = document.getElementById('topTitle');
      var mainEl = document.getElementById('mainTitle');
      var area = document.getElementById('titleArea');

      topEl.textContent = kioskSettings.topTitle;
      mainEl.textContent = kioskSettings.mainTitle;

      topEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !kioskSettings.topTitle);
      mainEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !kioskSettings.mainTitle);

      if (kioskSettings.titleOrder === "Big First") {
        area.appendChild(mainEl);
        area.appendChild(topEl);
      } else {
        area.appendChild(topEl);
        area.appendChild(mainEl);
      }

      area.classList.toggle(
        'hidden',
        !kioskSettings.topTitle && !kioskSettings.mainTitle
      );

      document.title =
        kioskSettings.mainTitle ||
        kioskSettings.topTitle ||
        "Hall Pass Kiosk";
    }

    function initialsFor(name) {
      return String(name || "")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map(function(part) {
          return part.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
        })
        .join("");
    }

    function studentInitial(student) {
      var source =
        (student && student.firstName) ||
        (student && student.displayName) ||
        (student && student.name) ||
        '?';

      source = String(source).trim();
      return source ? source.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : '?';
    }

    function photoHtml(student) {
      var initial = escapeHtml(studentInitial(student));

      if (student.imageUrl) {
        return (
          '<div class="student-photo-wrap">' +
            '<img class="student-photo" src="' +
            escapeAttribute(student.imageUrl) +
            '" alt="" ' +
            'onerror="this.style.display=\'none\';' +
            'this.nextElementSibling.style.display=\'flex\';">' +
            '<div class="student-initials" style="display:none;">' +
              initial +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="attendance-photo-cover hidden"></div>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      return (
        '<div class="student-photo-wrap">' +
          '<div class="student-initials">' + initial + '</div>' +
          '<div class="attendance-photo-cover hidden"></div>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function escapeAttribute(value) {
      return escapeHtml(value);
    }

    function setStudentStage(title, note) {
      document.getElementById('studentStageTitle').textContent = title || '';
      var noteEl = document.getElementById('studentStageNote');
      noteEl.textContent = note || '';
      noteEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !note);
    }

    function updateFlowNavigation() {
      var backButton = document.getElementById('backButton');

      if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle !== "Student Cards") {
        backButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }

      backButton.disabled = currentStep === "class";
    }

    function showStudentStage() {
      document.body.classList.remove(
        'destination-screen-active'
      );

      document
        .getElementById('studentStage')
        .classList.remove('hidden');

      document
        .getElementById('destinationStage')
        .classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showDestinationOnly() {
      document.body.classList.add(
        'destination-screen-active'
      );

      document
        .getElementById('studentStage')
        .classList.add('hidden');

      document
        .getElementById('destinationStage')
        .classList.remove('hidden');

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          fitDestinationCardTypography();

          if (
            typeof window.fitDestinationCardsFilled ===
              'function'
          ) {
            window.fitDestinationCardsFilled();
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function goBackOneStep() {
      if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle !== "Student Cards") {
        return;
      }

      if (currentStep === "destination") {
        selectedStudent = null;
        selectedDestination = "";
        document.getElementById('checkoutButton').disabled = true;

        if (selectedClass) {
          currentStep = "student";
          showStudentStage();
          renderStudentCards(selectedClass);
        } else {
          resetStudentFlow(true);
        }
      } else if (currentStep === "student") {
        if (kioskSettings.classSelectionMode === "Bell Schedule") {
          scheduleManualOverride = true;
        }
        selectedStudent = null;
        selectedDestination = "";
        selectedClass = null;
        currentStep = "class";
        showStudentStage();
        renderClassCards();
      }

      updateFlowNavigation();
    }



    function renderStudentMenuStyle() {
      document.getElementById('studentCardsArea').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('groupedDropdownArea').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('tieredMenuArea').classList.add('hidden');

      resetStudentFlow(false);
      showStudentStage();

      if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle === "Grouped Dropdown") {
        document.getElementById('groupedDropdownArea').classList.remove('hidden');
        setStudentStage('Choose Your Name', '');
      } else if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle === "Tiered Menu") {
        document.getElementById('tieredMenuArea').classList.remove('hidden');
        setStudentStage('Choose Your Name', '');
        renderTieredClasses();
      } else {
        document.getElementById('studentCardsArea').classList.remove('hidden');
        renderClassCards();
      }
    }


    function normalizeClassImagePeriod(value) {
      var text =
        String(value || '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .replace(/\bperiod\b/g, '')
          .replace(/\s+/g, '')
          .trim();

      text = text.replace(
        /^(\d+)(st|nd|rd|th)$/i,
        '$1'
      );

      return text;
    }

    function normalizeClassImageTitle(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function classImageLookupKey(
      period,
      classTitle
    ) {
      return (
        normalizeClassImagePeriod(period) +
        '||' +
        normalizeClassImageTitle(classTitle)
      );
    }

    function classImagePeriodKey(period) {
      return (
        '__PERIOD__||' +
        normalizeClassImagePeriod(
          period
        )
      );
    }



    function classImageHtml(group) {
      var zoom = Math.max(
        1,
        Math.min(
          3,
          Number(group.classImageZoom) || 1
        )
      );

      var focusX = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          100,
          Number(group.classImageFocusX)
        )
      );

      var focusY = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          100,
          Number(group.classImageFocusY)
        )
      );

      if (!isFinite(focusX)) {
        focusX = 50;
      }

      if (!isFinite(focusY)) {
        focusY = 50;
      }

      if (group.classImageUrl) {
        var mediaStyle =
          'object-position:' +
          focusX +
          '% ' +
          focusY +
          '%;' +
          'transform:scale(' +
          zoom +
          ');' +
          'transform-origin:' +
          focusX +
          '% ' +
          focusY +
          '%;';

        return (
          '<div class="class-image class-image-frame">' +
            '<img class="class-image-media" src="' +
            escapeAttribute(group.classImageUrl) +
            '" alt="" style="' +
            escapeAttribute(mediaStyle) +
            '" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\';this.parentElement.classList.add(\'class-image-load-failed\');">' +
            '<div class="class-image-placeholder class-image-fallback">' +
              escapeHtml(group.period) +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      return (
        '<div class="class-image-placeholder">' +
          escapeHtml(group.period) +
        '</div>'
      );
    }


    function normalizePeriodForSchedule(value) {
      return String(value || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/\s+/g, "")
        .replace(/(st|nd|rd|th)$/i, "")
        .trim();
    }

    function findRosterGroupForSchedulePeriod(period) {
      var wanted = normalizePeriodForSchedule(period);

      return studentRoster.find(function(group) {
        return normalizePeriodForSchedule(group.period) === wanted;
      }) || null;
    }

    // During passing periods the Hall Pass panel moves into the left column.
    // Start it just below the BACK / RESET / SETTINGS buttons (the same place
    // the Attendance panel normally starts) so the buttons never cover it.
    function applyPassingHallPassOffset() {
      var container =
        document.querySelector('body > .container');

      if (!container) return;

      container.style.removeProperty('margin-top');

      if (
        !document.body.classList.contains(
          'passing-attendance-priority'
        ) ||
        !document.body.classList.contains(
          'kiosk-column-layout'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var controls =
        document.querySelector('.top-left-control-row');

      if (!controls) return;

      var controlsBottom =
        controls.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;

      var containerTop =
        container.getBoundingClientRect().top;

      var needed =
        Math.ceil(controlsBottom + 6 - containerTop);

      if (needed > 0) {
        container.style.setProperty(
          'margin-top',
          needed + 'px',
          'important'
        );
      }
    }

    function fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards() {
      applyPassingHallPassOffset();

      if (
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
      ) {
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--passing-attendance-row-height'
        );

        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--passing-attendance-photo-size'
        );

        fitSolidAttendanceGridLayout();

        return;
      }

      if (
        !document.body.classList.contains(
          'passing-attendance-priority'
        )
      ) {
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--passing-attendance-row-height'
        );

        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--passing-attendance-photo-size'
        );

        return;
      }

      var panel =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSidePanel'
        );

      var grid =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSideGrid'
        );

      if (
        !panel ||
        !grid
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var cards =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          grid.querySelectorAll(
            '.attendance-side-card'
          )
        ).filter(function(card) {
          return (
            window
              .getComputedStyle(card)
              .display !==
            'none'
          );
        });

      if (!cards.length) {
        return;
      }

      var columns =
        5;

      var rows =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.ceil(
            cards.length /
            columns
          )
        );

      var gridStyle =
        window.getComputedStyle(
          grid
        );

      var rowGap =
        parseFloat(
          gridStyle.rowGap ||
          gridStyle.gap ||
          '4'
        ) || 4;

      var panelStyle =
        window.getComputedStyle(
          panel
        );

      var panelBottomPadding =
        parseFloat(
          panelStyle.paddingBottom ||
          '0'
        ) || 0;

      /* offsetTop gives us the exact amount of the panel occupied by
         Attendance / class / instructions above the student grid. */
      var available =
        panel.clientHeight -
        grid.offsetTop -
        panelBottomPadding -
        rowGap *
          Math.max(
            0,
            rows - 1
          ) -
        2;

      var rowHeight =
        Math.floor(
          available /
          rows
        );

      rowHeight =
        Math.max(
          112,
          Math.min(
            235,
            rowHeight
          )
        );

      var photoSize =
        Math.floor(
          rowHeight *
          .41
        );

      photoSize =
        Math.max(
          66,
          Math.min(
            106,
            photoSize
          )
        );

      /* The photo must also fit the card's WIDTH. On narrower screens
         (iPad, 1280-1600px monitors) five columns are only ~70-90px wide,
         so a height-based photo would spill out of the card. */
      var columnWidth =
        (
          grid.clientWidth -
          rowGap * (columns - 1)
        ) / columns;

      var widthLimit =
        Math.floor(columnWidth - 16);

      if (
        widthLimit > 0 &&
        photoSize > widthLimit
      ) {
        photoSize =
          Math.max(40, widthLimit);

        /* Keep the card in the same proportion as the photo so the card
           does not become a tall, mostly empty strip. */
        rowHeight =
          Math.max(
            112,
            Math.min(
              rowHeight,
              Math.ceil(photoSize / .41)
            )
          );
      }

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--passing-attendance-row-height',
        rowHeight + 'px'
      );

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--passing-attendance-photo-size',
        photoSize + 'px'
      );

      if (
        typeof settleAttendanceCardLayout ===
          'function'
      ) {
        settleAttendanceCardLayout();
      }
    }

    function updatePassingPeriodPriority(
      status
    ) {
      var attendanceEnabled =
        !!(
          attendanceSettings &&
          attendanceSettings.enabled
        );

      var passing =
        !!(
          attendanceEnabled &&
          status &&
          status.schoolDay &&
          status.phase ===
            'passing' &&
          status.activeRosterPeriod
        );

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'passing-attendance-priority',
        passing
      );

      if (!passing) {
        fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards();

        if (
          typeof window.applyStableLayout ===
            'function'
        ) {
          window.applyStableLayout();
        }

        return;
      }

      /* During passing period, show the scheduled class in Attendance
         even if the Hall Pass screen itself is being used manually.
         This does NOT change the teacher's selected Hall Pass class. */
      var attendanceGroup =
        findRosterGroupForSchedulePeriod(
          status.activeRosterPeriod
        );

      if (
        attendanceGroup &&
        kioskSettings.classSelectionMode !==
          'Bell Schedule'
      ) {
        renderAttendanceSidePanel(
          attendanceGroup
        );
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        if (
          typeof window.applyStableLayout ===
            'function'
        ) {
          window.applyStableLayout();
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(
          fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards
        );
      });
    }


    function updateScheduleStatusBar(status) {
      var bar = document.getElementById('scheduleStatusBar');
      var text = document.getElementById('scheduleStatusText');

      if (!bar || !text) return;

      if (kioskSettings.classSelectionMode !== 'Bell Schedule') {
        bar.classList.add('hidden');
        return;
      }

      bar.classList.remove('hidden');

      if (!status) {
        text.textContent = 'Checking bell schedule…';
        return;
      }

      if (!status.schoolDay) {
        text.textContent = status.label || 'No school';
        return;
      }

      if (!status.scheduleName) {
        text.textContent =
          'No automatic schedule for today — choose a class manually.';
        return;
      }

      var parts = [status.scheduleName];

      if (
        dayTypeOverride &&
        dayTypeOverride !== "__AUTO__" &&
        dayTypeOverride !== "__MANUAL__"
      ) {
        parts[0] = status.scheduleName + " (manual day choice)";
      }

      if (status.period) {
        parts.push('Period ' + status.period);
      }

      if (status.phase === 'passing' && status.lateBell) {
        parts.push('Late bell ' + status.lateBell);
      } else if (status.classEnds) {
        parts.push('Ends ' + status.classEnds);
      }

      text.textContent = parts.join(' • ');
    }

    function applyBellScheduleStatus(status) {
      bellScheduleStatus = status || null;
      updateScheduleStatusBar(status);
      updatePassingPeriodPriority(status);

      if (
        status &&
        status.scheduleName &&
        dayTypeOverride !== '__MANUAL__'
      ) {
        loadSchedulePreview(status.scheduleName);
      } else if (
        dayTypeOverride === '__MANUAL__' ||
        !status ||
        !status.scheduleName
      ) {
        renderSchedulePreview(null);
      }

      // Everything below this point is the automatic-roster behavior.
      // Manual class selection keeps the schedule visible but does not
      // auto-switch classes.
      if (kioskSettings.classSelectionMode !== 'Bell Schedule') {
        return;
      }

      if (!status || !status.schoolDay || !status.activeRosterPeriod) {
        if (!scheduleManualOverride && currentStep !== 'destination') {
          renderClassCards();
        }
        return;
      }

      var autoKey =
        String(status.scheduleName || '') + '|' +
        String(status.activeRosterPeriod || '');

      if (lastAutomaticRosterKey && autoKey !== lastAutomaticRosterKey) {
        scheduleManualOverride = false;
      }

      lastAutomaticRosterKey = autoKey;

      if (scheduleManualOverride || currentStep === 'destination') {
        return;
      }

      var group = findRosterGroupForSchedulePeriod(
        status.activeRosterPeriod
      );

      if (!group) {
        renderClassCards();
        setStudentStage(
          'Choose Your Class',
          'No class on the Students sheet matches ' +
            status.activeRosterPeriod +
            '.'
        );
        return;
      }

      selectedClass = group;
      renderStudentCards(group);

      // Keep the current class as the default kiosk screen whenever automatic
      // scheduling is active.
      currentStep = 'student';
      updateFlowNavigation();
    }


    function populateDayTypeDropdown() {
      var select = document.getElementById('dayTypeSelect');
      if (!select) return;

      var current = dayTypeOverride || "__AUTO__";

      select.innerHTML =
        '<option value="__AUTO__">Automatic</option>' +
        '<option value="__MANUAL__">Manual / No Auto</option>';

      bellScheduleNames.forEach(function(name) {
        var option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = name;
        option.textContent = name;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });

      select.value = current;
    }


    function scheduleDisplayTime(start, end) {
      var cleanStart = String(start || '').trim();
      var cleanEnd = String(end || '').trim();

      if (!cleanStart && !cleanEnd) return '';
      if (!cleanEnd) return cleanStart;
      if (!cleanStart) return cleanEnd;

      return cleanStart + '–' + cleanEnd;
    }

    function renderSchedulePreview(details) {
      var card = document.getElementById('schedulePreviewCard');
      var title = document.getElementById('schedulePreviewTitle');
      var body = document.getElementById('schedulePreviewBody');

      if (!card || !title || !body) return;

      if (
        !details ||
        !details.scheduleName ||
        !details.rows ||
        !details.rows.length
      ) {
        card.classList.add('hidden');
        title.textContent = '';
        body.innerHTML = '';
        positionBellPlusBelowSchedule();
        return;
      }

      title.textContent = details.scheduleName;

      var html =
        '<table class="schedule-preview-table">' +
          '<thead>' +
            '<tr>' +
              '<th>Period</th>' +
              '<th>' + escapeHtml(details.scheduleName) + '</th>' +
            '</tr>' +
          '</thead>' +
          '<tbody>';

      if (details.warningBell) {
        html +=
          '<tr class="warning-row">' +
            '<td>Warning Bell</td>' +
            '<td>' + escapeHtml(details.warningBell) + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }

      details.rows.forEach(function(row) {
        var period = String(row.period || '');
        var rowClass = '';

        if (/^4[AB]?$/i.test(period)) {
          rowClass = 'lunch-4';
        } else if (/^5[AB]?$/i.test(period)) {
          rowClass = 'lunch-5';
        } else if (
          String(row.blockType || '').toLowerCase() !== 'class'
        ) {
          rowClass = 'special-row';
        }

        html +=
          '<tr class="' + rowClass + '">' +
            '<td>' + escapeHtml(period) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' +
              escapeHtml(
                scheduleDisplayTime(
                  row.lateBell,
                  row.classEnds
                )
              ) +
            '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      });

      html += '</tbody></table>';

      body.innerHTML = html;
      card.classList.remove('hidden');

      positionBellPlusBelowSchedule();
    }

    /* The period chart only changes when the Bell Schedule tab is edited,
       so reuse a recent copy (up to 30 seconds old) instead of asking the
       server every 15 seconds. */
    var schedulePreviewMemo = {};
    var SCHEDULE_PREVIEW_MEMO_MS = 30000;

    function loadSchedulePreview(scheduleName) {
      var name = String(scheduleName || '').trim();

      if (!name) {
        renderSchedulePreview(null);
        return;
      }

      var memo = schedulePreviewMemo[name];

      if (
        memo &&
        Date.now() - memo.at < SCHEDULE_PREVIEW_MEMO_MS
      ) {
        renderSchedulePreview(memo.data);
        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(details) {
          schedulePreviewMemo[name] = {
            at: Date.now(),
            data: details
          };

          renderSchedulePreview(details);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          renderSchedulePreview(null);
        })
        .getBellScheduleDisplay(name);
    }

    function positionBellPlusBelowSchedule() {
      var bell =
        document.getElementById(
          'bellPlusEmbed'
        );

      var dock =
        document.getElementById(
          'rightSideDock'
        );

      var schedule =
        document.getElementById(
          'schedulePreviewCard'
        );

      if (
        !bell ||
        !dock
      ) {
        return;
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        var dockRect =
          dock.getBoundingClientRect();

        var dockWidth =
          Math.max(
            220,
            dockRect.width || 270
          );

        var bottomGap =
          12;

        var betweenGap =
          8;

        var minBellHeight =
          150;

        var maxBellHeight =
          Math.max(
            minBellHeight,
            Math.min(
              360,
              window.innerHeight -
                bottomGap -
                80
            )
          );

        if (
          schedule &&
          !schedule.classList.contains(
            'hidden'
          )
        ) {
          var scheduleTop =
            schedule.getBoundingClientRect().top;

          var allowedScheduleHeight =
            Math.max(
              120,
              window.innerHeight -
                scheduleTop -
                betweenGap -
                minBellHeight -
                bottomGap
            );

          schedule.style.setProperty(
            'max-height',
            Math.floor(
              allowedScheduleHeight
            ) + 'px',
            'important'
          );
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          var desiredTop =
            12;

          if (
            schedule &&
            !schedule.classList.contains(
              'hidden'
            ) &&
            schedule.getClientRects().length
          ) {
            desiredTop =
              schedule
                .getBoundingClientRect()
                .bottom +
              betweenGap;
          } else {
            desiredTop =
              Math.max(
                12,
                window.innerHeight -
                  maxBellHeight -
                  bottomGap
              );
          }

          var availableHeight =
            window.innerHeight -
            bottomGap -
            desiredTop;

          var bellHeight =
            Math.max(
              minBellHeight,
              Math.min(
                maxBellHeight,
                Math.floor(
                  availableHeight
                )
              )
            );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'position',
            'fixed',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'right',
            '12px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'left',
            'auto',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'bottom',
            bottomGap + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'top',
            'auto',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'width',
            Math.floor(
              dockWidth
            ) + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'min-width',
            Math.floor(
              dockWidth
            ) + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'max-width',
            Math.floor(
              dockWidth
            ) + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'height',
            bellHeight + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'min-height',
            minBellHeight + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'max-height',
            maxBellHeight + 'px',
            'important'
          );

          bell.style.setProperty(
            'aspect-ratio',
            'auto',
            'important'
          );
        });
      });
    }

    function loadBellScheduleNames() {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(names) {
          bellScheduleNames = names || [];
          populateDayTypeDropdown();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          bellScheduleNames = [];
          populateDayTypeDropdown();
        })
        .getBellScheduleNames();
    }

    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      positionBellPlusBelowSchedule,
      {
        passive: true
      }
    );


    function refreshBellScheduleStatus() {
      if (attendanceScheduleCheckedKey) {
        clearAttendanceScheduleAlert();
      }

      // Always load the bell schedule for the right-side display.
      // classSelectionMode still controls whether the roster changes
      // automatically; it no longer controls whether the schedule is visible.
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(applyBellScheduleStatus)
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          updateScheduleStatusBar({
            schoolDay: true,
            scheduleName: '',
            label: 'Bell schedule unavailable'
          });
          renderSchedulePreview(null);
        })
        .getBellScheduleStatus(dayTypeOverride);
    }

    function renderClassCards() {
      var grid = document.getElementById('classGrid');
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      currentStep = "class";
      setStudentStage('Choose Your Class', '');
      showStudentStage();
      updateFlowNavigation();

      studentRoster.forEach(function(group) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'class-card';

        button.innerHTML =
          classImageHtml(group) +
          '<div class="class-card-text">' +
            '<div class="class-period">' +
              escapeHtml(group.period + ' Period') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="class-title-text">' +
              escapeHtml(group.classTitle) +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';

        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectedClass = group;
          renderStudentCards(group);
        });

        grid.appendChild(button);
      });

      document.getElementById('classChooser').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('studentChooser').classList.add('hidden');
    }



    function parseCssRgbColor(value) {
      var match = String(value || '').match(
        /rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)/
      );

      if (!match) return null;

      return {
        r: Number(match[1]),
        g: Number(match[2]),
        b: Number(match[3])
      };
    }



    function applyStudentNameContrast() {
      var textColor = window
        .getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue('--role-text')
        .trim();

      document.querySelectorAll('.student-card-name').forEach(function(nameEl) {
        nameEl.style.color =
          textColor || 'var(--role-text, var(--palette-high))';

        nameEl.style.textShadow =
          '0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.28), ' +
          '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.18)';
      });
    }





    function attendanceLocalDateKey() {
      var d = new Date();
      return (
        d.getFullYear() + '-' +
        String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
        String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      );
    }

    function attendanceSnapshotStorageKey(classKey) {
      return (
        'hallPassAttendanceSnapshot|' +
        attendanceLocalDateKey() +
        '|' +
        String(classKey || '')
      );
    }

    function saveAttendanceSnapshotForClass(classKey) {
      if (!classKey) return;

      try {
        localStorage.setItem(
          attendanceSnapshotStorageKey(classKey),
          JSON.stringify({
            savedAt: Date.now(),
            states: attendanceStateByKey || {}
          })
        );
      } catch (err) {}
    }

    function loadAttendanceSnapshotForClass(classKey) {
      if (!classKey) return {};

      try {
        var raw =
          localStorage.getItem(
            attendanceSnapshotStorageKey(classKey)
          );

        if (!raw) return {};

        var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

        if (
          !parsed ||
          !parsed.states ||
          typeof parsed.states !== 'object'
        ) {
          return {};
        }

        return parsed.states;
      } catch (err) {
        return {};
      }
    }

    function rebuildStickyAttendanceOutFromStates(group) {
      if (
        !group ||
        !Array.isArray(group.students)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      group.students.forEach(function(student) {
        var key =
          attendanceStudentKey(student);

        var state =
          attendanceStateByKey[key];

        if (
          state &&
          state.status === 'Pending Departure'
        ) {
          setStickyAttendanceOut(
            student,
            'pending',
            Number(state.dueAtMillis || 0)
          );
          return;
        }

        if (
          state &&
          state.status === 'Absent' &&
          state.earlyDeparture
        ) {
          setStickyAttendanceOut(
            student,
            'left',
            0
          );
          return;
        }

        // A confirmed present/tardy student should not remain pinned
        // in the out rail after a reload.
        if (
          state &&
          (
            state.status === 'Present' ||
            state.status === 'Tardy' ||
            String(state.status || '').indexOf('Pending ') === 0
          )
        ) {
          if (
            state.status !== 'Pending Departure'
          ) {
            clearStickyAttendanceOut(student);
          }
        }
      });
    }


    function currentAttendanceGroup() {
      return (
        attendanceRenderedGroup ||
        selectedClass ||
        null
      );
    }

    function preferredAttendanceGroup() {
      if (
        attendanceSettings &&
        attendanceSettings.enabled &&
        bellScheduleStatus &&
        bellScheduleStatus.schoolDay &&
        bellScheduleStatus.phase ===
          'passing' &&
        bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod
      ) {
        var scheduled =
          findRosterGroupForSchedulePeriod(
            bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod
          );

        if (scheduled) {
          return scheduled;
        }
      }

      return (
        selectedClass ||
        attendanceRenderedGroup ||
        null
      );
    }


    function currentAttendanceClassKey() {
      if (attendanceRenderedClassKey) {
        return attendanceRenderedClassKey;
      }
      if (!selectedClass) return '';
      return (
        String(selectedClass.period || '') +
        '|' +
        String(
          selectedClass.classTitle ||
          selectedClass.label ||
          ''
        )
      );
    }

    function stickyAttendanceOutMap() {
      var classKey = currentAttendanceClassKey();
      if (!classKey) return {};
      if (!attendanceOutRailStickyByClass[classKey]) {
        attendanceOutRailStickyByClass[classKey] = {};
      }
      return attendanceOutRailStickyByClass[classKey];
    }

    function setStickyAttendanceOut(student, mode, untilMillis) {
      if (!student) return;
      var classKey = currentAttendanceClassKey();
      if (!classKey) return;
      var map = stickyAttendanceOutMap();
      map[attendanceStudentKey(student)] = {
        mode: mode || 'left',
        untilMillis: Number(untilMillis || 0)
      };
    }

    function clearStickyAttendanceOut(student) {
      if (!student) return;
      var classKey = currentAttendanceClassKey();
      if (!classKey) return;
      var map = attendanceOutRailStickyByClass[classKey];
      if (!map) return;
      delete map[attendanceStudentKey(student)];
    }

    function getStickyAttendanceOut(student) {
      if (!student) return null;
      var classKey = currentAttendanceClassKey();
      if (!classKey) return null;
      var map = attendanceOutRailStickyByClass[classKey];
      if (!map) return null;
      return map[attendanceStudentKey(student)] || null;
    }

    function solidAttendanceColumnCount() {
      var value =
        parseInt(
          getComputedStyle(
            document.documentElement
          ).getPropertyValue(
            '--solid-attendance-columns'
          ),
          10
        );

      return (
        isFinite(value) &&
        value >= 2
          ? value
          : 3
      );
    }

    function fitSolidAttendanceGridLayout() {
      var grid =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSideGrid'
        );

      var panel =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSidePanel'
        );

      if (
        !grid ||
        !panel
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        !attendanceUsesSolidColors()
      ) {
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--solid-attendance-columns'
        );

        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(
          '--solid-attendance-card-height'
        );

        return;
      }

      var cards =
        Array.from(
          grid.children
        ).filter(function(card) {
          return (
            window
              .getComputedStyle(card)
              .display !==
            'none'
          );
        });

      if (!cards.length) {
        return;
      }

      var gridWidth =
        Math.max(
          120,
          grid.clientWidth ||
          grid.getBoundingClientRect().width
        );

      var panelStyle =
        window.getComputedStyle(
          panel
        );

      var bottomPadding =
        parseFloat(
          panelStyle.paddingBottom ||
          '0'
        ) || 0;

      var availableHeight =
        panel.clientHeight -
        grid.offsetTop -
        bottomPadding -
        2;

      availableHeight =
        Math.max(
          180,
          availableHeight
        );

      var gap =
        7;

      var idealRatio =
        1.62;

      var best = null;

      [2, 3, 4].forEach(function(columns) {
        var rows =
          Math.ceil(
            cards.length /
            columns
          );

        var cardWidth =
          (
            gridWidth -
            gap *
              (
                columns -
                1
              )
          ) /
          columns;

        var heightFromWidth =
          cardWidth /
          idealRatio;

        var heightFromPanel =
          (
            availableHeight -
            gap *
              Math.max(
                0,
                rows -
                1
              )
          ) /
          rows;

        var cardHeight =
          Math.min(
            heightFromWidth,
            heightFromPanel
          );

        /* Do not force tiny cards just to avoid scrolling.
           A small amount of panel scrolling is better than portrait cards. */
        cardHeight =
          Math.max(
            68,
            Math.min(
              128,
              cardHeight
            )
          );

        var actualRatio =
          cardWidth /
          cardHeight;

        var ratioPenalty =
          Math.abs(
            actualRatio -
            idealRatio
          );

        var tooNarrowPenalty =
          cardWidth < 132
            ? (
                132 -
                cardWidth
              ) *
              .08
            : 0;

        var tooTallPenalty =
          actualRatio < 1.25
            ? 10
            : 0;

        var overflowHeight =
          rows *
            cardHeight +
          Math.max(
            0,
            rows -
            1
          ) *
            gap;

        var overflowPenalty =
          Math.max(
            0,
            overflowHeight -
            availableHeight
          ) *
          .015;

        var score =
          ratioPenalty *
            12 +
          tooNarrowPenalty +
          tooTallPenalty +
          overflowPenalty -
          (
            cardWidth *
            cardHeight
          ) /
          10000;

        if (
          !best ||
          score <
            best.score
        ) {
          best = {
            columns:
              columns,
            rows:
              rows,
            width:
              cardWidth,
            height:
              cardHeight,
            score:
              score
          };
        }
      });

      if (!best) {
        return;
      }

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--solid-attendance-columns',
        String(
          best.columns
        )
      );

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--solid-attendance-card-height',
        Math.floor(
          best.height
        ) + 'px'
      );

      grid.setAttribute(
        'data-solid-columns',
        String(
          best.columns
        )
      );

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        fitAttendanceCardNames();
        centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow();
      });
    }


    function fitAttendanceCardNames() {
      document.querySelectorAll(
        '#attendanceSideGrid .student-name, ' +
        '#attendanceSideGrid .attendance-side-name, ' +
        '#attendanceSideGrid .attendance-student-name'
      ).forEach(function(nameEl) {
        var card =
          nameEl.closest(
            '.attendance-side-card'
          );

        if (!card) return;

        if (
          attendanceUsesSolidColors()
        ) {
          fitAttendanceSolidCardName(
            nameEl,
            card
          );

          return;
        }

        var computed =
          window.getComputedStyle(card);

        var horizontalPadding =
          (
            parseFloat(
              computed.paddingLeft || '0'
            ) || 0
          ) +
          (
            parseFloat(
              computed.paddingRight || '0'
            ) || 0
          );

        var maxWidth =
          Math.max(
            28,
            card.clientWidth -
            horizontalPadding -
            4
          );

        var size = 24;
        var minSize = 10;

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'display',
          'block',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'height',
          'auto',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'max-width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'white-space',
          'nowrap',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'overflow',
          'hidden',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          size + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        while (
          size > minSize &&
          nameEl.scrollWidth >
            maxWidth
        ) {
          size -= 1;

          nameEl.style.setProperty(
            'font-size',
            size + 'px',
            'important'
          );
        }

        while (
          size > minSize &&
          nameEl.scrollWidth >
            maxWidth
        ) {
          size -= 0.25;

          nameEl.style.setProperty(
            'font-size',
            size.toFixed(2) + 'px',
            'important'
          );
        }
      });
    }

    function centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow() {
      var grid =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSideGrid'
        );

      if (!grid) return;

      var items =
        Array.from(
          grid.children
        ).filter(function(item) {
          return (
            window.getComputedStyle(item)
              .display !== 'none'
          );
        });

      items.forEach(function(item) {
        item.style.removeProperty(
          'grid-column-start'
        );
        item.style.removeProperty(
          'grid-column-end'
        );
        item.style.removeProperty(
          'transform'
        );
      });

      if (!items.length) return;

      var cols =
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
          ? solidAttendanceColumnCount()
          : 5;

      var remainder =
        items.length % cols;

      if (!remainder) return;

      var style =
        window.getComputedStyle(grid);

      var columnGap =
        parseFloat(
          style.columnGap ||
          style.gap ||
          '0'
        ) || 0;

      var gridWidth =
        grid.clientWidth ||
        grid.getBoundingClientRect().width ||
        0;

      var trackWidth =
        (
          gridWidth -
          columnGap *
            (
              cols -
              1
            )
        ) /
        cols;

      var emptyTracks =
        cols -
        remainder;

      var startColumn =
        Math.floor(
          emptyTracks /
          2
        ) +
        1;

      var halfTrackOffset =
        emptyTracks %
          2
          ? (
              trackWidth +
              columnGap
            ) /
            2
          : 0;

      var firstLastRowIndex =
        items.length -
        remainder;

      items
        .slice(
          firstLastRowIndex
        )
        .forEach(function(item, index) {
          item.style.setProperty(
            'grid-column-start',
            String(
              startColumn +
              index
            ),
            'important'
          );

          item.style.setProperty(
            'grid-column-end',
            'auto',
            'important'
          );

          item.style.setProperty(
            'transform',
            halfTrackOffset
              ? (
                  'translateX(' +
                  halfTrackOffset.toFixed(2) +
                  'px)'
                )
              : 'none',
            'important'
          );
        });
    }

    function settleAttendanceCardLayout() {
      if (
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
      ) {
        fitSolidAttendanceGridLayout();
      }

      fitAttendanceCardNames();
      centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow();

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        if (
          attendanceUsesSolidColors()
        ) {
          fitSolidAttendanceGridLayout();
        }

        fitAttendanceCardNames();
        centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow();
      });
    }


    function attendanceUsesSolidColors() {
      return (
        String(
          attendanceSettings &&
          attendanceSettings.emojiMode ||
          'Random Bank'
        ) ===
        'Solid Colors'
      );
    }

    function applyAttendanceDisplayMode() {
      var solid =
        attendanceUsesSolidColors();

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'attendance-mode-solid',
        solid
      );

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'attendance-mode-emoji',
        !solid
      );

      var panel =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSidePanel'
        );

      if (panel) {
        panel.classList.toggle(
          'attendance-mode-solid',
          solid
        );

        panel.classList.toggle(
          'attendance-mode-emoji',
          !solid
        );
      }

      if (
        typeof renderAttendanceStates ===
        'function'
      ) {
        renderAttendanceStates();
      }

      if (
        typeof syncAttendanceSidePassStates ===
        'function'
      ) {
        syncAttendanceSidePassStates();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
