        if (
          typeof settleAttendanceCardLayout ===
          'function'
        ) {
          settleAttendanceCardLayout();
        }
      });
    }

    function setAttendanceCardBaseColor(
      card,
      state
    ) {
      if (!card) return;

      card.classList.remove(
        'attendance-color-absent',
        'attendance-color-present',
        'attendance-color-out'
      );

      if (
        state &&
        (
          state.status ===
            'Pending Departure' ||
          (
            state.status ===
              'Absent' &&
            state.earlyDeparture
          )
        )
      ) {
        card.classList.add(
          'attendance-color-out'
        );

        return;
      }

      if (
        state &&
        (
          state.status ===
            'Present' ||
          state.status ===
            'Tardy' ||
          (
            String(
              state.status || ''
            ).indexOf(
              'Pending '
            ) === 0 &&
            state.status !==
              'Pending Departure'
          )
        )
      ) {
        card.classList.add(
          'attendance-color-present'
        );

        return;
      }

      card.classList.add(
        'attendance-color-absent'
      );
    }

    function fitAttendanceSolidCardName(
      nameEl,
      card
    ) {
      if (
        !nameEl ||
        !card
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var text =
        String(
          nameEl.textContent || ''
        ).trim();

      if (!text) {
        return;
      }

      var maxWidth =
        Math.max(
          34,
          card.clientWidth - 14
        );

      var maxHeight =
        Math.max(
          34,
          card.clientHeight - 14
        );

      var hasSpaces =
        /\s/.test(text);

      function setCommonMeasurementStyles() {
        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-family',
          'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-weight',
          '900',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'letter-spacing',
          '0',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'line-height',
          '.94',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'word-break',
          'normal',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'overflow-wrap',
          'normal',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'hyphens',
          'none',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'overflow',
          'visible',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'text-overflow',
          'clip',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'margin',
          '0',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'padding',
          '0',
          'important'
        );
      }

      setCommonMeasurementStyles();

      /* PASS 1 — one line.
         This is the normal state for first names. A single word is never
         allowed to wrap into chunks like "Bra / ely / nn". */
      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'display',
        'block',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'width',
        'max-content',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'max-width',
        'none',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'height',
        'auto',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'white-space',
        'nowrap',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'text-wrap',
        'nowrap',
        'important'
      );

      var low =
        14;

      var high =
        Math.max(
          24,
          Math.min(
            78,
            Math.floor(
              maxHeight *
              .72
            )
          )
        );

      var best =
        low;

      while (
        low <= high
      ) {
        var size =
          Math.floor(
            (
              low +
              high
            ) /
            2
          );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          size + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        var rect =
          nameEl.getBoundingClientRect();

        var fits =
          rect.width <=
            maxWidth + 1 &&
          rect.height <=
            maxHeight + 1;

        if (fits) {
          best =
            size;

          low =
            size + 1;
        } else {
          high =
            size - 1;
        }
      }

      /* For a single-word name, this one-line result is always final.
         For a multi-word name, keep one line unless it would become tiny. */
      if (
        !hasSpaces ||
        best >= 22
      ) {
        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          best + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'display',
          'flex',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'max-width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'height',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'align-items',
          'center',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'justify-content',
          'center',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'text-align',
          'center',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'white-space',
          'nowrap',
          'important'
        );

        return;
      }

      /* PASS 2 — multi-word names only.
         Allow a maximum of two centered lines, breaking only at spaces. */
      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'display',
        'block',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'width',
        maxWidth + 'px',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'max-width',
        maxWidth + 'px',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'height',
        'auto',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'white-space',
        'normal',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'text-wrap',
        'balance',
        'important'
      );

      low =
        14;

      high =
        Math.max(
          22,
          Math.min(
            58,
            Math.floor(
              maxHeight *
              .48
            )
          )
        );

      best =
        low;

      while (
        low <= high
      ) {
        var twoLineSize =
          Math.floor(
            (
              low +
              high
            ) /
            2
          );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          twoLineSize + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        var computed =
          window.getComputedStyle(
            nameEl
          );

        var lineHeight =
          parseFloat(
            computed.lineHeight || '0'
          );

        if (
          !isFinite(
            lineHeight
          ) ||
          lineHeight <= 0
        ) {
          lineHeight =
            twoLineSize *
            .94;
        }

        var twoLineLimit =
          lineHeight * 2 + 2;

        var twoLineFits =
          nameEl.scrollWidth <=
            maxWidth + 1 &&
          nameEl.scrollHeight <=
            Math.min(
              maxHeight,
              twoLineLimit
            ) + 1;

        if (twoLineFits) {
          best =
            twoLineSize;

          low =
            twoLineSize + 1;
        } else {
          high =
            twoLineSize - 1;
        }
      }

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'font-size',
        best + 'px',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'display',
        'flex',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'width',
        '100%',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'max-width',
        '100%',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'height',
        '100%',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'align-items',
        'center',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'justify-content',
        'center',
        'important'
      );

      nameEl.style.setProperty(
        'text-align',
        'center',
        'important'
      );
    }


    function renderAttendanceSidePanel(group) {
      var panel = document.getElementById('attendanceSidePanel');
      var classLabel = document.getElementById('attendanceSideClass');
      var note = document.getElementById('attendanceSideNote');
      var grid = document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid');

      if (!panel || !classLabel || !note || !grid) return;

      panel.classList.toggle(
        'hidden',
        !attendanceSettings.enabled
      );

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'attendance-side-on',
        !!attendanceSettings.enabled
      );

      if (!attendanceSettings.enabled) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      if (!group) {
        if (attendanceRenderedClassKey) {
          attendanceStateCacheByClass[
            attendanceRenderedClassKey
          ] = attendanceStateByKey;

          attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
            attendanceRenderedClassKey
          ] = attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys;
        }

        attendanceRenderedClassKey = '';
        attendanceRenderedGroup = null;
        attendanceStateByKey = {};
        attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys = {};
        attendanceLoadSequence += 1;

        classLabel.textContent = 'Choose a class';
        note.textContent =
          'Attendance will appear here once a class is selected.';
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      attendanceRenderedGroup =
        group;

      var nextClassKey =
        String(group.period || '') +
        '|' +
        String(group.classTitle || group.label || '');

      if (
        attendanceRenderedClassKey !==
        nextClassKey
      ) {
        // Save the current class's local attendance state before switching.
        // This preserves an optimistic check-in or an immediate undo if the
        // teacher/student jumps to another class and comes back quickly.
        if (attendanceRenderedClassKey) {
          attendanceStateCacheByClass[
            attendanceRenderedClassKey
          ] = attendanceStateByKey;

          attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
            attendanceRenderedClassKey
          ] = attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys;
        }

        attendanceRenderedClassKey =
          nextClassKey;

        attendanceStateByKey =
          attendanceStateCacheByClass[
            nextClassKey
          ] ||
          loadAttendanceSnapshotForClass(
            nextClassKey
          ) ||
          {};

        attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys =
          attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
            nextClassKey
          ] || {};

        // Store the live objects immediately so subsequent local mutations
        // remain attached to the correct class cache.
        attendanceStateCacheByClass[
          nextClassKey
        ] = attendanceStateByKey;

        attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
          nextClassKey
        ] = attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys;

        attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey = {};

        // Any older attendance response belongs to the previous class.
        attendanceLoadSequence += 1;
      }

      classLabel.textContent = group.label;

      note.textContent =
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
          ? 'Red = absent • Green = present/tardy • Yellow = out of room. Tap to check in; tap a checked-in card again if leaving early.'
          : 'Red = absent • Green = present/tardy • Yellow = out of room. Tap to check in; emoji reveal happens after the tap.';

      grid.innerHTML = '';

      group.students.forEach(function(student, studentIndex) {
        var card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className =
          'attendance-side-card attendance-absent';
        card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

        var key = attendanceStudentKey(student);

        card.setAttribute(
          'data-attendance-key',
          key
        );

        card.setAttribute(
          'data-student-index',
          String(studentIndex)
        );

        card.setAttribute(
          'data-student-full-name',
          String(
            student.fullName ||
            ((student.firstName || '') + ' ' + (student.lastName || ''))
          ).trim().toLowerCase()
        );

        card.innerHTML =
          attendanceAvatarHtml() +
          '<div class="attendance-side-name">' +
            escapeHtml(
              student.displayName ||
              student.firstName ||
              student.name
            ) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="attendance-state-line">ABSENT • TAP TO CHECK IN</div>' +
          '<div class="attendance-pass-hint"></div>' +
          '';

        setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(card);

        var departureAction = card.querySelector(
          '.attendance-departure-action'
        );

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.addEventListener(
            'pointerdown',
            function(event) {
              event.stopPropagation();
              if (event.cancelable) {
                event.preventDefault();
              }
            }
          );

          departureAction.addEventListener(
            'click',
            function(event) {
              event.stopPropagation();
              if (event.cancelable) {
                event.preventDefault();
              }

              var liveState =
                attendanceStateByKey[
                  attendanceStudentKey(student)
                ];

              if (
                liveState &&
                liveState.status === 'Pending Departure'
              ) {
                cancelStudentEarlyDeparture(
                  student,
                  card,
                  liveState
                );
                return;
              }

              if (
                liveState &&
                (
                  liveState.status === 'Present' ||
                  liveState.status === 'Tardy'
                )
              ) {
                markStudentEarlyDeparture(
                  student,
                  card,
                  liveState
                );
                return;
              }

              // Never fail silently. If this card looks checked in but its
              // local attendance state is stale, reload the attendance state
              // instead of leaving the student thinking the tap did nothing.
              if (
                card.classList.contains(
                  'attendance-confirmed'
                ) &&
                selectedClass
              ) {
                loadAttendanceForGroup(
                  selectedClass
                );
              }
            }
          );

          departureAction.addEventListener(
            'keydown',
            function(event) {
              if (
                event.key === 'Enter' ||
                event.key === ' '
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                departureAction.click();
              }
            }
          );
        }

        // Attendance interactions are intentionally isolated from the
        // hall-pass/student-selection flow. Do not perform the state change
        // on pointerdown: changing/rerendering the UI before pointerup/click
        // can create a "ghost" click on whatever appears underneath.
        card.addEventListener(
          'pointerdown',
          function(event) {
            event.stopPropagation();

            if (event.cancelable) {
              event.preventDefault();
            }
          }
        );

        card.addEventListener(
          'pointerup',
          function(event) {
            event.stopPropagation();

            if (event.cancelable) {
              event.preventDefault();
            }
          }
        );

        card.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function(event) {
            event.stopPropagation();

            if (event.cancelable) {
              event.preventDefault();
            }

            handleAttendanceStudentTap(
              student,
              card
            );
          }
        );

        card.addEventListener(
          'keydown',
          function(event) {
            if (
              event.target !== card ||
              (
                event.key !== 'Enter' &&
                event.key !== ' '
              )
            ) {
              return;
            }

            event.stopPropagation();
            event.preventDefault();

            handleAttendanceStudentTap(
              student,
              card
            );
          }
        );

        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Paint any same-day locally cached state immediately. This avoids
      // the reload flash where everyone temporarily looks absent while waiting
      // for Apps Script/Sheets.
      rebuildStickyAttendanceOutFromStates(group);
      renderAttendanceStates();

      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }

      loadAttendanceForGroup(group);
      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();

      settleAttendanceCardLayout();

      if (
        document.body.classList.contains(
          'passing-attendance-priority'
        )
      ) {
        requestAnimationFrame(
          fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards
        );
      }
    }

    function findActivePassForAttendanceCard(card) {
      if (!card) return null;

      var fullName = String(
        card.getAttribute(
          'data-student-full-name'
        ) || ''
      ).trim().toLowerCase();

      if (!fullName) return null;

      return (activePasses || []).find(function(pass) {
        return String(pass.name || '')
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase() === fullName;
      }) || null;
    }

    function syncAttendanceSidePassStates() {
      document
        .querySelectorAll(
          '#attendanceSideGrid .attendance-side-card'
        )
        .forEach(function(card) {
          card.classList.remove(
            'attendance-pass-out',
            'attendance-pass-green',
            'attendance-pass-yellow',
            'attendance-pass-red'
          );

          var pass =
            findActivePassForAttendanceCard(
              card
            );

          if (!pass) {
            return;
          }

          /* Attendance uses a simple room-status palette.
             Any active hall pass = OUT OF ROOM = yellow.
             The out-of-classroom rail keeps its own elapsed-time colors. */
          card.classList.add(
            'attendance-pass-out'
          );
        });
    }

    function attendanceStudentKey(student) {
      var id = String(student && student.id || '').trim();
      var fullName = String(
        student && (
          student.fullName ||
          ((student.firstName || '') + ' ' + (student.lastName || ''))
        ) || ''
      ).trim().toLowerCase();

      return id ? 'ID:' + id : 'NAME:' + fullName;
    }

    function attendanceContextForStudent(student) {
      return {
        studentName:
          student.fullName ||
          ((student.firstName || '') + ' ' + (student.lastName || '')).trim(),
        studentId: student.id || '',
        period: selectedClass ? selectedClass.period : '',
        className: selectedClass ? selectedClass.classTitle : '',
        scheduleName:
          bellScheduleStatus && bellScheduleStatus.scheduleName
            ? bellScheduleStatus.scheduleName
            : '',
        lateBell:
          bellScheduleStatus && bellScheduleStatus.lateBell
            ? bellScheduleStatus.lateBell
            : ''
      };
    }

    function formatAttendanceClockFromMillis(millis) {
      if (!millis) return '';

      return new Date(Number(millis)).toLocaleTimeString(
        [],
        {
          hour: 'numeric',
          minute: '2-digit',
          second: '2-digit'
        }
      );
    }

    function formatAttendanceRemaining(ms) {
      var total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 1000));
      var minutes = Math.floor(total / 60);
      var seconds = total % 60;

      return (
        minutes + ':' +
        String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')
      );
    }

    function clearAttendanceScheduleAlert() {
      var box = document.getElementById(
        'attendanceScheduleAlert'
      );

      if (!box) return;

      box.textContent = '';
      box.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showAttendanceScheduleAlert(result) {
      var box = document.getElementById(
        'attendanceScheduleAlert'
      );

      if (!box || !result) return;

      var text = '';

      if (result.level === 'strong') {
        text =
          'Schedule check: this arrival matches ' +
          result.suggestedSchedule +
          (result.expectedSchedule
            ? ', not the expected ' +
              result.expectedSchedule +
              '. Use the DAY menu if today’s schedule should change.'
            : '. Use the DAY menu if that is today’s schedule.');
      } else if (result.level === 'possible') {
        text =
          'Schedule check: this arrival does not clearly match the expected bell pattern. Possible matches: ' +
          result.matchingSchedules.join(', ') +
          '.';
      } else if (result.level === 'unusual') {
        text =
          'Unusual bell pattern detected: this arrival does not line up with any saved passing period for this class. Check the DAY menu or use manual class selection.';
      }

      if (!text) {
        clearAttendanceScheduleAlert();
        return;
      }

      box.textContent = text;
      box.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function maybeCheckArrivalSchedule(student) {
      if (
        !attendanceSettings.enabled ||
        !selectedClass ||
        !bellScheduleStatus ||
        bellScheduleStatus.phase !== 'passing'
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var checkKey =
        String(bellScheduleStatus.dateKey || '') + '|' +
        String(selectedClass.period || '');

      if (
        attendanceScheduleCheckedKey === checkKey
      ) {
        return;
      }

      attendanceScheduleCheckedKey = checkKey;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(
          showAttendanceScheduleAlert
        )
        .withFailureHandler(function() {})
        .checkArrivalScheduleMatch({
          period: selectedClass.period,
          expectedSchedule:
            bellScheduleStatus.scheduleName || ''
        });
    }


    function ensureEarlyDepartureInOutList(student, state) {
      // Left Early is rendered by the attendance-aware out rail.
      // Keeping it out of activePasses prevents duplicate cards.
      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }
    }


    function applyAttendanceStateToCard(
      student,
      card,
      state
    ) {
      if (!card) return;

      var cover = card.querySelector(
        '.attendance-photo-cover'
      );
      var stateLine = card.querySelector(
        '.attendance-state-line'
      );
      var hint = card.querySelector(
        '.attendance-pass-hint'
      );
      var departureAction = card.querySelector(
        '.attendance-departure-action'
      );

      card.classList.remove(
        'attendance-absent',
        'attendance-pending',
        'attendance-confirmed',
        'attendance-early-departure',
        'attendance-departure-pending'
      );

      setAttendanceCardBaseColor(
        card,
        state
      );

      if (!state) {
        card.classList.add('attendance-absent');

        if (cover) {
          setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(card);
        }

        if (stateLine) {
          stateLine.textContent =
            'ABSENT • TAP TO CHECK IN';
        }

        if (hint) {
          hint.textContent = '';
        }

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.textContent = 'MARK ABSENT';
        }

        return;
      }

      if (state.status === 'Absent') {
        card.classList.add('attendance-absent');

        if (state.earlyDeparture) {
          card.classList.add(
            'attendance-early-departure'
          );

          // Keep left-early students represented in the
          // Currently Out of the Classroom rail immediately.
          ensureEarlyDepartureInOutList(student, state);
        }

        if (cover) {
          if (
            state.earlyDeparture &&
            !attendanceUsesSolidColors() &&
            state.emoji
          ) {
            setAttendanceAvatar(
              card,
              student,
              state.emoji
            );
          } else {
            setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(
              card
            );
          }
        }

        if (stateLine) {
          stateLine.textContent =
            state.earlyDeparture
              ? (
                  'LEFT EARLY • ABSENT' +
                  (
                    state.departedAtText
                      ? ' • ' +
                        state.departedAtText
                      : ''
                  )
                )
              : 'ABSENT • TAP TO CHECK IN';
        }

        if (hint) {
          hint.textContent =
            state.earlyDeparture
              ? 'Tap if you return to class'
              : '';
        }

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.textContent = 'MARK ABSENT';
        }

        return;
      }

      if (state.status === 'Pending Departure') {
        card.classList.add(
          'attendance-confirmed',
          'attendance-departure-pending'
        );

        if (cover) {
          if (state.emoji) {
            setAttendanceAvatar(
              card,
              student,
              state.emoji
            );
          } else {
            setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(
              card
            );
          }
        }

        if (stateLine) {
          stateLine.textContent =
            'MARKING ABSENT • ' +
            formatAttendanceRemaining(
              Number(state.dueAtMillis || 0) -
              Date.now()
            ) +
            ' REMAINING';
        }

        if (hint) {
          hint.textContent =
            'Tap again to undo • 1 minute';
        }

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.textContent =
            'UNDO ABSENT';
        }

        return;
      }

      if (
        String(state.status || '').indexOf(
          'Pending '
        ) === 0
      ) {
        card.classList.add('attendance-pending');

        // The attendance save/confirmation continues in the background,
        // but the student's avatar may reveal immediately after the brief
        // slot-machine animation so the arrival line never has to wait.
        if (cover) {
          if (state.revealEmoji && state.emoji) {
            setAttendanceAvatar(card, student, state.emoji);
          } else {
            setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(card);
          }
        }

        if (stateLine) {
          stateLine.textContent =
            'CHECKING IN • ' +
            formatAttendanceRemaining(
              Number(state.dueAtMillis || 0) -
              Date.now()
            ) +
            ' REMAINING';
        }

        if (hint) {
          hint.textContent =
            'Tap again to undo • 1 minute';
        }

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.textContent = 'MARK ABSENT';
        }

        return;
      }

      if (
        state.status === 'Present' ||
        state.status === 'Tardy'
      ) {
        card.classList.add(
          'attendance-confirmed'
        );

        if (cover) {
          if (state.emoji) {
            setAttendanceAvatar(
              card,
              student,
              state.emoji
            );
          } else {
            setAttendanceHiddenAvatar(
              card
            );
          }
        }

        if (stateLine) {
          stateLine.textContent =
            state.status +
            ' • ' +
            (
              state.originalCheckInText ||
              formatAttendanceClockFromMillis(
                state.originalCheckInMillis
              )
            );
        }

        if (hint) {
          hint.textContent =
            'Tap to mark absent';
        }

        if (departureAction) {
          departureAction.textContent =
            'MARK ABSENT';
        }
      }
    }

    function renderAttendanceStates() {
      if (!attendanceSettings.enabled) {
        return;
      }

      var attendanceGroup =
        currentAttendanceGroup();

      document
        .querySelectorAll(
          '#attendanceSideGrid .attendance-side-card'
        )
        .forEach(function(card) {
          var key = card.getAttribute(
            'data-attendance-key'
          );

          var studentIndex = Number(
            card.getAttribute(
              'data-student-index'
            )
          );

          var student =
            attendanceGroup &&
            attendanceGroup.students
              ? attendanceGroup.students[
                  studentIndex
                ]
              : null;

          if (!student) return;

          applyAttendanceStateToCard(
            student,
            card,
            attendanceStateByKey[key] || null
          );
        });

      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();

      if (attendanceRenderedClassKey) {
        saveAttendanceSnapshotForClass(
          attendanceRenderedClassKey
        );
      }

      if (
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
      ) {
        requestAnimationFrame(
          fitSolidAttendanceGridLayout
        );
      }
    }

    function startAttendanceCountdownTimer() {
      if (attendanceCountdownTimer) {
        clearInterval(
          attendanceCountdownTimer
        );
      }

      attendanceCountdownTimer =
        setInterval(function() {
          var now = Date.now();

          Object.keys(
            attendanceStateByKey
          ).forEach(function(key) {
            var state =
              attendanceStateByKey[key];

            if (!state) return;

            var isPendingDeparture =
              state.status === 'Pending Departure';
            var isPendingArrival =
              String(
                state.status || ''
              ).indexOf('Pending ') === 0 &&
              !isPendingDeparture;

            if (
              !isPendingDeparture &&
              !isPendingArrival
            ) {
              return;
            }

            var card =
              document.querySelector(
                '#attendanceSideGrid .attendance-side-card[data-attendance-key="' +
                CSS.escape(key) +
                '"]'
              );

            if (card) {
              var stateLine =
                card.querySelector(
                  '.attendance-state-line'
                );

              if (stateLine) {
                stateLine.textContent =
                  (isPendingDeparture
                    ? 'MARKING ABSENT • '
                    : 'CHECKING IN • ') +
                  formatAttendanceRemaining(
                    Number(
                      state.dueAtMillis ||
                      0
                    ) -
                    now
                  ) +
                  ' REMAINING';
              }
            }

            if (
              Number(
                state.dueAtMillis ||
                0
              ) > now ||
              state.confirming
            ) {
              return;
            }

            if (isPendingDeparture) {
              if (!state.eventId) return;

              state.confirming = true;

              google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(
                  function(result) {
                    if (
                      !result ||
                      !result.success
                    ) {
                      state.confirming = false;
                      loadAttendanceForGroup(
                        currentAttendanceGroup()
                      );
                      return;
                    }

                    attendanceStateByKey[key] = {
                      studentKey: key,
                      eventId: state.eventId,
                      status: 'Absent',
                      earlyDeparture: true,
                      departedAtMillis:
                        result.departedAtMillis,
                      departedAtText:
                        result.departedAtText,
                      emoji:
                        state.emoji ||
                        attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey[key] ||
                        ''
                    };

                    var attendanceGroup =
                      currentAttendanceGroup();

                    if (
                      attendanceGroup &&
                      Array.isArray(attendanceGroup.students)
                    ) {
                      var departingStudent =
                        attendanceGroup.students.find(function(candidate) {
                          return attendanceStudentKey(candidate) === key;
                        });

                      if (departingStudent) {
                        setStickyAttendanceOut(
                          departingStudent,
                          'left',
                          0
                        );
                      }
                    }

                    renderAttendanceStates();
                  }
                )
                .withFailureHandler(
                  function() {
                    state.confirming = false;
                    loadAttendanceForGroup(
                      selectedClass
                    );
                  }
                )
                .markAttendanceEarlyDeparture(
                  state.eventId
                );

              return;
            }

            // During a rush, check-in writes get priority.
            // Confirmation can wait until the write queue is idle.
            if (
              attendanceWriteInFlight ||
              attendanceWriteQueue.length ||
              !state.eventId
            ) {
              return;
            }

            state.confirming = true;

            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(
                function(result) {
                  if (
                    !result ||
                    !result.success
                  ) {
                    state.confirming =
                      false;
                    return;
                  }

                  attendanceStateByKey[
                    key
                  ] = {
                    studentKey: key,
                    eventId:
                      result.eventId,
                    status:
                      result.status,
                    emoji:
                      result.emoji,
                    originalCheckInMillis:
                      result
                        .originalCheckInMillis ||
                      state
                        .originalCheckInMillis,
                    originalCheckInText:
                      result
                        .originalCheckInText ||
                      state
                        .originalCheckInText,
                    dueAtMillis: 0
                  };

                  if (card) {
                    var studentIndex =
                      Number(
                        card.getAttribute(
                          'data-student-index'
                        )
                      );

                    var attendanceGroup =
                      currentAttendanceGroup();

                    var student =
                      attendanceGroup &&
                      attendanceGroup.students
                        ? attendanceGroup.students[
                            studentIndex
                          ]
                        : null;

                    if (student) {
                      applyAttendanceStateToCard(
                        student,
                        card,
                        attendanceStateByKey[
                          key
                        ]
                      );

                      maybeCheckArrivalSchedule(
                        student
                      );
                    }
                  }
                }
              )
              .withFailureHandler(
                function() {
                  state.confirming =
                    false;
                }
              )
              .confirmAttendanceCheckIn(
                state.eventId
              );
          });
        }, 1000);
    }

    function loadAttendanceForGroup(group) {
      if (
        !attendanceSettings.enabled ||
        !group
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var loadId =
        ++attendanceLoadSequence;

      var requestedClassKey =
        String(group.period || '') +
        '|' +
        String(group.classTitle || group.label || '');

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(
          function(result) {
            // Ignore an older load if a newer one was requested.
            if (
              loadId !==
              attendanceLoadSequence ||
              requestedClassKey !==
              attendanceRenderedClassKey
            ) {
              return;
            }

            if (
              result &&
              result.settings
            ) {
              attendanceSettings =
                result.settings;

              applyAttendanceDisplayMode();
            }

            var serverStates = {};

            (
              result &&
              result.states
                ? result.states
                : []
            ).forEach(function(state) {
              serverStates[
                state.studentKey
              ] = state;
            });

            // CRITICAL: never let a slow server response erase a
            // student's tap that already happened on this screen.
            Object.keys(
              serverStates
            ).forEach(function(key) {
              if (
                !attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[
                  key
                ]
              ) {
                attendanceStateByKey[key] =
                  serverStates[key];
              }
            });

            // Remove stale untouched local states that no longer
            // exist on the server, but preserve every locally-tapped
            // student exactly as the touchscreen currently shows them.
            Object.keys(
              attendanceStateByKey
            ).forEach(function(key) {
              if (
                !attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[
                  key
                ] &&
                !serverStates[key]
              ) {
                delete attendanceStateByKey[
                  key
                ];
              }
            });

            attendanceStateCacheByClass[
              requestedClassKey
            ] = attendanceStateByKey;

            attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
              requestedClassKey
            ] = attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys;

            rebuildStickyAttendanceOutFromStates(group);
            saveAttendanceSnapshotForClass(
              requestedClassKey
            );

            renderAttendanceStates();

            if (
              typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal ===
              'function'
            ) {
              appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
            }

            startAttendanceCountdownTimer();
          }
        )
        .withFailureHandler(
          function() {}
        )
        .getAttendanceState({
          period: group.period,
          className: group.classTitle
        });
    }


    function markStudentEarlyDeparture(
      student,
      card,
      state
    ) {
      if (
        !state ||
        !state.eventId ||
        (
          state.status !== 'Present' &&
          state.status !== 'Tardy'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var key =
        attendanceStudentKey(student);

      if (
        isBirthdayCheckInStudent(
          student
        )
      ) {
        primeBirthdaySound();
      }

      attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[key] = true;

      var now = Date.now();
      var holdSeconds = 60;

      attendanceStateByKey[key] = {
        studentKey: key,
        eventId: state.eventId,
        status: 'Pending Departure',
        previousStatus: state.status,
        emoji:
          state.emoji ||
          getAttendanceAssignedEmoji(student),
        originalCheckInMillis:
          state.originalCheckInMillis,
        originalCheckInText:
          state.originalCheckInText,
        dueAtMillis:
          now + holdSeconds * 1000
      };

      setStickyAttendanceOut(
        student,
        'pending',
        now + holdSeconds * 1000
      );

      applyAttendanceStateToCard(
        student,
        card,
        attendanceStateByKey[key]
      );

      // Pending Departure belongs in the out rail immediately.
      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }

      startAttendanceCountdownTimer();
    }

    function cancelStudentEarlyDeparture(
      student,
      card,
      state
    ) {
      if (
        !state ||
        state.status !== 'Pending Departure'
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var key =
        attendanceStudentKey(student);

      attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[key] = true;

      clearStickyAttendanceOut(student);

      attendanceStateByKey[key] = {
        studentKey: key,
        eventId: state.eventId,
        status:
          state.previousStatus ||
          'Present',
        emoji:
          state.emoji ||
          getAttendanceAssignedEmoji(student),
        originalCheckInMillis:
          state.originalCheckInMillis,
        originalCheckInText:
          state.originalCheckInText,
        dueAtMillis: 0
      };

      applyAttendanceStateToCard(
        student,
        card,
        attendanceStateByKey[key]
      );

      // Undo should remove the student from the out rail immediately.
      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }
    }


    function makeAttendanceRequestId() {
      return (
        'att_' +
        Date.now() +
        '_' +
        Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 9)
      );
    }

    function enqueueAttendanceWrite(
      student,
      payload,
      requestId
    ) {
      var queueClassKey =
        attendanceRenderedClassKey ||
        (
          String(
            selectedClass &&
            selectedClass.period ||
            ''
          ) +
          '|' +
          String(
            selectedClass &&
            (
              selectedClass.classTitle ||
              selectedClass.label
            ) ||
            ''
          )
        );

      attendanceWriteQueue.push({
        key:
          attendanceStudentKey(student),
        classKey: queueClassKey,
        requestId: requestId,
        payload: payload
      });

      if (attendanceWriteTimer) {
        clearTimeout(
          attendanceWriteTimer
        );
      }

      // Tiny collection window lets several walking students
      // become one Apps Script request without delaying the UI.
      attendanceWriteTimer =
        setTimeout(
          flushAttendanceWriteQueue,
          300
        );
    }

    function removeQueuedAttendanceWrite(
      key,
      classKey
    ) {
      attendanceWriteQueue =
        attendanceWriteQueue.filter(
          function(item) {
            return !(
              item.key === key &&
              (
                !classKey ||
                item.classKey === classKey
              )
            );
          }
        );
    }

    function flushAttendanceWriteQueue() {
      attendanceWriteTimer = null;

      if (
        attendanceWriteInFlight ||
        !attendanceWriteQueue.length
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var batch =
        attendanceWriteQueue.splice(
          0,
          attendanceWriteQueue.length
        );

      attendanceWriteInFlight = true;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(
          function(response) {
            attendanceWriteInFlight =
              false;

            var results =
              response &&
              Array.isArray(
                response.results
              )
                ? response.results
                : [];

            results.forEach(
              function(result) {
                if (
                  !result ||
                  !result.success
                ) {
                  return;
                }

                var key =
                  result.studentKey;

                var batchItem = null;

                for (
                  var batchIndex = 0;
                  batchIndex < batch.length;
                  batchIndex++
                ) {
                  if (
                    batch[batchIndex] &&
                    batch[batchIndex].key === key
                  ) {
                    batchItem =
                      batch[batchIndex];
                    break;
                  }
                }

                var resultClassKey =
                  batchItem &&
                  batchItem.classKey
                    ? batchItem.classKey
                    : attendanceRenderedClassKey;

                var cancelKey =
                  resultClassKey +
                  '||' +
                  key;

                // If the same student's tap was undone while the write was
                // in flight, cancel the event for that exact class.
                if (
                  attendanceCancelledBeforeSave[
                    cancelKey
                  ]
                ) {
                  delete attendanceCancelledBeforeSave[
                    cancelKey
                  ];

                  google.script.run
                    .withFailureHandler(
                      function() {}
                    )
                    .cancelAttendanceCheckIn(
                      result.eventId
                    );

                  return;
                }

                var targetStateMap =
                  attendanceStateCacheByClass[
                    resultClassKey
                  ] ||
                  (
                    resultClassKey ===
                    attendanceRenderedClassKey
                      ? attendanceStateByKey
                      : {}
                  );

                var state =
                  targetStateMap[
                    key
                  ];

                // The local UI is already correct. Just attach
                // the persisted event ID and canonical timestamps.
                if (
                  state &&
                  String(
                    state.status || ''
                  ).indexOf(
                    'Pending '
                  ) === 0
                ) {
                  state.eventId =
                    result.eventId;
                  state.status =
                    'Pending ' +
                    result.statusCandidate;
                  state.emoji =
                    result.emoji ||
                    state.emoji;
                  state.originalCheckInMillis =
                    result.originalCheckInMillis;
                  state.originalCheckInText =
                    result.originalCheckInText;
                  state.dueAtMillis =
                    result.dueAtMillis;
                  state.optimistic = false;
                }
              }
            );

            startAttendanceCountdownTimer();

            if (
              attendanceWriteQueue.length
            ) {
              attendanceWriteTimer =
                setTimeout(
                  flushAttendanceWriteQueue,
                  50
                );
            }
          }
        )
        .withFailureHandler(
          function() {
            attendanceWriteInFlight =
              false;

            // Put failed writes back at the front and retry.
            attendanceWriteQueue =
              batch.concat(
                attendanceWriteQueue
              );

            attendanceWriteTimer =
              setTimeout(
                flushAttendanceWriteQueue,
                1200
              );
          }
        )
        .batchBeginAttendanceCheckIns(
          batch.map(
            function(item) {
              return item.payload;
            }
          )
        );
    }

    function beginStudentAttendance(
      student,
      card
    ) {
      var key =
        attendanceStudentKey(student);

      attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[key] = true;

      clearStickyAttendanceOut(student);

      var immediateEmoji =
        getAttendanceAssignedEmoji(student);

      var tapMillis =
        Date.now();

      var requestId =
        makeAttendanceRequestId();

      // THE SCREEN CHANGES FIRST.
      // No server call happens before this visible toggle.
      attendanceStateByKey[key] = {
        studentKey: key,
        eventId: '',
        requestId: requestId,
        status: 'Pending Present',
        emoji: immediateEmoji,
        revealEmoji: false,
        originalCheckInMillis:
          tapMillis,
        originalCheckInText: '',
        dueAtMillis:
          tapMillis + 60000,
        optimistic: true
      };

      applyAttendanceStateToCard(
        student,
        card,
        attendanceStateByKey[key]
      );

      // Update the out-of-classroom rail immediately from local state.
      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }

      // Emoji Slot Machine mode keeps the existing reveal.
      // Solid Colors mode skips the emoji animation entirely.
      if (
        attendanceUsesSolidColors()
      ) {
        if (
          isBirthdayCheckInStudent(
            student
          )
        ) {
          primeBirthdaySound();

          setTimeout(function() {
            showBirthdayCheckInCelebration(
              student
            );
          }, 80);
        }
      } else {
        animateAttendanceEmojiReveal(
          card,
          student,
          immediateEmoji
        );
      }

      startAttendanceCountdownTimer();

      var payload =
        Object.assign(
          attendanceContextForStudent(
            student
          ),
          {
            preferredEmoji:
              immediateEmoji,
            clientTapMillis:
              tapMillis,
            clientRequestId:
              requestId
          }
        );

      // Saving is deliberately deferred and batched.
      enqueueAttendanceWrite(
        student,
        payload,
        requestId
      );
    }

    function cancelStudentAttendance(
      student
    ) {
      var key =
        attendanceStudentKey(student);

      attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[key] = true;

      var state =
        attendanceStateByKey[key];

      if (!state) return;

      var eventId =
        String(
          state.eventId || ''
        );

      // SCREEN FIRST: immediately restore absent appearance.
      delete attendanceStateByKey[key];

      clearStickyAttendanceOut(student);

      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }

      if (attendanceRenderedClassKey) {
        attendanceStateCacheByClass[
          attendanceRenderedClassKey
        ] = attendanceStateByKey;

        attendanceTouchedCacheByClass[
          attendanceRenderedClassKey
        ] = attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys;
      }

      renderAttendanceStates();

      if (!eventId) {
        // If it is still waiting in the local queue, remove it
        // so Apps Script never has to process it.
        var before =
          attendanceWriteQueue.length;

        removeQueuedAttendanceWrite(
          key,
          attendanceRenderedClassKey
        );

        // If it was already sent in an in-flight batch,
        // remember to cancel it as soon as its event ID returns.
        if (
          before ===
          attendanceWriteQueue.length
        ) {
          attendanceCancelledBeforeSave[
            attendanceRenderedClassKey +
            '||' +
            key
          ] = true;
        }

        return;
      }

      // Persist the undo in the background. Capture the class now so
      // switching classes while the request is running cannot reload the
      // wrong attendance panel.
      var undoClass = currentAttendanceGroup();

      google.script.run
        .withFailureHandler(
          function() {
            if (
              undoClass &&
              currentAttendanceGroup() &&
              String(undoClass.period || '') ===
                String(currentAttendanceGroup().period || '') &&
              String(undoClass.classTitle || undoClass.label || '') ===
                String(
                  currentAttendanceGroup().classTitle ||
                  currentAttendanceGroup().label ||
                  ''
                )
            ) {
              loadAttendanceForGroup(
                undoClass
              );
            }
          }
        )
        .cancelAttendanceCheckIn(
          eventId
        );
    }

    function handleAttendanceStudentTap(
      student,
      card
    ) {
      // HARD BOUNDARY: this function may only change attendance state.
      // It must never call selectStudent(), renderDestinationCards(),
      // showDestinationOnly(), or any hall-pass navigation function.
      if (
        !card ||
        !card.closest('#attendanceSidePanel')
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var key =
        attendanceStudentKey(student);

      var state =
        attendanceStateByKey[key];

      if (!state || state.status === 'Absent') {
        beginStudentAttendance(
          student,
          card
        );
        return;
      }

      if (state.status === 'Pending Departure') {
        cancelStudentEarlyDeparture(
          student,
          card,
          state
        );
        return;
      }

      if (
        String(state.status || '').indexOf(
          'Pending '
        ) === 0
      ) {
        cancelStudentAttendance(
          student
        );
        return;
      }

      if (
        state.status === 'Present' ||
        state.status === 'Tardy'
      ) {
        // Attendance is attendance only. A present/tardy student tapping
        // their attendance card starts the protected "mark absent" toggle.
        // Hall passes are started only from the normal checkout/student grid.
        markStudentEarlyDeparture(
          student,
          card,
          state
        );
      }
    }

    function renderStudentCards(group) {
      var grid = document.getElementById('studentGrid');
      grid.innerHTML = '';

      selectedClass = group;
      currentStep = "student";

      setStudentStage('Choose Your Name', '');

      showStudentStage();
      updateFlowNavigation();

      var selectedHeadingText =
        String(group.label || '')
          .replace(
            /(\d+(?:st|nd|rd|th))\s+Period\s+Period\b/i,
            '$1 Period'
          )
          .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
          .trim();

      document.getElementById(
        'selectedClassHeading'
      ).textContent = selectedHeadingText;

      grid.classList.remove(
        'attendance-grid-mode',
        'student-count-small',
        'student-count-medium',
        'student-count-large',
        'student-count-xlarge'
      );

      var studentCount =
        Array.isArray(group.students)
          ? group.students.length
          : 0;

      if (studentCount <= 10) {
        grid.classList.add('student-count-small');
      } else if (studentCount <= 18) {
        grid.classList.add('student-count-medium');
      } else if (studentCount <= 24) {
        grid.classList.add('student-count-large');
      } else {
        grid.classList.add('student-count-xlarge');
      }

      grid.setAttribute(
        'data-student-count',
        String(studentCount)
      );

      group.students.forEach(function(student, studentIndex) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className =
          'student-card' +
          (student.passRestricted ? ' pass-restricted' : '');
        button.setAttribute(
          'data-student-index',
          String(studentIndex)
        );
        if (student.passRestricted) {
          button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
          button.title = 'Escort only. See your teacher.';
        }

        button.innerHTML =
          photoHtml(student) +
          '<div class="student-card-name">' +
          escapeHtml(
            student.displayName ||
            student.firstName ||
            student.name
          ) +
          '</div>' +
          (
            student.passRestricted
              ? '<div class="student-id pass-restricted-tag">🚫 ESCORT ONLY</div>'
              : student.id
              ? '<div class="student-id">' +
                escapeHtml(student.id) +
                '</div>'
              : ''
          );
        button.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function() {
            selectStudent(student);
          }
        );

        grid.appendChild(button);
      });

      // Explicitly mark the incomplete final row.
      // This does not depend on :nth-child, so extra DOM elements cannot
      // throw off the placement math.
      grid.classList.remove(
        'student-last-row-1',
        'student-last-row-2',
        'student-last-row-3'
      );

      grid.querySelectorAll(
        '.student-final-row-card'
      ).forEach(function(card) {
        card.classList.remove(
          'student-final-row-card',
          'student-final-row-1',
          'student-final-row-2',
          'student-final-row-3'
        );
      });

      var lastRowCount =
        studentCount % 4;

      if (lastRowCount) {
        grid.classList.add(
          'student-last-row-' +
          lastRowCount
        );

        var renderedStudentCards =
          Array.prototype.slice.call(
            grid.querySelectorAll(
              '.student-card'
            )
          );

        renderedStudentCards
          .slice(-lastRowCount)
          .forEach(function(card, index) {
            card.classList.add(
              'student-final-row-card',
              'student-final-row-' +
              (index + 1)
            );
          });
      }

      document
        .getElementById('classChooser')
        .classList.add('hidden');

      document
        .getElementById('studentChooser')
        .classList.remove('hidden');

      requestAnimationFrame(
        fitStudentCardNames
      );

      if (attendanceSettings.enabled) {
        renderAttendanceSidePanel(group);
      }
    }




    document.getElementById('dayTypeSelect').addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {
        dayTypeOverride = this.value || "__AUTO__";
        scheduleManualOverride = dayTypeOverride === "__MANUAL__";
        lastAutomaticRosterKey = "";

        if (dayTypeOverride === "__MANUAL__") {
          selectedClass = null;
          selectedStudent = null;
          selectedDestination = "";
          renderClassCards();
        }

        refreshBellScheduleStatus();
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('chooseAnotherClassButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        scheduleManualOverride = true;
        selectedClass = null;
        selectedStudent = null;
        selectedDestination = '';
        renderClassCards();
        updateScheduleStatusBar(bellScheduleStatus);
      }
    );

    function populateGroupedDropdown() {
      var sel = document.getElementById('studentSelect');

      sel.innerHTML =
        '<option value="" disabled selected>Class &gt; Student Name</option>';

      studentRoster.forEach(function(group, groupIndex) {
        var optgroup = document.createElement('optgroup');
        optgroup.label = group.label;

        group.students.forEach(function(student, studentIndex) {
          var option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = groupIndex + "::" + studentIndex;
          option.textContent =
            (student.displayName || student.firstName || student.name) +
            (student.passRestricted
              ? " — ESCORT ONLY"
              : (student.id ? " — " + student.id : ""));
          if (student.passRestricted) {
            option.disabled = true;
          }
          optgroup.appendChild(option);
        });

        sel.appendChild(optgroup);
      });
    }

    document.getElementById('studentSelect').addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {
        var parts = this.value.split("::");
        var group = studentRoster[Number(parts[0])];
        var student = group && group.students[Number(parts[1])];

        if (student) {
          selectStudent(student);
        }
      }
    );

    function renderTieredClasses() {
      var list = document.getElementById('tierList');
      list.innerHTML = '';

      studentRoster.forEach(function(group) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'tier-row';
        button.innerHTML =
          '<span>' + escapeHtml(group.label) + '</span><span>›</span>';

        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          renderTieredStudents(group);
        });

        list.appendChild(button);
      });
    }

    function renderTieredStudents(group) {
      var list = document.getElementById('tierList');
      list.innerHTML = '';

      var back = document.createElement('button');
      back.type = 'button';
      back.className = 'tier-row';
      back.innerHTML =
        '<span>‹ ' + escapeHtml(group.label) + '</span><span></span>';

      back.addEventListener('click', renderTieredClasses);
      list.appendChild(back);

      group.students.forEach(function(student) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className =
          'tier-row' +
          (student.passRestricted ? ' pass-restricted' : '');
        button.innerHTML =
          '<span>' +
          escapeHtml(student.displayName || student.firstName || student.name) +
          (student.passRestricted
            ? ' <small>• 🚫 ESCORT ONLY</small>'
            : (student.id ? ' <small>• ' + escapeHtml(student.id) + '</small>' : '')) +
          '</span><span>' + (student.passRestricted ? '' : '›') + '</span>';

        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectStudent(student);
        });

        list.appendChild(button);
      });
    }

    function selectStudent(student) {
      // Pass restriction: escort only. The card cannot start a pass.
      if (student && student.passRestricted) {
        showPassRestrictedNotice(student);
        return;
      }

      selectedStudent = student;
      selectedDestination = "";
      currentStep = "destination";
      renderDestinationCards();

      document.getElementById('selectedStudentSummary').textContent =
        (student.displayName || student.firstName || student.name) +
        (student.id ? " • " + student.id : "");

      document.getElementById('checkoutButton').disabled = true;
      showDestinationOnly();
      updateFlowNavigation();
    }

    function showDestinationStage() {
      showDestinationOnly();
    }

    function hideDestinationStage() {
      document.body.classList.remove(
        'destination-screen-active'
      );

      document
        .getElementById('destinationStage')
        .classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function destinationIconAccent_(iconName) {
      var colors = [
        '#A9D7F2',
        '#F6C0D2',
        '#F5E27E',
        '#BDD99C',
        '#CBB7F2',
        '#F9C28E',
        '#A7E3DA',
        '#BFD8FF'
      ];

      var textValue = String(iconName || '');
      var hash = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < textValue.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + textValue.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
      }

      return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
    }

    /* All 240 destination icons, built into the page at kiosk size.
       Nothing has to be fetched, so they can never fail to load. */
    // Destination icons are loaded from the Artwork file only when shown
    // (getDestinationArtwork), then remembered on this device.
    var destinationArtworkInline = {};

    /* Earlier versions saved fetched icons in this browser; free that space. */
    (function() {
      try {
        var stale = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
          var storageKey = localStorage.key(i);

          if (storageKey && storageKey.indexOf('hallPassDestArt|') === 0) {
            stale.push(storageKey);
          }
        }

        stale.forEach(function(storageKey) {
          localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        });
      } catch (err) {}
    })();

    var destinationArtworkCache = {};
    var destinationArtworkPending = {};
    var destinationArtworkQueue = [];
    var destinationArtworkQueueTimer = null;
    var DESTINATION_ART_STORAGE_PREFIX = 'hallPassDestArt|v1|';
    var DESTINATION_ART_PLACEHOLDER =
      'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7';

    function destinationArtCacheKey(collection, key) {
      return collection + '||' + key;
    }

    function getCachedDestinationArt(collection, key) {
      var inlineBank = destinationArtworkInline[collection];

      if (inlineBank && inlineBank[key]) {
        return inlineBank[key];
      }

      var cacheKey = destinationArtCacheKey(collection, key);

      if (destinationArtworkCache[cacheKey]) {
        return destinationArtworkCache[cacheKey];
      }

      try {
        var stored = localStorage.getItem(
          DESTINATION_ART_STORAGE_PREFIX + cacheKey
        );

        if (stored) {
          destinationArtworkCache[cacheKey] = stored;
          return stored;
        }
      } catch (err) {}

      return '';
    }

    function applyLoadedDestinationArt(collection, key, dataUrl) {
      if (!dataUrl) return;

      var cacheKey = destinationArtCacheKey(collection, key);
      destinationArtworkCache[cacheKey] = dataUrl;

      try {
        localStorage.setItem(
          DESTINATION_ART_STORAGE_PREFIX + cacheKey,
          dataUrl
        );
      } catch (err) {}

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(
        document.querySelectorAll('img.destination-approved-icon[data-art-pending]'),
        function(img) {
          if (
            img.getAttribute('data-art-collection') === collection &&
            img.getAttribute('data-art-key') === key
          ) {
            img.src = dataUrl;
            img.removeAttribute('data-art-pending');
          }
        }
      );
    }

    function requestDestinationArt(collection, key) {
      var cacheKey = destinationArtCacheKey(collection, key);

      if (destinationArtworkPending[cacheKey]) return;

      destinationArtworkPending[cacheKey] = true;
      destinationArtworkQueue.push({ collection: collection, key: key });

      // Collect every icon needed by this render into ONE server call.
      if (!destinationArtworkQueueTimer) {
        destinationArtworkQueueTimer = setTimeout(flushDestinationArtQueue, 0);
      }
    }

    var destinationArtRetryCount = 0;
    var destinationArtRetryTimer = null;

    /* Any icon still showing its placeholder is asked for again, a few
       times with growing pauses, so one failed request never leaves the
       cards without pictures. */
    function retryMissingDestinationArt() {
      if (destinationArtRetryTimer) return;
      if (destinationArtRetryCount >= 4) return;

      var delay = [2000, 5000, 15000, 30000][destinationArtRetryCount];
      destinationArtRetryCount++;

      destinationArtRetryTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        destinationArtRetryTimer = null;

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(
          document.querySelectorAll(
            'img.destination-approved-icon[data-art-pending]'
          ),
          function(img) {
            requestDestinationArt(
              img.getAttribute('data-art-collection'),
              img.getAttribute('data-art-key')
            );
          }
        );
      }, delay);
    }

    function flushDestinationArtQueue() {
      destinationArtworkQueueTimer = null;

      var batch = destinationArtworkQueue;
      destinationArtworkQueue = [];

      if (!batch.length) return;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(found) {
          found = found || {};

          if (found.__error) {
            console.error('Destination icons problem: ' + found.__error);
          }

          var missing = 0;

          batch.forEach(function(item) {
            var cacheKey = destinationArtCacheKey(item.collection, item.key);
            delete destinationArtworkPending[cacheKey];

            if (found[cacheKey]) {
              applyLoadedDestinationArt(item.collection, item.key, found[cacheKey]);
            } else {
              missing++;
            }
          });

          if (missing) {
            retryMissingDestinationArt();
          } else {
            destinationArtRetryCount = 0;
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          console.error('Destination icons failed:', error);

          batch.forEach(function(item) {
            delete destinationArtworkPending[
              destinationArtCacheKey(item.collection, item.key)
            ];
          });

          retryMissingDestinationArt();
        })
        .getDestinationArtwork(batch);
    }
