    function destinationIconMarkup(item) {
      var rawIcon =
        String(
          item && item.icon || ''
        ).trim();

      var destination =
        String(
          item && item.destination || ''
        ).trim();

      var rawCollection =
        String(
          item && item.collection || 'Doodle'
        ).trim();

      var collectionAliases = {
        'doodle': 'Doodle',
        'line drawing': 'Line Drawing',
        'line drawings': 'Line Drawing',
        'outline': 'Line Drawing',
        'soft modern': 'Soft Modern'
      };

      var collection =
        collectionAliases[
          rawCollection.toLowerCase()
        ] || 'Doodle';

      var bankKeys =
        destinationArtworkKeys[
          collection
        ] || [];

      var profileBank =
        destinationIconProfiles[
          collection
        ] || {};

      function normalizeBankText(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .replace(/[–—]/g, '-')
          .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
          .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
          .trim();
      }

      function findBankKey(value) {
        var wanted =
          normalizeBankText(
            value
          );

        if (!wanted) return '';

        var keys =
          bankKeys.slice();

        for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
          if (
            normalizeBankText(keys[i]) ===
            wanted
          ) {
            return keys[i];
          }
        }

        var matches =
          keys.filter(function(key) {
            var normalizedKey =
              normalizeBankText(key);

            return (
              normalizedKey &&
              (
                wanted.indexOf(
                  normalizedKey
                ) !== -1 ||
                normalizedKey.indexOf(
                  wanted
                ) !== -1
              )
            );
          });

        matches.sort(function(a, b) {
          return b.length - a.length;
        });

        return matches[0] || '';
      }

      var iconKey =
        rawIcon
          ? findBankKey(rawIcon)
          : findBankKey(destination);

      if (!iconKey) {
        iconKey = 'Other';
      }

      if (bankKeys.indexOf(iconKey) === -1) {
        iconKey = 'Other';
      }

      if (bankKeys.indexOf(iconKey) === -1) return '';

      var art =
        getCachedDestinationArt(
          collection,
          iconKey
        );

      if (!art) {
        requestDestinationArt(
          collection,
          iconKey
        );
      }

      var profile =
        profileBank[iconKey] || {
          s: 1.2,
          x: 0,
          y: 0
        };

      return (
        '<span class="destination-icon-wrap icon-style-approved-raster"' +
          ' data-icon-key="' +
          escapeAttribute(iconKey) +
          '"' +
          ' style="' +
            '--bank-icon-scale:' +
            Number(profile.s || 1.2) +
            ';' +
            '--bank-icon-x:' +
            Number(profile.x || 0) +
            '%;' +
            '--bank-icon-y:' +
            Number(profile.y || 0) +
            '%;' +
          '">' +
          '<img class="destination-approved-icon"' +
          ' data-art-collection="' +
          escapeAttribute(collection) +
          '" data-art-key="' +
          escapeAttribute(iconKey) +
          '"' +
          (art ? '' : ' data-art-pending="1"') +
          ' src="' +
          (art || DESTINATION_ART_PLACEHOLDER) +
          '" alt="" aria-hidden="true">' +
        '</span>'
      );
    }



    function mixHexColors(a, b, amountOfB) {
      var rgbA = hexRgb(a);
      var rgbB = hexRgb(b);
      if (!rgbA || !rgbB) return a;

      var t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(amountOfB) || 0));

      function part(value) {
        return Math.round(value).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
      }

      return '#' +
        part(rgbA.r + (rgbB.r - rgbA.r) * t) +
        part(rgbA.g + (rgbB.g - rgbA.g) * t) +
        part(rgbA.b + (rgbB.b - rgbA.b) * t);
    }

    function shuffledCopy(values) {
      var copy = values.slice();

      for (var i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        var tmp = copy[i];
        copy[i] = copy[j];
        copy[j] = tmp;
      }

      return copy;
    }

    function scatterDestinationCardColors() {
      var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
      var palette = option && option.palette;

      if (!palette) return;

      var bases = [
        palette.highContrast,
        palette.strongContrast,
        palette.popColor,
        palette.softSupport,
        palette.lowContrast
      ].filter(isHexColor);

      if (bases.length < 3) return;

      var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(
        document.querySelectorAll('#destinationGrid .destination-card')
      );

      if (!cards.length) return;

      // Build actual visual rows from the browser layout so the rule continues
      // working when the number of columns changes on a different screen size.
      var rows = [];

      cards.forEach(function(card) {
        var rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        var row = rows.find(function(candidate) {
          return Math.abs(candidate.top - rect.top) < 8;
        });

        if (!row) {
          row = { top: rect.top, cards: [] };
          rows.push(row);
        }

        row.cards.push({
          el: card,
          left: rect.left,
          center: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
          width: rect.width
        });
      });

      rows.sort(function(a, b) {
        return a.top - b.top;
      });

      rows.forEach(function(row) {
        row.cards.sort(function(a, b) {
          return a.left - b.left;
        });
      });

      var assignments = [];
      var usage = bases.map(function() { return 0; });

      rows.forEach(function(row, rowIndex) {
        assignments[rowIndex] = [];

        row.cards.forEach(function(cardInfo, colIndex) {
          var forbidden = {};

          // Never repeat directly left/right.
          if (colIndex > 0) {
            forbidden[assignments[rowIndex][colIndex - 1]] = true;
          }

          // Never repeat directly above/below.
          if (rowIndex > 0) {
            var priorRow = rows[rowIndex - 1];
            var priorAssignments = assignments[rowIndex - 1];

            priorRow.cards.forEach(function(aboveInfo, aboveIndex) {
              var horizontalDistance = Math.abs(
                aboveInfo.center - cardInfo.center
              );

              if (
                horizontalDistance <
                Math.max(aboveInfo.width, cardInfo.width) * .45
              ) {
                forbidden[priorAssignments[aboveIndex]] = true;
              }
            });
          }

          var allowed = bases
            .map(function(_, index) { return index; })
            .filter(function(index) {
              return !forbidden[index];
            });

          // Favor the least-used available colors. This makes a 10-card
          // destination screen naturally use all five palette colors about
          // twice instead of clustering around two or three colors.
          var minUsage = Math.min.apply(
            null,
            allowed.map(function(index) {
              return usage[index];
            })
          );

          var balancedChoices = allowed.filter(function(index) {
            return usage[index] === minUsage;
          });

          var picked = shuffledCopy(balancedChoices)[0];

          assignments[rowIndex][colIndex] = picked;
          usage[picked] += 1;

          var base = bases[picked];

          // Preserve much more of the original palette color than the
          // previous pastel-heavy mix so the five cards look distinctly
          // different while still matching the active background.
          var lightAnchor = paletteLightText(palette);
          var darkAnchor = paletteDarkText(palette);
          var light1 = mixHexColors(base, lightAnchor, .48);
          var light2 = mixHexColors(base, lightAnchor, .28);
          var border = mixHexColors(base, darkAnchor, .22);
          var icon = mixHexColors(base, darkAnchor, .42);

          var cardBackground =
            'linear-gradient(155deg, ' +
            light1 + ' 0%, ' +
            light2 + ' 100%)';

          var selectedBright =
            mixHexColors(base, lightAnchor, .12);

          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty(
            '--destination-base',
            base
          );
          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty(
            '--destination-bg',
            cardBackground
          );
          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty(
            '--destination-border',
            border
          );
          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty(
            '--destination-selected-bright',
            selectedBright
          );
          cardInfo.el.style.boxShadow =
            '0 5px 14px color-mix(in srgb, ' +
            base + ' 28%, transparent)';

          // Choose destination label color from the ACTUAL tile fill.
          // Store it as a card variable so it wins over the global shuffled
          // text role and stays readable on cream/yellow as well as dark tiles.
          var readable = paletteTextColor(palette, light2);
          var textShadow =
            String(readable).toLowerCase() === String(paletteLightText(palette)).toLowerCase()
              ? '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.46)'
              : '0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.60)';

          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty('--destination-text', readable);
          cardInfo.el.style.setProperty('--destination-text-shadow', textShadow);

          var iconWrap = cardInfo.el.querySelector('.destination-emoji');
          if (iconWrap) {
            iconWrap.style.color = icon;
          }

          cardInfo.el
            .querySelectorAll(
              '.destination-icon-stroke, .destination-icon-fill'
            )
            .forEach(function(part) {
              if (part.classList.contains('destination-icon-stroke')) {
                part.style.stroke = icon;
              }

              if (part.classList.contains('destination-icon-fill')) {
                part.style.fill = 'none';
              }
            });
        });
      });
    }

    function splitDestinationLabel(label) {
      var words = String(label || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      var full = words.join(' ');

      if (!words.length) {
        return { top: '', bottom: '' };
      }

      // Short destination names stay together beneath the icon. Longer names
      // use the icon as a divider so both pieces can remain much larger.
      // This also catches long two-word labels such as “Main Office.”
      var shouldSplit = words.length >= 3 || (words.length === 2 && full.length > 10);

      if (!shouldSplit) {
        return { top: '', bottom: full };
      }

      var bestIndex = 1;
      var bestScore = Infinity;

      for (var i = 1; i < words.length; i++) {
        var top = words.slice(0, i).join(' ');
        var bottom = words.slice(i).join(' ');

        // Balance the two lines, but slightly prefer a shorter top label so
        // the icon visually anchors the middle of the card.
        var score = Math.abs(top.length - bottom.length) +
          (top.length > bottom.length ? 1.5 : 0);

        if (score < bestScore) {
          bestScore = score;
          bestIndex = i;
        }
      }

      return {
        top: words.slice(0, bestIndex).join(' '),
        bottom: words.slice(bestIndex).join(' ')
      };
    }

    function renderDestinationCards() {
      var grid = document.getElementById('destinationGrid');
      grid.innerHTML = '';

      destinations.forEach(function(item) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'destination-card';

        button.setAttribute(
          'data-destination',
          String(item.destination || '')
        );

        button.classList.remove(
          'destination-has-top-label'
        );

        button.innerHTML =
          '<span class="destination-emoji">' +
          destinationIconMarkup(item) +
          '</span>' +
          '<div class="destination-name destination-name-bottom destination-name-full-editable">' +
          escapeHtml(
            item.destination || ''
          ) +
          '</div>';

        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectedDestination = item.destination;

          Array.prototype.forEach.call(
            grid.querySelectorAll('.destination-card'),
            function(card) {
              card.classList.remove('selected');
            }
          );

          button.classList.add('selected');
          document.getElementById('checkoutButton').disabled = false;
        });

        grid.appendChild(button);
      });

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        scatterDestinationCardColors();
        fitDestinationCardTypography();

        if (
          typeof window.fitDestinationCardsFilled ===
            'function'
        ) {
          window.fitDestinationCardsFilled();
        }
      });
    }


    function restoreAutomaticCurrentClassFromLocalSchedule() {
      if (
        kioskSettings.classSelectionMode !== 'Bell Schedule' ||
        dayTypeOverride === '__MANUAL__' ||
        scheduleManualOverride ||
        !bellScheduleStatus ||
        !bellScheduleStatus.schoolDay ||
        !bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      var group =
        findRosterGroupForSchedulePeriod(
          bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod
        );

      if (!group) {
        return false;
      }

      selectedClass = group;
      currentStep = 'student';
      showStudentStage();
      renderStudentCards(group);
      updateFlowNavigation();

      return true;
    }


    function resetStudentFlow(restoreMenu) {
      selectedStudent = null;
      selectedDestination = "";
      selectedClass = null;
      currentStep = "class";

      hideDestinationStage();
      showStudentStage();
      document.getElementById('checkoutButton').disabled = true;

      var grouped = document.getElementById('studentSelect');
      if (grouped) grouped.selectedIndex = 0;

      if (restoreMenu !== false) {
        if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle === "Student Cards") {
          // In Bell Schedule mode, use the current schedule already in memory
          // immediately. Do not make students choose a class while waiting for
          // the next server refresh.
          if (!restoreAutomaticCurrentClassFromLocalSchedule()) {
            renderClassCards();
          }
        } else if (kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle === "Tiered Menu") {
          renderTieredClasses();
        }
      }

      updateFlowNavigation();
    }

    document.getElementById('checkoutButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        if (!selectedStudent || !selectedDestination) {
          return;
        }

        kioskBeforeLeaving(
          selectedStudent,
          selectedDestination,
          kioskFinishCheckout
        );
      }
    );

    /* ===== Before a student leaves =====
       1. Counselor, AP Office (Destinations tab, column G = Yes): "Did you get
          a pass?" Delivered passes don't count toward weekly minutes.
       2. More than 6 minutes out this week, from 5 minutes after class
          starts to 5 minutes before it ends: a short reminder that being in
          class matters. They can still go. */
    function kioskClockMinutes(text) {
      var m = String(text || '').trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*([AaPp])?[Mm]?$/);
      if (!m) return null;
      var h = Number(m[1]);
      if (m[3]) {
        var pm = m[3].toLowerCase() === 'p';
        if (h === 12) h = pm ? 12 : 0; else if (pm) h += 12;
      }
      return h * 60 + Number(m[2]);
    }

    function kioskInReminderWindow() {
      var status = bellScheduleStatus || {};
      var start = kioskClockMinutes(status.lateBell);
      var end = kioskClockMinutes(status.classEnds);
      if (start == null || end == null) return false;
      var d = new Date();
      var now = d.getHours() * 60 + d.getMinutes();
      var grace = Number(kioskReminderSettings.graceMinutes);
      if (!isFinite(grace)) grace = 5;
      return now >= start + grace && now <= end - 5;
    }

    function kioskAsk(title, text, buttons, tone, artHtml) {
      var box = document.getElementById('kioskAskBox');
      if (!box) {
        box = document.createElement('div');
        box.id = 'kioskAskBox';
        box.innerHTML =
          '<div class="kask-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">' +
          '<div class="kask-art"></div><h2 class="kask-title"></h2><p class="kask-text"></p><div class="kask-buttons"></div></div>';
        document.body.appendChild(box);
        ['click', 'pointerdown', 'touchstart', 'mousedown'].forEach(function(type) {
          box.addEventListener(type, function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
        });
      }
      box.classList.toggle('red', tone === 'red');
      box.classList.remove('names');
      box.classList.toggle('wide', /kseat-frame/.test(artHtml || ''));
      var art = box.querySelector('.kask-art');
      if (art) { art.innerHTML = artHtml || ''; art.hidden = !artHtml; }
      box.querySelector('.kask-title').textContent = title;
      box.querySelector('.kask-text').textContent = text;
      var row = box.querySelector('.kask-buttons');
      row.innerHTML = '';
      buttons.forEach(function(b) {
        var el = document.createElement('button');
        el.type = 'button';
        el.className = b.primary ? 'kask-primary' : 'kask-secondary';
        el.textContent = b.label;
        el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          box.classList.remove('open');
          b.run();
        });
        row.appendChild(el);
      });
      box.classList.add('open');
    }

    var kioskTeacherPinSet = false;

    function kioskSetPinStatus(isSet) {
      kioskTeacherPinSet = !!isSet;
      var wrap = document.getElementById('teacherPinCurrentWrap');
      var status = document.getElementById('teacherPinStatus');
      if (wrap) wrap.hidden = !kioskTeacherPinSet;
      var off = document.getElementById('removeTeacherPinButton');
      if (off) off.hidden = !kioskTeacherPinSet;
      if (status) {
        status.textContent = kioskTeacherPinSet
          ? 'A teacher PIN is set. Students over the weekly limit need it to leave for an optional trip (water, locker, library...). To change it, enter the current PIN and a new one. To stop using it, enter the current PIN and press Turn off PIN.'
          : 'Optional. With no PIN, students over the weekly limit see the reminder and can still leave on their own. Set a PIN of 4 to 8 numbers if you want them to need your OK for optional trips (water, locker, library...).';
      }
    }

    (function() {
      var button = document.getElementById('saveTeacherPinButton');
      if (!button) return;
      button.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var message = document.getElementById('teacherPinMessage');
        var newPin = document.getElementById('teacherPinNew').value.trim();
        var current = document.getElementById('teacherPinCurrent').value.trim();
        message.textContent = 'Saving…';
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
            message.textContent = result && result.message || '';
            message.style.color = result && result.success ? '#20733b' : '#990000';
            if (result && result.success) {
              document.getElementById('teacherPinNew').value = '';
              document.getElementById('teacherPinCurrent').value = '';
              kioskSetPinStatus(true);
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            message.textContent = error && error.message || 'Could not save the PIN.';
            message.style.color = '#990000';
          })
          .setTeacherPin(newPin, current);
      });

      var off = document.getElementById('removeTeacherPinButton');
      if (off) off.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var message = document.getElementById('teacherPinMessage');
        message.textContent = 'Turning off…';
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
            message.textContent = result && result.message || '';
            message.style.color = result && result.success ? '#20733b' : '#990000';
            if (result && result.success) {
              document.getElementById('teacherPinCurrent').value = '';
              kioskSetPinStatus(false);
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            message.textContent = error && error.message || 'Could not turn off the PIN.';
            message.style.color = '#990000';
          })
          .removeTeacherPin(document.getElementById('teacherPinCurrent').value.trim());
      });
    })();

    // Number pad for the teacher PIN. ok() runs after the server accepts it.
    function kioskPinPad(ok, cancel) {
      var box = document.getElementById('kioskPinPad');
      if (!box) {
        box = document.createElement('div');
        box.id = 'kioskPinPad';
        var keys = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', 'Clear', '0', 'OK'];
        box.innerHTML = '<div class="kpin-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">' +
          '<h2>🔒 Teacher PIN</h2><div class="kpin-dots" aria-live="polite"></div>' +
          '<p class="kpin-msg"></p><div class="kpin-keys">' +
          keys.map(function(k) { return '<button type="button" data-key="' + k + '">' + k + '</button>'; }).join('') +
          '</div><button type="button" class="kpin-cancel">Cancel</button></div>';
        document.body.appendChild(box);
        ['click', 'pointerdown', 'touchstart', 'mousedown'].forEach(function(type) {
          box.addEventListener(type, function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
        });
      }
      var digits = '';
      var dots = box.querySelector('.kpin-dots');
      var msg = box.querySelector('.kpin-msg');
      function show() { dots.textContent = digits ? digits.replace(/./g, '●') : '—'; }
      function close() { box.classList.remove('open'); }
      msg.textContent = '';
      show();
      box.querySelectorAll('[data-key]').forEach(function(b) {
        b.onclick = function() {
          var k = b.getAttribute('data-key');
          if (k === 'Clear') { digits = ''; msg.textContent = ''; show(); return; }
          if (k !== 'OK') { if (digits.length < 8) digits += k; show(); return; }
          if (!digits) return;
          msg.textContent = 'Checking…';
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
              if (result && result.ok) { close(); ok(); return; }
              digits = ''; show();
              msg.textContent = result && result.message || 'That PIN is not right.';
            })
            .withFailureHandler(function() { msg.textContent = 'Could not check the PIN. Try again.'; })
            .verifyTeacherPin(digits);
        };
      });
      box.querySelector('.kpin-cancel').onclick = function() { close(); if (cancel) cancel(); };
      box.classList.add('open');
    }

    // Has this student checked in for the class they picked? (true when
    // attendance is off or this kiosk doesn't know that class's check-ins)
    function kioskHasCheckedIn(student) {
      if (!attendanceSettings || attendanceSettings.enabled === false || !selectedClass) return true;
      var classKey = kioskClassKey(selectedClass);
      var states = classKey === attendanceRenderedClassKey
        ? attendanceStateByKey
        : attendanceStateCacheByClass[classKey];
      if (!states) return true;
      var state = states[attendanceStudentKey(student)];
      return !!(state && String(state.status || '') !== 'Cancelled');
    }

    /* ===== Seating charts (built in the teacher view's Seating page) =====
       "Where do I sit?" shows a student their desk; "Pass the pass" shows
       where the next person sits. Only for classes that have a chart. */
    var kioskSeating = { link: '', classes: [] };

    function kioskSetSeating(v) {
      if (v && Array.isArray(v.classes)) kioskSeating = v;
      kioskUpdateWhereSit();
    }

    function kioskClassHasChart(label) {
      return !!label && !!kioskSeating.link && kioskSeating.classes.indexOf(label) !== -1;
    }

    function kioskSeatFrame(label, key, height) {
      var src = kioskSeating.link + '?view=seat&cls=' + encodeURIComponent(label) + '&key=' + encodeURIComponent(key);
      return '<iframe class="kseat-frame" title="Seating chart" src="' + src.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') +
        '" style="height:' + (height || 330) + 'px"></iframe>';
    }

    function kioskUpdateWhereSit() {
      var b = document.getElementById('whereSitButton');
      if (b) b.hidden = !(selectedClass && kioskClassHasChart(selectedClass.label));
    }
    setInterval(kioskUpdateWhereSit, 1000);

    (function() {
      var b = document.getElementById('whereSitButton');
      if (!b) return;
      b.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (!selectedClass) return;
        var cls = selectedClass;
        var names = (cls.students || []).slice().sort(function(a, x) {
          return String(a.displayName || a.firstName).localeCompare(String(x.displayName || x.firstName));
        });
        kioskAsk('🪑 Where do I sit?', 'Tap your name.', names.map(function(st) {
          return { label: st.displayName || st.firstName, run: function() {
            kioskAsk('🪑 ' + (st.firstName || st.displayName) + ', here\'s your seat',
              'Look for your name with the pink outline.',
              [{ label: '👍 Got it', primary: true, run: function() {} }],
              '', kioskSeatFrame(cls.label, attendanceStudentKey(st), 420));
          } };
        }).concat([{ label: 'Cancel', run: function() {} }]));
        var box = document.getElementById('kioskAskBox');
        if (box) box.classList.add('names');
      });
    })();

    // The room's hall pass: a yellow lanyard with a blank white portrait card.

        '<path d="M22 4 L50 70 L78 4" fill="none" stroke="#f5c400" stroke-width="11" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
        '<path d="M22 4 L50 70 L78 4" fill="none" stroke="#ffde3d" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
        '<rect x="44" y="64" width="12" height="14" rx="3" fill="#9aa3ad"/>' +
        '<rect x="22" y="76" width="56" height="70" rx="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#8a94a0" stroke-width="2.5"/>' +
        '<rect x="42" y="82" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c7cdd4"/>' +
        '</svg>';
    }

    /* ===== Waiting line for the room's hall passes (Settings: "Hall
       passes in your room"; 0 = no limit) ===== */
    var kioskPassQueue = [];

    function kioskSetQueue(list) {
      kioskPassQueue = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
      var bar = document.getElementById('kioskQueueBar');
      if (!bar) return;
      bar.hidden = !kioskPassQueue.length;
      bar.textContent = kioskPassQueue.length
        ? '🙋 Next in line: ' + kioskPassQueue.map(function(e) { return e.displayName || e.name; }).join(', ')
        : '';
    }

    function kioskHallPassesOut() {
      return (activePasses || []).filter(function(p) {
        return p && (p.row != null || p.pending) && !p.delivered && !p.earlyDeparture;
      }).length;
    }

    // Lets the student go (next) when a pass is free and nobody is ahead of
    // them; otherwise puts them in line and tells them their place.
    function kioskLineCheck(student, first, next) {
      var limit = Number(kioskReminderSettings.passCount);
      if (!isFinite(limit)) limit = 2;
      if (!limit) { next(); return; }

      var key = attendanceStudentKey(student);
      var line = kioskPassQueue || [];
      var pos = -1;
      line.forEach(function(e, i) { if (pos === -1 && e.key === key) pos = i; });
      var full = kioskHallPassesOut() >= limit;
      if (!full && (!line.length || pos === 0)) { next(); return; }

      var fullName = String(student.fullName || student.name || '').trim();
      var place = pos === -1 ? line.length + 1 : pos + 1;
      if (pos === -1) {
        kioskSetQueue(line.concat([{ key: key, name: fullName, displayName: first, at: new Date().toISOString() }]));
        google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(kioskSetQueue)
          .joinPassQueue({ studentId: String(student.id || ''), studentName: fullName, displayName: first,
            classLabel: selectedClass ? String(selectedClass.label || '') : '' });
      }

      var ahead = line[0] && line[0].key !== key ? String(line[0].displayName || line[0].name) : '';
      kioskAsk(
        full
          ? (limit === 2 ? 'Both passes are out' : 'All ' + limit + ' passes are out')
          : ahead + ' is next in line',
        'You\'re #' + place + ' in line 🙋 When a pass comes back, the person returning will hand it to you. ' +
        'Then tap your name and leave as usual.',
        [
          { label: '👍 OK', primary: true, run: function() { resetStudentFlow(true); } },
          { label: 'Leave the line', run: function() {
              kioskSetQueue((kioskPassQueue || []).filter(function(e) { return e.key !== key; }));
              google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(kioskSetQueue)
                .leavePassQueue({ studentId: String(student.id || ''), studentName: fullName });
              resetStudentFlow(true);
            } }
        ],
        '',
        full ? kioskPassArt(110, true) + kioskPassArt(110, true) : kioskPassArt(110)
      );
    }

    // The reminder wording: the teacher's own (Settings > Attendance > Reminder wording) or this standard wording.
    var KIOSK_REMINDER_WORDING = {
      weekTitle: 'Hi {name} — quick check-in 💙',
      weekText: 'You\'ve left class {trips} times this week (about {minutes} minutes). Every minute here counts: ' +
        'explanations, practice, and time with your classmates add up fast. If it can wait, please stay. ' +
        'If you really need to go, that\'s okay.',
      redTitle: '⚠️ {name}, this is becoming a pattern',
      redText: 'You\'ve left class {trips2weeks} times in the last 2 weeks. That\'s a lot of missed time. ' +
        'If you need time for personal business, please spread it out across different classes instead of ' +
        'always taking it from this one.\n\nIf something is going on and causing this, let\'s talk about it please!'
    };
    function kioskReminderText(key, fill) {
      var text = String((kioskReminderSettings || {})[key] || '').trim() || KIOSK_REMINDER_WORDING[key];
      return text.replace(/\{(name|trips|minutes|trips2weeks|place)\}/g, function(m, k) { return fill[k] != null ? fill[k] : m; })
        .replace(/1 times/g, '1 time');
    }

    function kioskBeforeLeaving(student, destinationName, done) {
      var dest = (destinations || []).filter(function(d) {
        return d && d.destination === destinationName;
      })[0];
      var first = String(student.displayName || student.firstName || student.name || '').trim();

      function remind() {
        var stats = kioskWeekMinutes.students || {};
        var full = String(student.fullName || student.name || '').trim();
        var byId = student.id ? stats['ID:' + String(student.id).trim()] : null;
        var byName = stats['NAME:' + full.toLowerCase()];
        var minutes = (byId ? byId.minutes : 0) + (byName ? byName.minutes : 0);
        var trips = (byId ? byId.trips : 0) + (byName ? byName.trips : 0);
        var lastWeekOver = !!((byId && byId.lastWeekOver) || (byName && byName.lastWeekOver));
        var twoWeekTrips = (byId ? byId.twoWeekTrips || 0 : 0) + (byName ? byName.twoWeekTrips || 0 : 0);
        var settings = kioskReminderSettings;
        var over = minutes > Number(settings.minutes || 6) || trips >= Number(settings.trips || 3);
        var classOff = (settings.offClasses || []).indexOf(kioskClassKey(selectedClass)) !== -1;

        if (!over || classOff || !kioskInReminderWindow()) {
          done(false);
          return;
        }

        var needsPin = !!(dest && dest.optional) && kioskTeacherPinSet;
        var leaveButton = needsPin
          ? { label: '🔒 My teacher said yes', run: function() {
              kioskPinPad(function() { done('teacher'); }, function() { resetStudentFlow(true); });
            } }
          : { label: 'I still need to go', run: function() { done(false); } };
        var stayButton = { label: '👍 I\'ll stay in class', primary: true, run: function() { resetStudentFlow(true); } };
        var pinLine = needsPin ? ' To leave for ' + destinationName + ' now, ask your teacher.' : '';
        var fill = { name: first, trips: trips, minutes: Math.round(minutes), trips2weeks: twoWeekTrips, place: destinationName };

        // Over the limit this week AND last week: the red "pattern" warning
        // (the teacher's own wording).
        if (lastWeekOver) {
          // Emails the student (only if turned on in Settings; once a week).
          try {
            google.script.run.withFailureHandler(function() {})
              .notifyRedWarning({ studentId: String(student.id || ''), studentName: full, classKey: kioskClassKey(selectedClass) });
          } catch (mailErr) {}

          kioskAsk(
            kioskReminderText('redTitle', fill),
            kioskReminderText('redText', fill) + (pinLine ? '\n\n' + pinLine.trim() : ''),
            [stayButton, leaveButton],
            'red'
          );
          return;
        }

        var weekText = kioskReminderText('weekText', fill);
        if (needsPin) weekText = weekText.replace(/\s*If you really need to go, that's okay\.\s*$/, '') + pinLine;
        kioskAsk(kioskReminderText('weekTitle', fill), weekText, [stayButton, leaveButton]);
      }

      // Not checked in for this class yet: that comes first.
      if (!kioskHasCheckedIn(student)) {
        kioskAsk(
          'How can you leave for the ' + destinationName + ' if you\'re not even here yet? 😄',
          'You forgot to check in. Tap your name in Attendance first, then come back.',
          [{ label: '👍 OK, I\'ll check in', primary: true, run: function() { resetStudentFlow(true); } }]
        );
        return;
      }

      if (dest && dest.askPass) {
        kioskAsk(
          'Did you get a pass?',
          'Was a pass delivered to you to go to ' + destinationName + '?',
          [
            { label: '🎟️ Yes, I got a pass', primary: true, run: function() { done(true); } },
            { label: 'No', run: function() { kioskLineCheck(student, first, remind); } }
          ]
        );
        return;
      }

      kioskLineCheck(student, first, remind);
    }

    // calledByPass: the student said a pass was delivered to them.
    function kioskFinishCheckout(calledByPass) {
        if (!selectedStudent || !selectedDestination) {
          return;
        }

        var now = new Date();

        activePasses.push({
          name: selectedStudent.fullName || selectedStudent.name,
          displayName: selectedStudent.displayName || selectedStudent.firstName || selectedStudent.name,
          destination: selectedDestination,
          timeOut: now.toLocaleTimeString([], {
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit'
          }),
          timeOutMs: now.getTime(),
          row: null,
          pending: true,
          delivered: calledByPass === true
        });

        renderActivePasses();

        var checkoutName =
          selectedStudent.displayName ||
          selectedStudent.firstName ||
          selectedStudent.name;

        var checkoutFullName =
          selectedStudent.fullName ||
          selectedStudent.name ||
          checkoutName;

        var checkoutDestination = selectedDestination;

        // Leaving takes this student out of the waiting line right away.
        var leavingKey = attendanceStudentKey(selectedStudent);
        kioskSetQueue((kioskPassQueue || []).filter(function(e) { return e.key !== leavingKey; }));
        var checkoutClassKey = kioskClassKey(selectedClass);
        var checkoutStudentId = String(selectedStudent.id || '');

        resetStudentFlow(true);

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(serverPasses) {
            var serverActive =
              filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(serverPasses || []);

            var localEarlyDepartures =
              (activePasses || []).filter(function(pass) {
                return pass && pass.earlyDeparture;
              });

            localEarlyDepartures.forEach(function(localPass) {
              var alreadyOnServer =
                serverActive.some(function(serverPass) {
                  return (
                    serverPass &&
                    namesMatchForCheckout(
                      serverPass.name,
                      localPass.name
                    )
                  );
                });

              if (!alreadyOnServer) {
                serverActive.push(localPass);
              }
            });

            activePasses = serverActive;
            renderActivePasses();
          })
          .checkOut(
            checkoutName,
            checkoutDestination,
            checkoutFullName,
            calledByPass || false,
            checkoutClassKey,
            checkoutStudentId
          );
    }

    function getElapsedSeconds(pass) {
      var start = Number(pass.timeOutMs);
      if (!isFinite(start)) return 0;

      return Math.max(
        0,
        Math.floor((Date.now() - start) / 1000)
      );
    }

    function getStatusClass(elapsedSeconds) {
      var greenLimit =
        Number(kioskSettings.greenThroughMinutes || 5) * 60;

      var yellowLimit =
        Number(kioskSettings.yellowThroughMinutes || 8) * 60;

      if (elapsedSeconds <= greenLimit) return 'status-green';
      if (elapsedSeconds <= yellowLimit) return 'status-yellow';
      return 'status-red';
    }

    function formatLiveElapsed(totalSeconds) {
      totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));

      var hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
      var minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
      var seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

      if (hours > 0) {
        return hours + ':' +
          String(minutes).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
          String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
      }

      return minutes + ':' +
        String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    function renderActivePasses() {
      var container = document.getElementById('activeContainer');
      container.innerHTML = '';

      if (!activePasses || activePasses.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML =
          '<p class="muted">Everyone is currently in class.</p>';
        return;
      }

      activePasses.forEach(function(pass, index) {
        var elapsed = getElapsedSeconds(pass);
        var statusClass = getStatusClass(elapsed);

        var item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'active-item ' + statusClass;
        item.setAttribute('data-pass-index', index);

        item.innerHTML =
          '<div class="active-info">' +
            '<div><span class="student-name">' +
            escapeHtml(pass.displayName || pass.name) +
            '</span><span class="destination-text"> — ' +
            escapeHtml(pass.destination) +
            '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="timing-line">' +
              '<span class="live-timer" data-pass-index="' + index + '">' +
              formatLiveElapsed(elapsed) +
              '</span>' +
              '<span class="active-time">Left at ' +
              escapeHtml(pass.timeOut) +
              '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          (
            pass.pending
              ? '<button class="checkin-button" disabled style="opacity:.55;">Syncing...</button>'
              : '<button class="checkin-button" onclick="handleCheckIn(' + index + ')">I’M BACK!</button>'
          );

        container.appendChild(item);
      });

      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();
    }

    function updateLiveTimers() {
      activePasses.forEach(function(pass, index) {
        var row = document.querySelector(
          '.active-item[data-pass-index="' + index + '"]'
        );

        var timer = document.querySelector(
          '.live-timer[data-pass-index="' + index + '"]'
        );

        if (!row || !timer) return;

        var elapsed = getElapsedSeconds(pass);
        var statusClass = getStatusClass(elapsed);

        timer.textContent = formatLiveElapsed(elapsed);

        row.classList.remove(
          'status-green',
          'status-yellow',
          'status-red'
        );
        row.classList.add(statusClass);
      });

      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();
    }

    var recentlyReturnedPassRows = {};

    function filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(passes) {
      var now = Date.now();

      Object.keys(recentlyReturnedPassRows)
        .forEach(function(key) {
          if (
            Number(recentlyReturnedPassRows[key] || 0) <= now
          ) {
            delete recentlyReturnedPassRows[key];
          }
        });

      return (passes || []).filter(function(pass) {
        var rowKey = String(
          pass && pass.row != null
            ? pass.row
            : ''
        );

        return !(
          rowKey &&
          recentlyReturnedPassRows[rowKey] &&
          recentlyReturnedPassRows[rowKey] > now
        );
      });
    }

    /* Coming back: before checking in, a big reminder to put the hall pass
       back, or, when someone is waiting, to hand it to the next person in
       line. Delivered passes (Counselor, AP...) skip it. */
    function handleCheckIn(index) {
      var item = activePasses[index];
      if (!item || item.pending) return;
      if (!item.row || item.delivered || item.earlyDeparture) {
        kioskCompleteCheckIn(index);
        return;
      }

      var row = item.row;
      var first = String(item.displayName || item.name || '').trim();
      // The next person waiting: never the returning student or someone already out.
      var outNames = {};
      (activePasses || []).forEach(function(p) { if (p) outNames[String(p.name || '').toLowerCase()] = true; });
      var nextUp = (kioskPassQueue || []).filter(function(e) {
        return !outNames[String(e.name || '').toLowerCase()];
      })[0];
      function complete() {
        for (var i = 0; i < activePasses.length; i++) {
          if (activePasses[i] && activePasses[i].row === row) { kioskCompleteCheckIn(i); return; }
        }
      }
      var notYet = { label: 'Oops, not back yet', run: function() {} };

      if (nextUp) {
        var nextName = String(nextUp.displayName || nextUp.name || 'the next person');
        var seatClass = nextUp.classLabel || (selectedClass && selectedClass.label) || '';
        var showSeat = kioskClassHasChart(seatClass);
        kioskAsk(
          '👉 Pass the pass to ' + nextName,
          'Welcome back, ' + first + '! ' + nextName + ' is next in line' +
            (showSeat ? ' (their desk is outlined in pink)' : '') + '. Hand them the yellow lanyard, then tap below.',
          [{ label: '✅ I passed the pass to ' + nextName, primary: true, run: complete }],
          '', showSeat ? kioskSeatFrame(seatClass, nextUp.key, 330) : kioskPassArt(150)
        );
      } else {
        kioskAsk(
          'Put the pass back!',
          'Welcome back, ' + first + '! Hang the yellow lanyard back where it belongs, then tap below.',
          [{ label: '✅ I put the pass back', primary: true, run: complete }, notYet],
          '', kioskPassArt(150)
        );
      }
    }

    function kioskCompleteCheckIn(index) {
      var item = activePasses[index];

      if (!item || item.pending) {
        return;
      }

      var rowNumber = item.row;
      var rowKey = String(
        rowNumber != null ? rowNumber : ''
      );

      if (rowKey) {
        recentlyReturnedPassRows[rowKey] =
          Date.now() + 15000;
      }

      activePasses.splice(index, 1);
      renderActivePasses();

      if (!rowNumber) {
        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(serverPasses) {
          activePasses =
            filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(
              serverPasses || []
            );

          renderActivePasses();

          setTimeout(function() {
            delete recentlyReturnedPassRows[rowKey];
          }, 5000);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          delete recentlyReturnedPassRows[rowKey];

          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(function(serverPasses) {
              activePasses =
                filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(
                  serverPasses || []
                );
              renderActivePasses();
            })
            .getActivePasses();
        })
        .checkIn(rowNumber);
    }


    function getCurrentBackgroundOption() {
      return getBackgroundOptionByName(kioskSettings.backgroundName);
    }


    function lockAccentLook() {
      var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
      var button = document.getElementById('lockAccentButton');

      if (!option || !option.palette) {
        return;
      }

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'SAVING…';
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
          option.accentLayout = Number(result.accentLayout || 0);
          option.accentAdvanced = "";
          currentAccentLayoutIndex = option.accentLayout;
          currentAdvancedAccentMap = null;

          if (button) {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.classList.add('locked');
            button.textContent = '✓ LOOK LOCKED';

            setTimeout(function() {
              button.textContent = '🔒 LOCK LOOK';
            }, 1400);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          if (button) {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.classList.remove('locked');
            button.textContent = 'LOCK FAILED';
            setTimeout(function() {
              button.textContent = '🔒 LOCK LOOK';
            }, 1600);
          }
        })
        .saveAccentLayout(
          option.name,
          currentAccentLayoutIndex
        );
    }
