    var ADVANCED_ACCENT_ROLES = [
      ['titleOutline', 'Title outline / stroke'],
      ['titleBox', 'Title backing box'],
      ['panelFill', 'Large class / destination panel fill'],
      ['panelBorder', 'Large panel border / edge'],
      ['cardFill', 'Class / student / destination card fill'],
      ['cardBorder', 'Card borders'],
      ['iconAccent', 'Icons / selected outlines / avatars'],
      ['primaryButton', 'Primary action buttons'],
      ['navControls', 'Back / Restart / Settings controls']
    ];

    function renderAdvancedAccentGrid(palette, roleMap) {
      var grid = document.getElementById('advancedAccentGrid');
      if (!grid || !palette) return;

      grid.innerHTML = '';

      var slots = [
        ['high', 'High Contrast'],
        ['strong', 'Strong Contrast'],
        ['pop', 'Pop Color'],
        ['soft', 'Soft Support'],
        ['low', 'Low Contrast']
      ];

      ADVANCED_ACCENT_ROLES.forEach(function(pair) {
        var role = pair[0];
        var labelText = pair[1];

        var label = document.createElement('label');
        label.textContent = labelText;

        var select = document.createElement('select');
        select.setAttribute('data-accent-role', role);

        slots.forEach(function(slotPair) {
          var option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = slotPair[0];
          option.textContent = slotPair[1] + ' • ' +
            paletteSlotColor(palette, slotPair[0]);
          select.appendChild(option);
        });

        select.value = roleMap[role] || 'high';

        select.addEventListener('change', function() {
          var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
          if (!option || !option.palette) return;

          currentAdvancedAccentMap =
            currentAdvancedAccentMap ||
            defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(currentAccentLayoutIndex);

          currentAdvancedAccentMap[role] = this.value;

          applyPaletteTheme(
            option.palette,
            currentAccentLayoutIndex,
            currentAdvancedAccentMap
          );
        });

        grid.appendChild(label);
        grid.appendChild(select);
      });
    }

    function collectAdvancedAccentMap() {
      var map = {};

      document
        .querySelectorAll('[data-accent-role]')
        .forEach(function(select) {
          map[select.getAttribute('data-accent-role')] = select.value;
        });

      return map;
    }

    document.getElementById('advancedAccentToggle').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        var body = document.getElementById('advancedAccentBody');
        var open = body.classList.contains('hidden');
        body.classList.toggle('hidden', !open);
        this.textContent =
          (open ? '▾' : '▸') + ' Advanced Color Assignment';
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('saveAdvancedAccentButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
        var status = document.getElementById('settingsAccentStatus');

        if (!option || !option.palette) return;

        currentAdvancedAccentMap = collectAdvancedAccentMap();

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
            option.accentAdvanced = result.accentAdvanced || '';
            currentAdvancedAccentMap =
              normalizeAdvancedAccentMap(option.accentAdvanced);

            if (status) {
              status.textContent =
                'Advanced color assignments saved for this background.';
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            if (status) {
              status.textContent =
                error && error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : 'Could not save advanced colors.';
            }
          })
          .saveAccentAdvanced(
            option.name,
            JSON.stringify(currentAdvancedAccentMap)
          );
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('clearAdvancedAccentButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
        var status = document.getElementById('settingsAccentStatus');

        if (!option || !option.palette) return;

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function() {
            option.accentAdvanced = '';
            currentAdvancedAccentMap = null;

            applyPaletteTheme(
              option.palette,
              currentAccentLayoutIndex,
              null
            );

            if (status) {
              status.textContent = 'Using shuffle mode for this background.';
            }
          })
          .clearAccentAdvanced(option.name);
      }
    );


    function showStudentPhotoCropper(dataUrl, fileName) {
      var preview = document.getElementById('studentPhotoPreviewCard');
      if (!preview) return;

      preview.innerHTML =
        '<div class="student-photo-cropper">' +
          '<div id="studentPhotoCropStage" class="student-photo-crop-stage">' +
            '<img id="studentPhotoCropImage" src="' +
              escapeAttribute(dataUrl) +
              '" alt="Student photo crop preview">' +
            '<div id="studentPhotoCropBox" class="student-photo-crop-box" ' +
              'aria-label="Drag to move the square crop">' +
              '<span class="student-photo-crop-handle nw" data-crop-handle="nw" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
              '<span class="student-photo-crop-handle ne" data-crop-handle="ne" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
              '<span class="student-photo-crop-handle sw" data-crop-handle="sw" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
              '<span class="student-photo-crop-handle se" data-crop-handle="se" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="student-photo-crop-size-control">' +
            '<span>Smaller</span>' +
            '<input id="studentPhotoCropSize" type="range" min="70" max="950" step="1" value="740" aria-label="Crop size">' +
            '<span>Larger</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="student-photo-crop-nudge-controls" aria-label="Fine crop adjustments">' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="up" title="Move crop up">↑</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="left" title="Move crop left">←</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="down" title="Move crop down">↓</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="right" title="Move crop right">→</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="smaller" title="Make crop smaller">−</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-crop-action="larger" title="Make crop larger">＋</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="student-photo-crop-help">' +
            'Drag anywhere inside the square to move it. Drag any corner handle to resize it directly, use the slider for larger changes, or use the arrow and +/− buttons for fine adjustments. The crop always stays square.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      studentPhotoCropState = {
        sourceDataUrl: dataUrl,
        fileName: fileName || 'student-photo.png',
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        size: 740
      };

      var stage = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropStage');
      var box = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropBox');
      var img = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropImage');
      var sizeSlider = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropSize');

      function getRenderedImageBounds() {
        var rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
        var naturalWidth = img.naturalWidth || rect.width;
        var naturalHeight = img.naturalHeight || rect.height;
        var sourceRatio = naturalWidth / naturalHeight;
        var stageRatio = rect.width / rect.height;

        var renderedWidth;
        var renderedHeight;
        var imageLeft;
        var imageTop;

        if (sourceRatio > stageRatio) {
          renderedWidth = rect.width;
          renderedHeight = renderedWidth / sourceRatio;
          imageLeft = 0;
          imageTop = (rect.height - renderedHeight) / 2;
        } else {
          renderedHeight = rect.height;
          renderedWidth = renderedHeight * sourceRatio;
          imageTop = 0;
          imageLeft = (rect.width - renderedWidth) / 2;
        }

        return {
          width: renderedWidth,
          height: renderedHeight,
          left: imageLeft,
          top: imageTop
        };
      }

      function applyCropSize(size, preserveCenter) {
        if (!stage || !box || !img) return;

        var bounds = getRenderedImageBounds();
        var maxSize = Math.max(
          70,
          Math.min(bounds.width, bounds.height)
        );

        var minSize = Math.min(
          70,
          maxSize
        );

        var newSize = Math.max(
          minSize,
          Math.min(Number(size) || 740, maxSize)
        );

        var centerX;
        var centerY;

        if (preserveCenter) {
          centerX =
            studentPhotoCropState.x +
            studentPhotoCropState.size / 2;

          centerY =
            studentPhotoCropState.y +
            studentPhotoCropState.size / 2;
        } else {
          centerX = bounds.left + bounds.width / 2;
          centerY = bounds.top + bounds.height / 2;
        }

        var x = centerX - newSize / 2;
        var y = centerY - newSize / 2;

        x = Math.max(
          bounds.left,
          Math.min(
            bounds.left + bounds.width - newSize,
            x
          )
        );

        y = Math.max(
          bounds.top,
          Math.min(
            bounds.top + bounds.height - newSize,
            y
          )
        );

        studentPhotoCropState.size = newSize;
        studentPhotoCropState.x = x;
        studentPhotoCropState.y = y;

        box.style.width = newSize + 'px';
        box.style.height = newSize + 'px';
        box.style.left = x + 'px';
        box.style.top = y + 'px';
        box.style.transform = 'none';

        if (sizeSlider) {
          sizeSlider.max = String(
            Math.floor(maxSize)
          );
          sizeSlider.value = String(
            Math.round(newSize)
          );
        }
      }

      function applyCropRect(
        x,
        y,
        size
      ) {
        var bounds =
          getRenderedImageBounds();

        var maxSize =
          Math.max(
            70,
            Math.min(
              bounds.width,
              bounds.height
            )
          );

        var minSize =
          Math.min(
            70,
            maxSize
          );

        size =
          Math.max(
            minSize,
            Math.min(
              Number(size) || minSize,
              maxSize
            )
          );

        x =
          Math.max(
            bounds.left,
            Math.min(
              bounds.left +
              bounds.width -
              size,
              Number(x) || bounds.left
            )
          );

        y =
          Math.max(
            bounds.top,
            Math.min(
              bounds.top +
              bounds.height -
              size,
              Number(y) || bounds.top
            )
          );

        studentPhotoCropState.size =
          size;
        studentPhotoCropState.x =
          x;
        studentPhotoCropState.y =
          y;

        box.style.width =
          size + 'px';
        box.style.height =
          size + 'px';
        box.style.left =
          x + 'px';
        box.style.top =
          y + 'px';
        box.style.transform =
          'none';

        if (sizeSlider) {
          sizeSlider.min =
            String(
              Math.floor(minSize)
            );
          sizeSlider.max =
            String(
              Math.floor(maxSize)
            );
          sizeSlider.value =
            String(
              Math.round(size)
            );
        }
      }

      function applyPortraitHeadshotHeuristic() {
        var bounds = getRenderedImageBounds();

        var maxSquare = Math.min(
          bounds.width,
          bounds.height
        );

        // School portraits are usually vertical. Start with a large square
        // that favors the upper-middle of the portrait so it tends to include
        // space above the head and shoulders below instead of centering on
        // the middle of the torso.
        var size = maxSquare * .985;

        var x =
          bounds.left +
          (bounds.width - size) / 2;

        var y;

        if (bounds.height > bounds.width * 1.12) {
          y =
            bounds.top +
            Math.max(
              0,
              (bounds.height - size) * .18
            );
        } else {
          y =
            bounds.top +
            (bounds.height - size) / 2;
        }

        studentPhotoCropState.size = size;
        studentPhotoCropState.x = x;
        studentPhotoCropState.y = y;

        box.style.width = size + 'px';
        box.style.height = size + 'px';
        box.style.left = x + 'px';
        box.style.top = y + 'px';
        box.style.transform = 'none';

        if (sizeSlider) {
          sizeSlider.max = String(
            Math.floor(maxSquare)
          );
          sizeSlider.value = String(
            Math.round(size)
          );
        }
      }

      function placeCropAroundDetectedFace(faceBox) {
        var bounds = getRenderedImageBounds();

        if (
          !faceBox ||
          !img.naturalWidth ||
          !img.naturalHeight
        ) {
          applyPortraitHeadshotHeuristic();
          return;
        }

        var scaleX =
          bounds.width / img.naturalWidth;

        var scaleY =
          bounds.height / img.naturalHeight;

        var faceLeft =
          bounds.left +
          faceBox.x * scaleX;

        var faceTop =
          bounds.top +
          faceBox.y * scaleY;

        var faceWidth =
          faceBox.width * scaleX;

        var faceHeight =
          faceBox.height * scaleY;

        var faceCenterX =
          faceLeft + faceWidth / 2;

        // Give the crop enough space for hair/headroom and shoulders.
        // Face itself ends up at roughly 45–55% of crop width.
        var size = Math.max(
          faceWidth * 2.05,
          faceHeight * 1.75
        );

        var maxSquare =
          Math.min(
            bounds.width,
            bounds.height
          );

        size = Math.min(
          size,
          maxSquare * .98
        );

        size = Math.max(
          size,
          Math.min(
            maxSquare,
            220
          )
        );

        var x =
          faceCenterX -
          size / 2;

        // Put the face slightly above vertical center so the crop reaches
        // from above the hairline down toward the shoulders.
        var y =
          faceTop -
          faceHeight * .48;

        x = Math.max(
          bounds.left,
          Math.min(
            bounds.left +
            bounds.width -
            size,
            x
          )
        );

        y = Math.max(
          bounds.top,
          Math.min(
            bounds.top +
            bounds.height -
            size,
            y
          )
        );

        studentPhotoCropState.size = size;
        studentPhotoCropState.x = x;
        studentPhotoCropState.y = y;

        box.style.width = size + 'px';
        box.style.height = size + 'px';
        box.style.left = x + 'px';
        box.style.top = y + 'px';
        box.style.transform = 'none';

        if (sizeSlider) {
          sizeSlider.max = String(
            Math.floor(maxSquare)
          );
          sizeSlider.value = String(
            Math.round(size)
          );
        }
      }

      function centerCropBox() {
        if (!stage || !box || !img) return;

        applyPortraitHeadshotHeuristic();

        // If the browser supports native face detection, use the largest
        // detected face to refine the crop. If not, the portrait heuristic
        // above remains in place.
        if (typeof window.FaceDetector !== 'function') {
          return;
        }

        try {
          var detector =
            new FaceDetector({
              fastMode: true,
              maxDetectedFaces: 5
            });

          detector
            .detect(img)
            .then(function(faces) {
              if (!faces || !faces.length) {
                return;
              }

              faces.sort(function(a, b) {
                var areaA =
                  a.boundingBox.width *
                  a.boundingBox.height;

                var areaB =
                  b.boundingBox.width *
                  b.boundingBox.height;

                return areaB - areaA;
              });

              placeCropAroundDetectedFace(
                faces[0].boundingBox
              );
            })
            .catch(function() {
              // Keep the portrait-aware fallback.
            });
        } catch (error) {
          // Keep the portrait-aware fallback.
        }
      }

      if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth) {
        centerCropBox();
      } else {
        img.onload = centerCropBox;
      }

      if (sizeSlider) {
        sizeSlider.addEventListener(
          'input',
          function() {
            applyCropSize(
              Number(this.value),
              true
            );
          }
        );
      }

      var nudgeButtons =
        preview.querySelectorAll(
          '[data-crop-action]'
        );

      nudgeButtons.forEach(
        function(button) {
          button.addEventListener(
            'click',
            function() {
              var action =
                this.getAttribute(
                  'data-crop-action'
                );

              var step = 8;
              var x =
                studentPhotoCropState.x;
              var y =
                studentPhotoCropState.y;
              var size =
                studentPhotoCropState.size;

              if (action === 'up') {
                y -= step;
              }

              if (action === 'down') {
                y += step;
              }

              if (action === 'left') {
                x -= step;
              }

              if (action === 'right') {
                x += step;
              }

              if (
                action === 'smaller'
              ) {
                size -= 8;
                x += 4;
                y += 4;
              }

              if (
                action === 'larger'
              ) {
                size += 8;
                x -= 4;
                y -= 4;
              }

              applyCropRect(
                x,
                y,
                size
              );
            }
          );
        }
      );

      var resizing = false;
      var resizeHandle = '';
      var resizeStartX = 0;
      var resizeStartY = 0;
      var resizeStartLeft = 0;
      var resizeStartTop = 0;
      var resizeStartSize = 0;

      function resizePointerDown(
        event
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        resizing = true;
        resizeHandle =
          event.currentTarget
            .getAttribute(
              'data-crop-handle'
            ) || 'se';

        resizeStartX =
          event.clientX;
        resizeStartY =
          event.clientY;
        resizeStartLeft =
          studentPhotoCropState.x;
        resizeStartTop =
          studentPhotoCropState.y;
        resizeStartSize =
          studentPhotoCropState.size;

        if (
          event.currentTarget
            .setPointerCapture &&
          event.pointerId != null
        ) {
          try {
            event.currentTarget
              .setPointerCapture(
                event.pointerId
              );
          } catch (err) {}
        }
      }

      function resizePointerMove(
        event
      ) {
        if (!resizing) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        var dx =
          event.clientX -
          resizeStartX;

        var dy =
          event.clientY -
          resizeStartY;

        var delta;

        if (
          resizeHandle === 'se'
        ) {
          delta =
            Math.max(dx, dy);
        } else if (
          resizeHandle === 'nw'
        ) {
          delta =
            Math.max(-dx, -dy);
        } else if (
          resizeHandle === 'ne'
        ) {
          delta =
            Math.max(dx, -dy);
        } else {
          delta =
            Math.max(-dx, dy);
        }

        var newSize =
          resizeStartSize +
          delta;

        var newX =
          resizeStartLeft;

        var newY =
          resizeStartTop;

        if (
          resizeHandle === 'nw' ||
          resizeHandle === 'sw'
        ) {
          newX =
            resizeStartLeft +
            resizeStartSize -
            newSize;
        }

        if (
          resizeHandle === 'nw' ||
          resizeHandle === 'ne'
        ) {
          newY =
            resizeStartTop +
            resizeStartSize -
            newSize;
        }

        applyCropRect(
          newX,
          newY,
          newSize
        );
      }

      function resizePointerUp(
        event
      ) {
        resizing = false;

        if (
          event &&
          event.currentTarget &&
          event.currentTarget
            .releasePointerCapture &&
          event.pointerId != null
        ) {
          try {
            event.currentTarget
              .releasePointerCapture(
                event.pointerId
              );
          } catch (err) {}
        }
      }

      box
        .querySelectorAll(
          '[data-crop-handle]'
        )
        .forEach(
          function(handle) {
            handle.addEventListener(
              'pointerdown',
              resizePointerDown
            );

            handle.addEventListener(
              'pointermove',
              resizePointerMove
            );

            handle.addEventListener(
              'pointerup',
              resizePointerUp
            );

            handle.addEventListener(
              'pointercancel',
              resizePointerUp
            );
          }
        );

      var dragging = false;
      var offsetX = 0;
      var offsetY = 0;

      function pointerDown(event) {
        if (
          event.target &&
          event.target.hasAttribute(
            'data-crop-handle'
          )
        ) {
          return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        dragging = true;

        var boxRect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
        offsetX = event.clientX - boxRect.left;
        offsetY = event.clientY - boxRect.top;

        if (box.setPointerCapture && event.pointerId != null) {
          try {
            box.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
          } catch (err) {}
        }
      }

      function pointerMove(event) {
        if (
          !dragging ||
          resizing
        ) return;
        event.preventDefault();

        var stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
        var bounds = getRenderedImageBounds();
        var size = studentPhotoCropState.size;

        var x =
          event.clientX -
          stageRect.left -
          offsetX;

        var y =
          event.clientY -
          stageRect.top -
          offsetY;

        x = Math.max(
          bounds.left,
          Math.min(
            bounds.left + bounds.width - size,
            x
          )
        );

        y = Math.max(
          bounds.top,
          Math.min(
            bounds.top + bounds.height - size,
            y
          )
        );

        studentPhotoCropState.x = x;
        studentPhotoCropState.y = y;

        box.style.left = x + 'px';
        box.style.top = y + 'px';
      }

      function pointerUp(event) {
        dragging = false;

        if (box.releasePointerCapture && event.pointerId != null) {
          try {
            box.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
          } catch (err) {}
        }
      }

      box.addEventListener('pointerdown', pointerDown);
      box.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerMove);
      box.addEventListener('pointerup', pointerUp);
      box.addEventListener('pointercancel', pointerUp);
    }

    function cropStudentPhotoToSquare(callback) {
      if (!studentPhotoCropState || !studentPhotoCropState.sourceDataUrl) {
        callback(null);
        return;
      }

      var stage = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropStage');
      var displayImg = document.getElementById('studentPhotoCropImage');

      if (!stage || !displayImg) {
        callback(null);
        return;
      }

      var source = new Image();

      source.onload = function() {
        var stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();

        // Recreate object-fit: contain math used by the preview image.
        var sourceRatio = source.width / source.height;
        var stageRatio = stageRect.width / stageRect.height;

        var renderedWidth;
        var renderedHeight;
        var imageLeft;
        var imageTop;

        if (sourceRatio > stageRatio) {
          renderedWidth = stageRect.width;
          renderedHeight = renderedWidth / sourceRatio;
          imageLeft = 0;
          imageTop = (stageRect.height - renderedHeight) / 2;
        } else {
          renderedHeight = stageRect.height;
          renderedWidth = renderedHeight * sourceRatio;
          imageTop = 0;
          imageLeft = (stageRect.width - renderedWidth) / 2;
        }

        var cropX = studentPhotoCropState.x;
        var cropY = studentPhotoCropState.y;
        var cropSize = studentPhotoCropState.size;

        // Limit the saved crop to the actual visible image. If the crop square
        // overlaps letterboxed space, clamp it back inside the image.
        cropX = Math.max(imageLeft, Math.min(
          imageLeft + renderedWidth - cropSize,
          cropX
        ));

        cropY = Math.max(imageTop, Math.min(
          imageTop + renderedHeight - cropSize,
          cropY
        ));

        var scaleX = source.width / renderedWidth;
        var scaleY = source.height / renderedHeight;

        var sx = (cropX - imageLeft) * scaleX;
        var sy = (cropY - imageTop) * scaleY;
        var sSize = cropSize * Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);

        sx = Math.max(0, Math.min(source.width - sSize, sx));
        sy = Math.max(0, Math.min(source.height - sSize, sy));

        var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 600;
        canvas.height = 600;

        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(
          source,
          sx,
          sy,
          sSize,
          sSize,
          0,
          0,
          600,
          600
        );

        callback(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .9));
      };

      source.onerror = function() {
        callback(null);
      };

      source.src = studentPhotoCropState.sourceDataUrl;
    }

    var studentPhotoOptions = [];

    function loadStudentPhotoOptions() {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(options) {
          studentPhotoOptions = options || [];
          renderStudentPhotoOptions();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          studentPhotoOptions = [];
          renderStudentPhotoOptions();
        })
        .getStudentPhotoOptions();
    }

    function updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState() {
      var select = document.getElementById('studentPhotoStudentSelect');
      var button = document.getElementById('uploadStudentPhotoButton');

      if (!button) return;

      // A student selection is required before the save button can be used.
      button.disabled = !select || !select.value;
    }

    function renderStudentPhotoOptions() {
      var select = document.getElementById('studentPhotoStudentSelect');
      if (!select) return;

      var current = select.value;
      select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Choose a student</option>';

      studentPhotoOptions.forEach(function(item) {
        var option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = String(item.rowNumber);
        option.textContent =
          item.period + ' • ' +
          item.classTitle + ' • ' +
          item.displayName +
          (item.hasPhoto ? ' • photo added' : '');
        select.appendChild(option);
      });

      if (
        current &&
        studentPhotoOptions.some(function(item) {
          return String(item.rowNumber) === String(current);
        })
      ) {
        select.value = current;
      }

      updateStudentPhotoPreview();
      updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
    }

    function getSelectedStudentPhotoOption() {
      var select = document.getElementById('studentPhotoStudentSelect');
      if (!select || !select.value) return null;

      return studentPhotoOptions.find(function(item) {
        return String(item.rowNumber) === String(select.value);
      }) || null;
    }

    function updateStudentPhotoPreview() {
      var preview = document.getElementById('studentPhotoPreviewCard');
      if (!preview) return;

      var item = getSelectedStudentPhotoOption();

      if (!item) {
        preview.innerHTML =
          '<div class="student-photo-preview-empty">?</div>';
        return;
      }

      if (item.imageUrl) {
        preview.innerHTML =
          '<img src="' +
          escapeAttribute(item.imageUrl) +
          '" alt="Student photo preview">';
        return;
      }

      var initial =
        String(item.displayName || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';

      preview.innerHTML =
        '<div class="student-photo-preview-empty">' +
        escapeHtml(initial) +
        '</div>';
    }

    document.getElementById('studentPhotoStudentSelect').addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {
        pastedStudentPhoto = null;
        studentPhotoCropState = null;
        var input = document.getElementById('studentPhotoFile');
        if (input) input.value = '';
        updateStudentPhotoPreview();
        updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('studentPhotoFile').addEventListener(
      'change',
      function() {
        var file = this.files && this.files[0];
        var preview = document.getElementById('studentPhotoPreviewCard');

        pastedStudentPhoto = null;

        if (!file || !preview) {
          updateStudentPhotoPreview();
          return;
        }

        fileToDataUrl(file, function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (error) return;

          showStudentPhotoCropper(dataUrl, file.name);

          var status = document.getElementById('studentPhotoUploadStatus');
          if (status) {
            status.textContent =
              'Selected image ready. Click SAVE STUDENT PHOTO.';
            status.style.color = '#20733b';
          }
        });
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('studentPhotoPasteZone').addEventListener(
      'paste',
      function(event) {
        var items =
          event.clipboardData && event.clipboardData.items
            ? Array.prototype.slice.call(event.clipboardData.items)
            : [];

        var imageItem = items.find(function(item) {
          return item.type && item.type.indexOf('image/') === 0;
        });

        if (!imageItem) {
          var status = document.getElementById('studentPhotoUploadStatus');
          if (status) {
            status.textContent = 'No image was found on the clipboard.';
            status.style.color = '#990000';
          }
          return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();

        var blob = imageItem.getAsFile();
        if (!blob) return;

        fileToDataUrl(blob, function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (error) return;

          pastedStudentPhoto = {
            dataUrl: dataUrl,
            name: 'pasted-student-photo.png'
          };

          var fileInput = document.getElementById('studentPhotoFile');
          if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';

          showStudentPhotoCropper(
            dataUrl,
            'pasted-student-photo.png'
          );

          var status = document.getElementById('studentPhotoUploadStatus');
          if (status) {
            status.textContent =
              'Pasted image ready. Click SAVE STUDENT PHOTO.';
            status.style.color = '#20733b';
          }
        });
      }
    );

    document.getElementById('uploadStudentPhotoButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        var select = document.getElementById('studentPhotoStudentSelect');
        var input = document.getElementById('studentPhotoFile');
        var status = document.getElementById('studentPhotoUploadStatus');
        var button = document.getElementById('uploadStudentPhotoButton');
        var file = input.files && input.files[0];
        var pasted = pastedStudentPhoto;

        if (!select.value) {
          status.textContent = 'Choose a student first.';
          status.style.color = '#990000';
          return;
        }

        if (!file && !pasted) {
          status.textContent = 'Choose or paste a photo first.';
          status.style.color = '#990000';
          return;
        }

        button.disabled = true;
        status.textContent = 'Saving…';
        status.style.color = '#647386';

        function sendPhoto(dataUrl, fileName) {
          var savedPhotoRow = Number(select.value);

          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(function() {
              updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
              input.value = '';
              pastedStudentPhoto = null;
              studentPhotoCropState = null;
              status.textContent = 'Photo saved.';
              status.style.color = '#20733b';

              loadStudentPhotoOptions();

              google.script.run
                .withSuccessHandler(function(roster) {
                  studentRoster = roster || [];
                  // Keep every photo already loaded, then fetch the new one.
                  applyKnownStudentPhotos();
                  populateGroupedDropdown();
                  renderStudentMenuStyle();
                  queueStudentPhotoRows([savedPhotoRow], true);
                })
                .getStudentRoster();
            })
            .withFailureHandler(function(serverError) {
              updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
              status.textContent =
                serverError && serverError.message
                  ? serverError.message
                  : 'Save failed.';
              status.style.color = '#990000';
            })
            .saveStudentPhotoUpload(
              Number(select.value),
              dataUrl,
              fileName || 'pasted-student-photo.png'
            );
        }

        if (studentPhotoCropState && studentPhotoCropState.sourceDataUrl) {
          cropStudentPhotoToSquare(function(croppedDataUrl) {
            if (!croppedDataUrl) {
              updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
              status.textContent = 'Could not create the square crop.';
              status.style.color = '#990000';
              return;
            }

            sendPhoto(
              croppedDataUrl,
              studentPhotoCropState.fileName || 'student-photo.jpg'
            );
          });
          return;
        }

        if (pasted && pasted.dataUrl) {
          sendPhoto(pasted.dataUrl, pasted.name);
          return;
        }

        fileToDataUrl(file, function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (error) {
            updateStudentPhotoSaveButtonState();
            status.textContent =
              error.message || 'Could not read that photo.';
            status.style.color = '#990000';
            return;
          }

          sendPhoto(dataUrl, file.name);
        });
      }
    );

    /* Settings */
    function getBackgroundOptionByName(name) {
      return backgroundOptions.find(function(option) {
        return option.name === name;
      }) || null;
    }

    function isHexColor(value) {
      return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(String(value || '').trim());
    }

    function hexRgb(hex) {
      hex = String(hex || '').replace('#', '');
      if (hex.length !== 6) return null;
      return {
        r: parseInt(hex.substring(0,2), 16),
        g: parseInt(hex.substring(2,4), 16),
        b: parseInt(hex.substring(4,6), 16)
      };
    }

    function readableTextColor(hex) {
      var rgb = hexRgb(hex);
      if (!rgb) return '#ffffff';
      var luminance = (0.2126 * rgb.r) + (0.7152 * rgb.g) + (0.0722 * rgb.b);
      return luminance > 160 ? '#14283d' : '#ffffff';
    }

    function srgbChannelToLinear(value) {
      value = value / 255;
      return value <= 0.04045
        ? value / 12.92
        : Math.pow((value + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
    }

    function relativeLuminance(hex) {
      var rgb = hexRgb(hex);
      if (!rgb) return 0;

      var r = srgbChannelToLinear(rgb.r);
      var g = srgbChannelToLinear(rgb.g);
      var b = srgbChannelToLinear(rgb.b);

      return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
    }

    function contrastRatio(hexA, hexB) {
      if (!isHexColor(hexA) || !isHexColor(hexB)) return 1;
      var a = relativeLuminance(hexA);
      var b = relativeLuminance(hexB);
      var lighter = Math.max(a, b);
      var darker = Math.min(a, b);
      return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05);
    }

    function paletteDarkText(palette) {
      return palette && isHexColor(palette.darkText)
        ? palette.darkText
        : (palette && isHexColor(palette.black) ? palette.black : '#1F252B');
    }

    function paletteLightText(palette) {
      return palette && isHexColor(palette.lightText)
        ? palette.lightText
        : (palette && isHexColor(palette.white) ? palette.white : '#FFFDF8');
    }

    function paletteTextColor(palette, backgroundHex) {
      var dark = paletteDarkText(palette);
      var light = paletteLightText(palette);

      if (!isHexColor(backgroundHex)) return dark;

      var darkRatio = contrastRatio(dark, backgroundHex);
      var lightRatio = contrastRatio(light, backgroundHex);

      // Prefer a 4.5:1 text pairing. If both pass, use the stronger pairing.
      // If neither passes, still use the strongest available pair.
      if (darkRatio >= 4.5 || lightRatio >= 4.5) {
        return darkRatio >= lightRatio ? dark : light;
      }

      return darkRatio >= lightRatio ? dark : light;
    }

    function oppositePaletteTextColor(palette, chosenText) {
      var dark = paletteDarkText(palette);
      var light = paletteLightText(palette);
      return String(chosenText || '').toLowerCase() === dark.toLowerCase()
        ? light
        : dark;
    }


    function oppositeOutlineColor(hex) {
      return readableTextColor(hex) === '#ffffff' ? '#ffffff' : '#14283d';
    }

    function getAllPalettePermutations() {
      var values = ['high','strong','pop','soft','low'];
      var result = [];

      function permute(prefix, remaining) {
        if (!remaining.length) {
          result.push(prefix.slice());
          return;
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
          var next = remaining[i];
          var rest = remaining.slice(0, i).concat(remaining.slice(i + 1));
          prefix.push(next);
          permute(prefix, rest);
          prefix.pop();
        }
      }

      permute([], values);
      return result;
    }

    var BASE_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS = getAllPalettePermutations();
    var ACCENT_LAYOUT_FAMILY_COUNT = 6;

    // Keep the existing 120 arrangements first so previously saved layout
    // numbers still resolve exactly the same way. Additional families reuse
    // the same five palette colors in different role relationships, producing
    // 720 possible layouts before readability filtering.
    var ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS = [];

    for (
      var accentFamilyIndex = 0;
      accentFamilyIndex < ACCENT_LAYOUT_FAMILY_COUNT;
      accentFamilyIndex++
    ) {
      BASE_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.forEach(function(permutation) {
        ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.push(permutation);
      });
    }

    function defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(layoutIndex) {
      var safeIndex = Number(layoutIndex);
      if (!Number.isFinite(safeIndex)) safeIndex = 0;

      safeIndex =
        ((Math.floor(safeIndex) % ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length) +
        ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length) %
        ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length;

      var baseCount = BASE_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length;
      var family = Math.floor(safeIndex / baseCount);
      var p = BASE_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS[safeIndex % baseCount];

      // Family 0 is the original layout mapping so existing saved looks
      // remain unchanged.
      if (family === 0) {
        return {
          titleOutline: p[4],
          titleBox: p[3],
          panelFill: p[4],
          panelBorder: p[1],
          cardFill: p[3],
          cardBorder: p[1],
          iconAccent: p[2],
          primaryButton: p[0],
          navControls: p[0]
        };
      }

      if (family === 1) {
        return {
          titleOutline: p[0],
          titleBox: p[4],
          panelFill: p[3],
          panelBorder: p[0],
          cardFill: p[4],
          cardBorder: p[1],
          iconAccent: p[2],
          primaryButton: p[1],
          navControls: p[0]
        };
      }

      if (family === 2) {
        return {
          titleOutline: p[1],
          titleBox: p[3],
          panelFill: p[4],
          panelBorder: p[0],
          cardFill: p[2],
          cardBorder: p[1],
          iconAccent: p[0],
          primaryButton: p[2],
          navControls: p[1]
        };
      }

      if (family === 3) {
        return {
          titleOutline: p[2],
          titleBox: p[4],
          panelFill: p[3],
          panelBorder: p[1],
          cardFill: p[4],
          cardBorder: p[0],
          iconAccent: p[1],
          primaryButton: p[0],
          navControls: p[2]
        };
      }

      if (family === 4) {
        return {
          titleOutline: p[0],
          titleBox: p[2],
          panelFill: p[4],
          panelBorder: p[1],
          cardFill: p[3],
          cardBorder: p[0],
          iconAccent: p[2],
          primaryButton: p[1],
          navControls: p[3]
        };
      }

      return {
        titleOutline: p[1],
        titleBox: p[4],
        panelFill: p[2],
        panelBorder: p[0],
        cardFill: p[3],
        cardBorder: p[1],
        iconAccent: p[4],
        primaryButton: p[0],
        navControls: p[2]
      };
    }

    function normalizeAdvancedAccentMap(raw) {
      if (!raw) return null;

      var parsed = raw;
      if (typeof raw === 'string') {
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch (err) {
          return null;
        }
      }

      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return null;

      var allowed = ['high','strong','pop','soft','low'];
      var result = {};
      var found = false;

      Object.keys(parsed).forEach(function(role) {
        var slot = String(parsed[role] || '').toLowerCase();
        if (allowed.indexOf(slot) !== -1) {
          result[role] = slot;
          found = true;
        }
      });

      return found ? result : null;
    }

    function paletteSlotColor(palette, slot) {
      var map = {
        high: palette.highContrast,
        strong: palette.strongContrast,
        pop: palette.popColor,
        soft: palette.softSupport,
        low: palette.lowContrast,
        black:
          palette.black || '#000000',
        white:
          palette.white || '#FFFFFF'
      };

      return map[slot] ||
        palette.highContrast;
    }

    function renderAccentSwatches(palette, roleMap) {
      var row = document.getElementById('accentSwatchRow');
      if (!row || !palette) return;

      var slots = ['high','strong','pop','soft','low'];
      var labels = {
        high: 'High',
        strong: 'Strong',
        pop: 'Pop',
        soft: 'Soft',
        low: 'Low'
      };

      row.innerHTML = '';

      slots.forEach(function(slot) {
        var swatch = document.createElement('div');
        swatch.className = 'accent-swatch';
        swatch.style.background = paletteSlotColor(palette, slot);
        swatch.innerHTML =
          '<div class="accent-swatch-label">' +
          labels[slot] +
          '</div>';
        row.appendChild(swatch);
      });
    }


    function applyUnifiedKioskTextColor(color) {
      if (!color) return;

      var selectors = [
        '.stage-title',
        '.active-pass-stage h3',
        '.class-card-text',
        '.student-card-name',
        '.student-id',
        '.destination-name',
        '#selectedStudentLine',
        '#selectedStudentSummary',
        '.selected-student-line',
        '.student-meta',
        '.class-card-title',
        '.class-card-subtitle',
        '.class-period',
        '.class-title-text'
      ];

      document
        .querySelectorAll(selectors.join(','))
        .forEach(function(el) {
          el.style.color = color;
        });
    }

    function applyPaletteTheme(palette, layoutIndex, advancedMap) {
      if (!palette) return false;

      var colors = [
        palette.highContrast,
        palette.strongContrast,
        palette.popColor,
        palette.softSupport,
        palette.lowContrast
      ];

      if (!colors.every(isHexColor)) return false;

      function roleMapIsVisuallySafe(candidate) {
        function c(role, fallback) {
          return paletteSlotColor(
            palette,
            candidate[role] || fallback
          );
        }

        var panel = c('panelFill', 'low');
        var card = c('cardFill', 'soft');
        var panelBorder = c('panelBorder', 'strong');
        var cardBorder = c('cardBorder', 'strong');
        var button = c('primaryButton', 'high');

        // These are separation checks rather than text checks. Text safety is
        // evaluated independently against every actual fill.
        return (
          contrastRatio(panel, card) >= 1.18 &&
          contrastRatio(panel, panelBorder) >= 1.28 &&
          contrastRatio(card, cardBorder) >= 1.28 &&
          contrastRatio(panel, button) >= 1.30
        );
      }

      var roleMap = normalizeAdvancedAccentMap(advancedMap);

      if (!roleMap) {
        var requested = Number(layoutIndex);
        if (!Number.isFinite(requested)) requested = 0;
        requested = Math.floor(requested);

        // Start with the requested shuffle and move forward until we find a
        // combination with clear panel/card/control separation.
        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length; attempt++) {
          var candidate = defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(requested + attempt);
          if (roleMapIsVisuallySafe(candidate)) {
            roleMap = candidate;
            break;
          }
        }

        roleMap = roleMap || defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(requested);
      }

      // Remember what is really on screen (it can differ from the requested
      // layout), so Shuffle always moves to something different.
      lastShownAccentKey = accentRoleMapKey(roleMap);

      function roleColor(role, fallbackSlot) {
        var slot = roleMap[role] || fallbackSlot;
        return paletteSlotColor(palette, slot);
      }

      var rawTitleBox = roleColor('titleBox', 'low');
      var rawPanelFill = roleColor('panelFill', 'low');
      var rawCardFill = roleColor('cardFill', 'soft');

      var lightAnchor = paletteLightText(palette);

      // Resolve the exact visible fills here instead of relying on CSS mixing
      // with pure white. This keeps each palette's warm/cool character intact
      // and lets the contrast calculation use the actual displayed color.
      var titleBox = mixHexColors(rawTitleBox, lightAnchor, .18);
      var panelFill = mixHexColors(rawPanelFill, lightAnchor, .22);
      var cardFill = mixHexColors(rawCardFill, lightAnchor, .32);

      var panelBorder = roleColor('panelBorder', 'strong');
      var cardBorder = roleColor('cardBorder', 'strong');
      var iconAccent = roleColor('iconAccent', 'pop');
      var primaryButton = roleColor('primaryButton', 'high');
      var navControls = roleColor('navControls', 'high');

      var titleText = paletteTextColor(palette, titleBox);
      var titleOutline = oppositePaletteTextColor(palette, titleText);
      var textColor = paletteTextColor(palette, panelFill);
      var cardText = paletteTextColor(palette, cardFill);
      var primaryButtonText = paletteTextColor(palette, primaryButton);
      var navText = paletteTextColor(palette, navControls);

      var root = document.documentElement.style;

      root.setProperty('--palette-high', roleColor('primaryButton', 'high'));
      root.setProperty('--palette-strong', panelBorder);
      root.setProperty('--palette-pop', iconAccent);
      root.setProperty('--palette-soft', cardFill);
      root.setProperty('--palette-low', panelFill);
      root.setProperty('--palette-dark-text', paletteDarkText(palette));
      root.setProperty('--palette-light-text', paletteLightText(palette));

      root.setProperty('--role-title-text', titleText);
      root.setProperty('--role-big-title', titleText);
      root.setProperty('--role-small-title', titleText);
      root.setProperty('--role-title-outline', titleOutline);
      root.setProperty('--role-title-box', titleBox);
      root.setProperty('--role-panel-fill', panelFill);
      root.setProperty('--role-panel-border', panelBorder);
      root.setProperty('--role-text', textColor);
      root.setProperty('--role-heading-text', textColor);
      root.setProperty('--role-card-fill', cardFill);
      root.setProperty('--role-card-text', cardText);
      root.setProperty('--role-card-border', cardBorder);
      root.setProperty('--role-icon-accent', iconAccent);
      root.setProperty('--role-primary-button', primaryButton);
      root.setProperty('--role-nav-controls', navControls);

      root.setProperty('--palette-on-high', primaryButtonText);
      root.setProperty('--palette-on-strong', textColor);
      root.setProperty('--palette-on-pop', paletteTextColor(palette, iconAccent));
      root.setProperty('--role-primary-button-text', primaryButtonText);
      root.setProperty('--role-nav-text', navText);
      root.setProperty('--palette-title-outline', titleOutline);

      applyUnifiedKioskTextColor(textColor);

      renderAccentSwatches(palette, roleMap);
      renderAdvancedAccentGrid(palette, roleMap);

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        fitStudentCardNames();
        scatterDestinationCardColors();
        positionTopColorControls();
      });

      return true;
    }

    function setThemeFromRgb(r, g, b) {
      // Keep the kiosk panels readable while borrowing the actual hue
      // from the selected background.
      function mixWithWhite(value, whiteAmount) {
        return Math.round(value * (1 - whiteAmount) + 255 * whiteAmount);
      }

      var surface = [
        mixWithWhite(r, .72),
        mixWithWhite(g, .72),
        mixWithWhite(b, .72)
      ];

      var card = [
        mixWithWhite(r, .84),
        mixWithWhite(g, .84),
        mixWithWhite(b, .84)
      ];

      var border = [
        mixWithWhite(r, .48),
        mixWithWhite(g, .48),
        mixWithWhite(b, .48)
      ];

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--theme-surface-rgb',
        surface.join(',')
      );
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--theme-card-rgb',
        card.join(',')
      );
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--theme-border-rgb',
        border.join(',')
      );
    }

    function applyAdaptiveThemeFromImage(dataUrl) {
      if (!dataUrl || dataUrl.indexOf('data:image/') !== 0) {
        return;
      }

      var img = new Image();

      img.onload = function() {
        try {
          var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 32;
          canvas.height = 18;
          var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently: true});
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 32, 18);

          var pixels = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 18).data;
          var r = 0;
          var g = 0;
          var b = 0;
          var count = 0;

          for (var i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
            var alpha = pixels[i + 3];
            if (alpha < 180) continue;

            var pr = pixels[i];
            var pg = pixels[i + 1];
            var pb = pixels[i + 2];

            // Ignore very white pixels so large white content panels in
            // some background art do not wash out the theme color.
            if (pr > 238 && pg > 238 && pb > 238) continue;

            r += pr;
            g += pg;
            b += pb;
            count++;
          }

          if (count) {
            setThemeFromRgb(
              Math.round(r / count),
              Math.round(g / count),
              Math.round(b / count)
            );
          }
        } catch (err) {
          // Keep the existing safe theme if color sampling fails.
        }
      };

      img.src = dataUrl;
    }

    function setBodyBackground(dataUrl, option) {
      if (!dataUrl) {
        document.body.style.backgroundImage = '';
        document.body.style.background = '#eef3f8';
        return;
      }

      document.body.style.background = '';
      document.body.style.backgroundImage =
        'url("' + dataUrl.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '")';
      document.body.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
      document.body.style.backgroundPosition = 'center center';
      document.body.style.backgroundAttachment = 'fixed';

      kioskDebug('Painted background: ' + String(dataUrl).slice(0, 40) + ' (' + Math.round(String(dataUrl).length / 1024) + ' KB)' +
        ' -> page now shows ' + String(document.body.style.backgroundImage || 'nothing').slice(0, 30));

      // Remember the saved choice on this device for an instant start next time
      // (not previews of tiles that haven't been saved).
      if (option && option.name === kioskSettings.backgroundName) {
        kioskLastBackground.save(option.name, 'image', dataUrl);
      }

      // Built-in backgrounds use the curated five-role palette from the
      // Backgrounds sheet. Custom backgrounds still fall back to sampling.
      if (option) {
        currentAccentLayoutIndex = Number(option.accentLayout || 0);
        currentAccentBackgroundName = option.name || "";
        currentAdvancedAccentMap =
          normalizeAdvancedAccentMap(option.accentAdvanced || "");
      }

      if (!option || !applyPaletteTheme(
        option.palette,
        currentAccentLayoutIndex,
        currentAdvancedAccentMap
      )) {
        applyAdaptiveThemeFromImage(dataUrl);
      }
    }

    function loadBuiltInPreview(option, swatch, button) {
      if (!option || option.type !== 'BUILTIN') return;

      button.classList.add('loading-preview');

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(dataUrl) {
          button.classList.remove('loading-preview');

          if (dataUrl) {
            option.previewValue = dataUrl;
            swatch.style.background = '';
            swatch.style.backgroundImage =
              'url("' + dataUrl.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '")';
            swatch.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
            swatch.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          button.classList.remove('loading-preview');
        })
        .getBackgroundThumbnail(option.name);
    }

    var backgroundFullImageCache = Object.create(null);

    function previewBackgroundChoice(option) {
      if (!option) return;

      if (option.type === 'CSS') {
        document.body.style.backgroundImage = '';
        document.body.style.background = option.value || '#eef3f8';
        if (option.name === kioskSettings.backgroundName) {
          kioskLastBackground.save(option.name, 'css', option.value);
        }
        currentAccentLayoutIndex = Number(option.accentLayout || 0);
        currentAccentBackgroundName = option.name || "";
        currentAdvancedAccentMap =
          normalizeAdvancedAccentMap(option.accentAdvanced || "");
        applyPaletteTheme(
          option.palette,
          currentAccentLayoutIndex,
          currentAdvancedAccentMap
        );
        return;
      }

      if (option.type === 'BUILTIN') {
        var cachedFull = backgroundFullImageCache[option.name];
        if (cachedFull) {
          setBodyBackground(cachedFull, option);
          return;
        }

        // Paint the already-loaded thumbnail immediately so selecting a
        // background feels instant. Fetch the full-resolution image quietly
        // and swap it in only when it arrives.
        if (option.previewValue) {
          setBodyBackground(option.previewValue, option);
        }

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(imageData) {
            if (!imageData) return;
            backgroundFullImageCache[option.name] = imageData;

            var selectedInput = document.getElementById('settingBackground');
            var isStillSelected =
              (selectedInput && selectedInput.value === option.name) ||
              kioskSettings.backgroundName === option.name;

            if (isStillSelected) {
              setBodyBackground(imageData, option);
            }
          })
          .getBackgroundImage(option.name);
        return;
      }

      if (option.value) {
        setBodyBackground(
          option.value,
          option
        );
        return;
      }

      // Deferred image: fetch only the selected background instead of loading
      // every background image during kiosk startup.
      kioskDebug('Asking the Sheet for "' + option.name + '"...');
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(imageData) {
          kioskDebug('Got "' + option.name + '": ' + (imageData ? String(imageData).slice(0, 30) + '... ' + Math.round(String(imageData).length / 1024) + ' KB' : 'NOTHING') +
            ', still chosen: ' + (kioskSettings.backgroundName === option.name));
          if (!imageData) return;

          option.value =
            imageData;

          var isStillSelected =
            kioskSettings.backgroundName ===
            option.name;

          if (isStillSelected) {
            setBodyBackground(
              imageData,
              option
            );
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(
          function(error) {
            kioskDebug('FAILED getting "' + option.name + '": ' + String(error && error.message || error));
          }
        )
        .getBackgroundImage(
          option.name
        );
    }

    function applyBackground() {
      var option = getBackgroundOptionByName(kioskSettings.backgroundName);
      kioskDebug('Background: chosen "' + kioskSettings.backgroundName + '", ' + backgroundOptions.length +
        ' in list, ' + (option ? 'found (' + option.type + (option.value ? ', has address ' + String(option.value).slice(0, 40) : ', will ask the Sheet') + ')' : 'NOT in the list'));
      previewBackgroundChoice(option);
    }

    /* ===== Background previews =====
       Every preview comes from one small request (stored on the Backgrounds
       tab). A background that has no stored preview yet gets one made here,
       once, from its full image, and it is saved for every device. */
    var backgroundPreviewStore = {
      loaded: false,
      loading: false,
      waiting: [],
      queue: [],
      queued: {},
      active: 0
    };

    function backgroundCssUrl(value) {
      return 'url("' + String(value).replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '")';
    }

    /* What to draw in a preview tile for this background, if known. */
    function backgroundPreviewSource(option) {
      if (!option || option.type === 'CSS') return '';
      return option.previewValue || option.value || '';
    }

    function findBackgroundButton(name) {
      var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(
        '#backgroundGrid .background-option'
      );

      for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        if (buttons[i].getAttribute('data-background') === name) {
          return buttons[i];
        }
      }

      return null;
    }

    function paintBackgroundPreview(option) {
      var source = backgroundPreviewSource(option);
      var button = findBackgroundButton(option.name);

      if (button) {
        button.classList.remove('loading-preview');

        var swatch = button.querySelector('.background-swatch');

        if (swatch && source) {
          swatch.style.background = '';
          swatch.style.backgroundImage = backgroundCssUrl(source);
          swatch.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
          swatch.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
        }
      }

      var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('settingBackground');

      if (hiddenInput && hiddenInput.value === option.name) {
        updateBackgroundPreview();
      }
    }

    /* Shrinks a full-size image to a small preview (under ~45 KB). */
    function makeBackgroundThumbnail(dataUrl, callback) {
      var img = new Image();

      img.onload = function() {
        var attempts = [[400, .72], [320, .66], [260, .6], [200, .55]];

        for (var i = 0; i < attempts.length; i++) {
          try {
            var scale = Math.min(
              1,
              attempts[i][0] / Math.max(img.width, 1)
            );
            var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * scale));
            canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));

            var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            var thumb = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', attempts[i][1]);

            if (thumb.length < 45000) {
              callback(thumb);
              return;
            }
          } catch (err) {
            break;
          }
        }

        callback('');
      };

      img.onerror = function() { kioskDebug('Picture would not open in the browser: ' + String(dataUrl).slice(0, 40)); callback(''); };
      img.src = dataUrl;
    }

    function pumpBackgroundPreviewQueue() {
      while (
        backgroundPreviewStore.active < 2 &&
        backgroundPreviewStore.queue.length
      ) {
        buildBackgroundPreview(backgroundPreviewStore.queue.shift());
      }
    }

    function buildBackgroundPreview(option) {
      backgroundPreviewStore.active++;

      function done() {
        backgroundPreviewStore.active--;
        delete backgroundPreviewStore.queued[option.name];
        pumpBackgroundPreviewQueue();
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(imageData) {
          imageData = String(imageData || '');
          kioskDebug('Tile "' + option.name + '": got ' + (imageData ? imageData.slice(0, 22) + '... ' + Math.round(imageData.length / 1024) + ' KB' : 'NOTHING'));

          if (!imageData) {
            var button = findBackgroundButton(option.name);
            if (button) button.classList.remove('loading-preview');
            done();
            return;
          }

          if (!/^data:image\//i.test(imageData)) {
            /* A web link: the browser can show it directly. */
            option.previewValue = imageData;
            paintBackgroundPreview(option);
            done();
            return;
          }

          makeBackgroundThumbnail(imageData, function(thumb) {
            option.previewValue = thumb || imageData;
            paintBackgroundPreview(option);

            if (thumb) {
              /* Remember it for this session even if the list refreshes. */
              if (!backgroundPreviewStore.storedPreviews) {
                backgroundPreviewStore.storedPreviews = {};
              }
              backgroundPreviewStore.storedPreviews[option.name] = thumb;

              google.script.run
                .withFailureHandler(function() {})
                .saveBackgroundPreview(option.name, thumb);
            }

            done();
          });
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          kioskDebug('Tile "' + option.name + '": FAILED ' + String(error && error.message || error));
          var button = findBackgroundButton(option.name);
          if (button) button.classList.remove('loading-preview');
          done();
        })
        .getBackgroundImage(option.name);
    }

    function queueBackgroundPreview(option) {
      if (
        !option ||
        option.type === 'CSS' ||
        backgroundPreviewSource(option) ||
        backgroundPreviewStore.queued[option.name]
      ) {
        return;
      }

      backgroundPreviewStore.queued[option.name] = true;
      backgroundPreviewStore.queue.push(option);

      var button = findBackgroundButton(option.name);
      if (button) button.classList.add('loading-preview');

      pumpBackgroundPreviewQueue();
    }

    /* Fetches every stored preview in one request (once), then calls back. */
    function loadStoredBackgroundPreviews(callback) {
      if (backgroundPreviewStore.loaded) {
        callback();
        return;
      }

      backgroundPreviewStore.waiting.push(callback);

      if (backgroundPreviewStore.loading) return;

      backgroundPreviewStore.loading = true;

      function finish(previews) {
        previews = previews || {};

        backgroundOptions.forEach(function(option) {
          if (previews[option.name] && !option.previewValue) {
            option.previewValue = previews[option.name];
          }
        });

        backgroundPreviewStore.storedPreviews = previews;
        backgroundPreviewStore.loaded = true;
        backgroundPreviewStore.loading = false;

        var waiting = backgroundPreviewStore.waiting;
        backgroundPreviewStore.waiting = [];
        waiting.forEach(function(fn) { fn(); });
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(finish)
        .withFailureHandler(function() { finish({}); })
        .getBackgroundPreviews();
    }

    function populateBackgroundSelect() {
      var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('settingBackground');
      var grid = document.getElementById('backgroundGrid');

      if (!hiddenInput || !grid) return;

      hiddenInput.value =
        kioskSettings.backgroundName || 'School- Supplies';

      grid.innerHTML = '';

      /* The background list may have been refreshed since the previews
         were fetched; re-attach the stored previews to the new list. */
      var storedPreviews = backgroundPreviewStore.storedPreviews || {};

      backgroundOptions.forEach(function(option) {
        if (!option.previewValue && storedPreviews[option.name]) {
          option.previewValue = storedPreviews[option.name];
        }

        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'background-option';
        button.setAttribute('data-background', option.name);

        var swatch = document.createElement('div');
        swatch.className = 'background-swatch';
        swatch.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
        swatch.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';

        var source = backgroundPreviewSource(option);

        if (option.type === 'CSS') {
          swatch.style.background = option.value || '#eef3f8';
        } else if (source) {
          swatch.style.backgroundImage = backgroundCssUrl(source);
        } else {
          swatch.style.background =
            'linear-gradient(135deg,#eef3f8,#dfe7f0)';
        }

        var label = document.createElement('div');
        label.className = 'background-label';
        label.textContent = option.name;

        button.appendChild(swatch);
        button.appendChild(label);

        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          hiddenInput.value = option.name;

          document.querySelectorAll('.background-option').forEach(
            function(item) {
              item.classList.remove('active');
            }
          );

          button.classList.add('active');
          updateBackgroundPreview();
          previewBackgroundChoice(option);
        });

        if (option.name === hiddenInput.value) {
          button.classList.add('active');
        }

        grid.appendChild(button);
      });

      updateBackgroundPreview();

      /* One request for all stored previews; then make any that are
         missing, two at a time. */
      loadStoredBackgroundPreviews(function() {
        backgroundOptions.forEach(function(option) {
          if (option.type === 'CSS') return;

          if (backgroundPreviewSource(option)) {
            paintBackgroundPreview(option);
          } else {
            queueBackgroundPreview(option);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function updateBackgroundPreview() {
      var selected =
        document.getElementById('settingBackground').value;
      var option = getBackgroundOptionByName(selected);
      var preview = document.getElementById('backgroundPreview');

      preview.style.background = '';
      preview.style.backgroundImage = '';
      preview.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
      preview.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';

      if (!option) {
        preview.style.background = '#eef3f8';
        return;
      }

      if (option.type === 'CSS') {
        preview.style.background = option.value || '#eef3f8';
        return;
      }

      /* The large preview prefers the full image when it is already here. */
      var source = option.value || option.previewValue || '';

      if (source) {
        preview.style.backgroundImage = backgroundCssUrl(source);
        return;
      }

      preview.style.background =
        'linear-gradient(135deg,#eef3f8,#dfe7f0)';

      if (backgroundPreviewStore.loaded) {
        queueBackgroundPreview(option);
      }
    }

    function getFontOptionByName(name) {
      return fontOptions.find(function(option) {
        return option.name === name;
      }) || null;
    }

    function installCustomFontFaces() {
      var old = document.getElementById('dynamicFontFaces');

      if (old) {
        old.remove();
      }

      var style = document.createElement('style');
      style.id = 'dynamicFontFaces';
      var css = '';

      fontOptions.forEach(function(option) {
        if (
          option.type === "CUSTOM" &&
          option.dataUrl &&
          option.familyKey
        ) {
          css +=
            '@font-face{' +
            'font-family:"' +
            option.familyKey.replace(/"/g, '') +
            '";' +
            'src:url("' +
            option.dataUrl +
            '");' +
            'font-weight:normal;' +
            'font-style:normal;' +
            '}\n';
        }
      });

      style.textContent = css;
      document.head.appendChild(style);
    }

    function applyKioskFont() {
      var option =
        getFontOptionByName(kioskSettings.fontName) ||
        getFontOptionByName('Arial');

      var family =
        option && option.family
          ? option.family
          : 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';

      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--kiosk-font-family',
        family
      );
    }


    function toGrade1Braille(text) {
      var map = {
        a:'⠁', b:'⠃', c:'⠉', d:'⠙', e:'⠑', f:'⠋', g:'⠛', h:'⠓',
        i:'⠊', j:'⠚', k:'⠅', l:'⠇', m:'⠍', n:'⠝', o:'⠕', p:'⠏',
        q:'⠟', r:'⠗', s:'⠎', t:'⠞', u:'⠥', v:'⠧', w:'⠺', x:'⠭',
        y:'⠽', z:'⠵'
      };

      return String(text || '')
        .split('')
        .map(function(ch) {
          var lower = ch.toLowerCase();
          return map[lower] || ch;
        })
        .join('');
    }

    function renderFontOptions() {
      var grid = document.getElementById('fontGrid');
      var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('settingFont');

      if (!grid || !hiddenInput) return;

      hiddenInput.value = kioskSettings.fontName || 'Arial';
      grid.innerHTML = '';

      var knownSpecialty = [
        'CG ASL',
        'Braille Full Cell',
        'Braille Dots Only'
      ];

      var displayOptions = fontOptions.slice();

      knownSpecialty.forEach(function(name) {
        if (!displayOptions.some(function(option) {
          return option.name === name;
        })) {
          displayOptions.push({
            name: name,
            family: 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif',
            type: 'UNAVAILABLE'
          });
        }
      });

      displayOptions.forEach(function(option) {
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'font-option';

        if (option.type === 'UNAVAILABLE') {
          button.classList.add('unavailable');
        }

        if (option.name === hiddenInput.value) {
          button.classList.add('active');
        }

        var sampleFamily =
          option.family || 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';

        var previewText = 'Aa Bb 123 • Hall Pass';

        if (option.name === 'CG ASL') {
          previewText = 'ABC abc 123';
        } else if (option.name === 'Braille Full Cell') {
          previewText = 'learn 123';
        } else if (option.name === 'Braille Dots Only') {
          previewText = toGrade1Braille('LEARN 123');
        }

        button.innerHTML =
          '<div class="font-preview-name">' +
            escapeHtml(option.name) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="font-preview-sample" style="font-family:' +
            escapeAttribute(sampleFamily) +
          ' !important;">' + escapeHtml(previewText) + '</div>';

        if (option.type === 'UNAVAILABLE') {
          button.title =
            'Upload the matching specialty font file below first.';
        } else {
          button.addEventListener('click', function() {
            hiddenInput.value = option.name;

            document.querySelectorAll('.font-option').forEach(
              function(item) {
                item.classList.remove('active');
              }
            );

            button.classList.add('active');
          });
        }

        grid.appendChild(button);
      });
    }


    function updateTimingExplanation() {
      var greenSelect = document.getElementById('settingGreen');
      var yellowSelect = document.getElementById('settingYellow');

      if (!greenSelect || !yellowSelect) return;

      var green = Number(greenSelect.value || 0);
      var yellow = Number(yellowSelect.value || 0);

      if (!isFinite(green)) green = 0;
      if (!isFinite(yellow)) yellow = green;
      if (yellow < green) yellow = green;

      var greenText = green + ' min';
      var yellowText = yellow + ' min';

      var greenExample = document.getElementById('timingGreenExample');
      var yellowExample = document.getElementById('timingYellowExample');
      var redExample = document.getElementById('timingRedExample');

      if (greenExample) greenExample.textContent = greenText;
      if (yellowExample) yellowExample.textContent = yellowText;
      if (redExample) redExample.textContent = yellowText;

      var greenPreview = document.getElementById('timingPreviewGreen');
      var yellowPreview = document.getElementById('timingPreviewYellow');
      var redPreview = document.getElementById('timingPreviewRed');

      var greenSeconds =
        Math.max(30, Math.min(green * 60, Math.max(30, green * 60 - 30)));

      var yellowLower = Math.max(green * 60 + 30, 60);
      var yellowUpper = Math.max(yellowLower, yellow * 60);
      var yellowSeconds =
        Math.min(
          yellowUpper,
          Math.max(
            yellowLower,
            Math.floor((yellowLower + yellowUpper) / 2)
          )
        );

      var redSeconds = Math.max(yellow * 60 + 30, yellowSeconds + 30);

      function formatPreviewDuration(totalSeconds) {
        var mins = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
        var secs = Math.round(totalSeconds % 60);

        if (mins > 0 && secs > 0) {
          return mins + ' min ' + secs + ' sec';
        }

        if (mins > 0) {
          return mins + ' min';
        }

        return secs + ' sec';
      }

      if (greenPreview) {
        greenPreview.textContent = formatPreviewDuration(greenSeconds);
      }

      if (yellowPreview) {
        yellowPreview.textContent = formatPreviewDuration(yellowSeconds);
      }

      if (redPreview) {
        redPreview.textContent = formatPreviewDuration(redSeconds);
      }
    }

    function populateMinuteSelect(id, selected) {
      var select = document.getElementById(id);
      select.innerHTML = '';

      for (var i = 1; i <= 30; i++) {
        var option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = String(i);
        option.textContent = i + " min";
        option.selected = Number(selected) === i;
        select.appendChild(option);
      }
    }
