    var classImageEditorOptions = [];
    var classImageEditorLoaded = false;
    var classImageEditState = null;
    var classImageEditorNewFile = null;

    function classImageEditorClamp(value, min, max) {
      return Math.max(
        min,
        Math.min(
          max,
          Number(value) || 0
        )
      );
    }

    function getSelectedClassImageOption() {
      var select =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageClassSelect'
        );

      if (!select || !select.value) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        classImageEditorOptions.find(
          function(item) {
            return (
              String(item.rowNumber) ===
              String(select.value)
            );
          }
        ) || null
      );
    }

    function renderClassImageClassOptions() {
      var select =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageClassSelect'
        );

      if (!select) return;

      var current =
        select.value;

      select.innerHTML =
        '<option value="">Choose a class</option>';

      classImageEditorOptions.forEach(
        function(item) {
          var option =
            document.createElement(
              'option'
            );

          option.value =
            String(item.rowNumber);

          option.textContent =
            item.period +
            ' • ' +
            item.classTitle +
            (
              item.hasImage
                ? ' • image added'
                : ''
            );

          select.appendChild(option);
        }
      );

      if (
        current &&
        classImageEditorOptions.some(
          function(item) {
            return (
              String(item.rowNumber) ===
              String(current)
            );
          }
        )
      ) {
        select.value = current;
      }
    }

    function classImageEditorSetStatus(
      message,
      isError
    ) {
      var status =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageEditorStatus'
        );

      if (!status) return;

      status.textContent =
        message || '';

      status.style.color =
        isError
          ? '#990000'
          : '#20733b';
    }

    function updateClassImageEditorButtons() {
      var item =
        getSelectedClassImageOption();

      var saveButton =
        document.getElementById(
          'saveClassImageButton'
        );

      var removeButton =
        document.getElementById(
          'removeClassImageButton'
        );

      if (saveButton) {
        saveButton.disabled =
          !item ||
          !classImageEditState ||
          !classImageEditState.sourceUrl;
      }

      if (removeButton) {
        removeButton.disabled =
          !item ||
          !item.hasImage;
      }
    }

    function applyClassImageEditorPreview() {
      var stage =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageCropStage'
        );

      var zoomSlider =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageZoom'
        );

      if (
        !stage ||
        !classImageEditState ||
        !classImageEditState.sourceUrl
      ) {
        if (stage) {
          stage.classList.add(
            'class-image-crop-empty'
          );

          stage.innerHTML =
            '<div class="class-image-crop-empty-text">' +
            (
              getSelectedClassImageOption()
                ? 'No class image yet'
                : 'Choose a class'
            ) +
            '</div>';
        }

        if (zoomSlider) {
          zoomSlider.value = '1';
        }

        updateClassImageEditorButtons();
        return;
      }

      stage.classList.remove(
        'class-image-crop-empty'
      );

      var image =
        stage.querySelector('img');

      if (!image) {
        stage.innerHTML =
          '<img alt="Class image crop preview">';

        image =
          stage.querySelector('img');
      }

      if (
        image.getAttribute('src') !==
        classImageEditState.sourceUrl
      ) {
        image.setAttribute(
          'src',
          classImageEditState.sourceUrl
        );
      }

      var zoom =
        classImageEditorClamp(
          classImageEditState.zoom,
          1,
          3
        );

      var focusX =
        classImageEditorClamp(
          classImageEditState.focusX,
          0,
          100
        );

      var focusY =
        classImageEditorClamp(
          classImageEditState.focusY,
          0,
          100
        );

      image.style.objectPosition =
        focusX +
        '% ' +
        focusY +
        '%';

      image.style.transform =
        'scale(' +
        zoom +
        ')';

      image.style.transformOrigin =
        focusX +
        '% ' +
        focusY +
        '%';

      if (zoomSlider) {
        zoomSlider.value =
          String(zoom);
      }

      updateClassImageEditorButtons();
    }

    function beginClassImageEditFromOption() {
      var item =
        getSelectedClassImageOption();

      classImageEditorNewFile = null;

      var input =
        document.getElementById(
          'classImageFile'
        );

      if (input) {
        input.value = '';
      }

      if (!item) {
        classImageEditState = null;
        applyClassImageEditorPreview();
        return;
      }

      classImageEditState = {
        sourceUrl:
          item.imageUrl || '',
        zoom:
          Number(item.zoom) || 1,
        focusX:
          isFinite(Number(item.focusX))
            ? Number(item.focusX)
            : 50,
        focusY:
          isFinite(Number(item.focusY))
            ? Number(item.focusY)
            : 50
      };

      classImageEditorSetStatus(
        '',
        false
      );

      applyClassImageEditorPreview();
    }

    function loadClassImageEditorOptions(force) {
      if (
        classImageEditorLoaded &&
        !force
      ) {
        renderClassImageClassOptions();
        beginClassImageEditFromOption();
        return;
      }

      classImageEditorSetStatus(
        'Loading class images…',
        false
      );

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(
          function(options) {
            classImageEditorOptions =
              options || [];

            classImageEditorLoaded = true;

            renderClassImageClassOptions();
            beginClassImageEditFromOption();

            classImageEditorSetStatus(
              '',
              false
            );
          }
        )
        .withFailureHandler(
          function(error) {
            classImageEditorLoaded =
              false;

            classImageEditorSetStatus(
              error && error.message
                ? error.message
                : 'Class images could not load.',
              true
            );
          }
        )
        .getClassImageEditorOptions();
    }

    function updateRosterClassImageFromEditor(
      item
    ) {
      if (!item) return;

      (studentRoster || []).forEach(
        function(group) {
          var groupKey =
            classImageLookupKey(
              group.period,
              group.classTitle
            );

          var itemKey =
            classImageLookupKey(
              item.period,
              item.classTitle
            );

          if (
            groupKey !==
            itemKey
          ) {
            return;
          }

          group.classImageUrl =
            item.imageUrl || '';

          group.classImageZoom =
            Number(item.zoom) || 1;

          group.classImageFocusX =
            isFinite(Number(item.focusX))
              ? Number(item.focusX)
              : 50;

          group.classImageFocusY =
            isFinite(Number(item.focusY))
              ? Number(item.focusY)
              : 50;
        }
      );

      if (!selectedClass) {
        renderStudentMenuStyle();
      }
    }

    function selectClassImageFile(file) {
      if (!file) return;

      var allowed = [
        'image/png',
        'image/jpeg',
        'image/webp',
        'image/gif'
      ];

      if (
        allowed.indexOf(
          String(file.type || '')
            .toLowerCase()
        ) === -1
      ) {
        classImageEditorSetStatus(
          'Choose a JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF image.',
          true
        );
        return;
      }

      if (
        file.size &&
        file.size > 12 * 1024 * 1024
      ) {
        classImageEditorSetStatus(
          'That file is over 12 MB. Choose a smaller image or GIF.',
          true
        );
        return;
      }

      fileToDataUrl(
        file,
        function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (error || !dataUrl) {
            classImageEditorSetStatus(
              error && error.message
                ? error.message
                : 'Could not read that image.',
              true
            );
            return;
          }

          classImageEditorNewFile = {
            dataUrl: dataUrl,
            name:
              file.name ||
              'class-image'
          };

          classImageEditState = {
            sourceUrl: dataUrl,
            zoom: 1,
            focusX: 50,
            focusY: 50
          };

          applyClassImageEditorPreview();

          classImageEditorSetStatus(
            file.type === 'image/gif'
              ? 'Animated GIF ready. Position it, zoom it, then save.'
              : 'Image ready. Position it, zoom it, then save.',
            false
          );
        }
      );
    }

    function nudgeClassImageZoom(delta) {
      if (!classImageEditState) return;

      classImageEditState.zoom =
        classImageEditorClamp(
          (
            Number(
              classImageEditState.zoom
            ) || 1
          ) + delta,
          1,
          3
        );

      applyClassImageEditorPreview();
    }

    var classImageSelect =
      document.getElementById(
        'classImageClassSelect'
      );

    if (classImageSelect) {
      classImageSelect.addEventListener(
        'change',
        beginClassImageEditFromOption
      );
    }

    var classImageFile =
      document.getElementById(
        'classImageFile'
      );

    if (classImageFile) {
      classImageFile.addEventListener(
        'change',
        function() {
          var file =
            this.files &&
            this.files[0];

          selectClassImageFile(
            file
          );
        }
      );
    }

    var classImageZoom =
      document.getElementById(
        'classImageZoom'
      );

    if (classImageZoom) {
      classImageZoom.addEventListener(
        'input',
        function() {
          if (!classImageEditState) {
            return;
          }

          classImageEditState.zoom =
            classImageEditorClamp(
              this.value,
              1,
              3
            );

          applyClassImageEditorPreview();
        }
      );
    }

        }
      );
    }

    if (classImageCenterButton) {
      classImageCenterButton.addEventListener(

        'classImageResetCropButton'
      );

    if (classImageResetCropButton) {
      classImageResetCropButton.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function() {
          if (!classImageEditState) return;

          classImageEditState.zoom =

          classImageEditState.focusX =

            50;

          applyClassImageEditorPreview();
        }
      );
    }

    var classImageStage =
      document.getElementById(
        'classImageCropStage'
      );

    if (classImageStage) {
      var classImageDragState = null;

      classImageStage.addEventListener(
        'pointerdown',
        function(event) {
          if (
            !classImageEditState ||
            !classImageEditState.sourceUrl
          ) {
            return;
          }

          event.preventDefault();

          classImageDragState = {
            pointerId:
              event.pointerId,
            x:
              event.clientX,
            y:
              event.clientY,
            startFocusX:
              Number(
                classImageEditState.focusX
              ) || 50,
            startFocusY:
              Number(
                classImageEditState.focusY
              ) || 50
          };

          classImageStage.classList.add(
            'dragging'
          );

          try {
            classImageStage.setPointerCapture(
              event.pointerId
            );
          } catch (error) {}
        }
      );

      classImageStage.addEventListener(
        'pointermove',
        function(event) {
          if (
            !classImageDragState ||
            !classImageEditState ||
            event.pointerId !==
              classImageDragState.pointerId
          ) {
            return;
          }

          var rect =
            classImageStage.getBoundingClientRect();

          if (
            !rect.width ||
            !rect.height
          ) {
            return;
          }

          var dx =
            event.clientX -
            classImageDragState.x;

          var dy =
            event.clientY -
            classImageDragState.y;

          classImageEditState.focusX =
            classImageEditorClamp(
              classImageDragState.startFocusX -
              (
                dx /
                rect.width *
                100
              ),
              0,
              100
            );

          classImageEditState.focusY =
            classImageEditorClamp(
              classImageDragState.startFocusY -
              (
                dy /
                rect.height *
                100
              ),
              0,
              100
            );

          applyClassImageEditorPreview();
        }
      );

      function endClassImageDrag(event) {
        if (
          !classImageDragState ||
          (
            event &&
            event.pointerId !==
              classImageDragState.pointerId
          )
        ) {
          return;
        }

        classImageDragState = null;

        classImageStage.classList.remove(
          'dragging'
        );
      }

      classImageStage.addEventListener(
        'pointerup',
        endClassImageDrag
      );

      classImageStage.addEventListener(
        'pointercancel',
        endClassImageDrag
      );

      classImageStage.addEventListener(
        'wheel',
        function(event) {
          if (
            !classImageEditState ||
            !classImageEditState.sourceUrl
          ) {
            return;
          }

          event.preventDefault();

          nudgeClassImageZoom(
            event.deltaY < 0
              ? 0.08
              : -0.08
          );
        },
        {
          passive: false
        }
      );
    }

    var saveClassImageButton =
      document.getElementById(
        'saveClassImageButton'
      );

    if (saveClassImageButton) {
      saveClassImageButton.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function() {
          var item =
            getSelectedClassImageOption();

          if (
            !item ||
            !classImageEditState ||
            !classImageEditState.sourceUrl
          ) {
            return;
          }

          saveClassImageButton.disabled =
            true;

          classImageEditorSetStatus(
            'Saving…',
            false
          );

          var crop = {
            zoom:
              classImageEditorClamp(
                classImageEditState.zoom,
                1,
                3
              ),
            focusX:
              classImageEditorClamp(
                classImageEditState.focusX,
                0,
                100
              ),
            focusY:
              classImageEditorClamp(
                classImageEditState.focusY,
                0,
                100
              )
          };

          var runner =
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(
                function(saved) {
                  item.hasImage = true;
                  item.imageUrl =
                    saved.imageUrl ||
                    classImageEditState.sourceUrl;
                  item.zoom =
                    saved.zoom;
                  item.focusX =
                    saved.focusX;
                  item.focusY =
                    saved.focusY;

                  classImageEditorNewFile =
                    null;

                  classImageEditState = {
                    sourceUrl:
                      item.imageUrl,
                    zoom:
                      item.zoom,
                    focusX:
                      item.focusX,
                    focusY:
                      item.focusY
                  };

                  updateRosterClassImageFromEditor(
                    item
                  );

                  refreshVisibleClassCardsAfterImageLoad();

                  renderClassImageClassOptions();

                  document
                    .getElementById(
                      'classImageClassSelect'
                    )
                    .value =
                    String(item.rowNumber);

                  applyClassImageEditorPreview();

                  classImageEditorSetStatus(
                    saved.warning ||
                    'Class image saved.',
                    false
                  );
                }
              )
              .withFailureHandler(
                function(error) {
                  updateClassImageEditorButtons();

                  classImageEditorSetStatus(
                    error && error.message
                      ? error.message
                      : 'Class image could not be saved.',
                    true
                  );
                }
              );

          if (
            classImageEditorNewFile &&
            classImageEditorNewFile.dataUrl
          ) {
            runner.saveClassImageUpload(
              Number(item.rowNumber),
              classImageEditorNewFile.dataUrl,
              classImageEditorNewFile.name,
              crop
            );
          } else {
            runner.saveClassImageCrop(
              Number(item.rowNumber),
              crop
            );
          }
        }
      );
    }

    var removeClassImageButton =
      document.getElementById(
        'removeClassImageButton'
      );

    if (removeClassImageButton) {
      removeClassImageButton.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function() {
          var item =
            getSelectedClassImageOption();

          if (!item) return;

          removeClassImageButton.disabled =
            true;

          classImageEditorSetStatus(
            'Removing…',
            false
          );

          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(
              function() {
                item.hasImage = false;
                item.imageUrl = '';
                item.zoom = 1;
                item.focusX = 50;
                item.focusY = 50;

                classImageEditorNewFile =
                  null;

                classImageEditState = {
                  sourceUrl: '',
                  zoom: 1,
                  focusX: 50,
                  focusY: 50
                };

                updateRosterClassImageFromEditor(
                  item
                );

                refreshVisibleClassCardsAfterImageLoad();

                renderClassImageClassOptions();

                document
                  .getElementById(
                    'classImageClassSelect'
                  )
                  .value =
                  String(item.rowNumber);

                applyClassImageEditorPreview();

                classImageEditorSetStatus(
                  'Class image removed.',
                  false
                );
              }
            )
            .withFailureHandler(
              function(error) {
                updateClassImageEditorButtons();

                classImageEditorSetStatus(
                  error && error.message
                    ? error.message
                    : 'Class image could not be removed.',
                  true
                );
              }
            )
            .removeClassImage(
              Number(item.rowNumber)
            );
        }
      );
    }


    function kioskFillReminderSettings() {
      var r = kioskReminderSettings || {};
      var set = function(id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = v; };
      set('settingReminderMinutes', r.minutes != null ? r.minutes : 6);
      set('settingReminderTrips', r.trips != null ? r.trips : 3);
      set('settingReminderGrace', r.graceMinutes != null ? r.graceMinutes : 5);
      set('settingPassCount', r.passCount != null ? r.passCount : 2);
      var pe = document.getElementById('settingPatternEmail');
      if (pe) pe.checked = r.patternEmail !== false;
      var se = document.getElementById('settingStudentEmail');
      if (se) se.checked = r.studentEmail === true;
      var fe = document.getElementById('settingFridayEmail');
      if (fe) fe.checked = r.fridayEmail !== false;
      [['settingWeekTitle', 'weekTitle'], ['settingWeekText', 'weekText'], ['settingRedTitle', 'redTitle'], ['settingRedText', 'redText']].forEach(function(f) {
        var el = document.getElementById(f[0]);
        if (!el) return;
        el.value = r[f[1]] || '';
        el.placeholder = KIOSK_REMINDER_WORDING[f[1]];      // the standard wording, in gray
      });
      var mailList = document.getElementById('settingEmailClasses');
      if (mailList) {
        var mailOff = r.emailOffClasses || [];
        mailList.innerHTML = '';
        (studentRoster || []).forEach(function(group) {
          var key = kioskClassKey(group);
          var label = document.createElement('label');
          label.className = 'reminder-class';
          var box = document.createElement('input');
          box.type = 'checkbox';
          box.value = key;
          box.checked = mailOff.indexOf(key) === -1;
          label.appendChild(box);
          label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ' + (group.label || (group.period + ' ' + group.classTitle))));
          mailList.appendChild(label);
        });
      }
      var list = document.getElementById('settingReminderClasses');
      if (!list) return;
      var off = r.offClasses || [];
      list.innerHTML = '';
      (studentRoster || []).forEach(function(group) {
        var key = kioskClassKey(group);
        var label = document.createElement('label');
        label.className = 'reminder-class';
        var box = document.createElement('input');
        box.type = 'checkbox';
        box.value = key;
        box.checked = off.indexOf(key) === -1;
        label.appendChild(box);
        label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ' + (group.label || (group.period + ' ' + group.classTitle))));
        list.appendChild(label);
      });
    }

    function kioskReadReminderSettings() {
      var num = function(id, fallback) { var v = Number((document.getElementById(id) || {}).value); return isFinite(v) && v !== 0 || id === 'settingReminderGrace' ? v : fallback; };
      var off = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('#settingReminderClasses input[type=checkbox]').forEach(function(box) {
        if (!box.checked) off.push(box.value);
      });
      return {
        minutes: num('settingReminderMinutes', 6),
        trips: num('settingReminderTrips', 3),
        graceMinutes: num('settingReminderGrace', 5),
        passCount: (function() { var v = Number((document.getElementById('settingPassCount') || {}).value); return isFinite(v) ? v : 2; })(),
        offClasses: off,
        patternEmail: !!(document.getElementById('settingPatternEmail') || {}).checked,
        studentEmail: !!(document.getElementById('settingStudentEmail') || {}).checked,
        fridayEmail: !!(document.getElementById('settingFridayEmail') || {}).checked,
        weekTitle: (document.getElementById('settingWeekTitle') || {}).value || '',
        weekText: (document.getElementById('settingWeekText') || {}).value || '',
        redTitle: (document.getElementById('settingRedTitle') || {}).value || '',
        redText: (document.getElementById('settingRedText') || {}).value || '',
        emailOffClasses: Array.prototype.filter.call(
          document.querySelectorAll('#settingEmailClasses input[type=checkbox]'),
          function(box) { return !box.checked; }).map(function(box) { return box.value; })
      };
    }

    function activateSettingsTab(tabName) {
      currentSettingsTab =
        tabName || 'appearance';

      document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-button').forEach(
        function(button) {
          button.classList.toggle(
            'active',
            button.getAttribute('data-tab') === tabName
          );
        }
      );

      document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-panel').forEach(
        function(panel) {
          panel.classList.toggle(
            'active',
            panel.getAttribute('data-panel') === tabName
          );
        }
      );

      // Class pictures now sit on the Students & Classes tab.
      if (tabName === 'students' || tabName === 'classes') {
        loadClassImageEditorOptions(false);
      }

      if (tabName === 'birthday') {
        if (
          kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false
        ) {
          preloadBirthdayVideoAsset();
        }

        if (
          kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false
        ) {
          preloadBirthdaySoundAsset();
        }
      }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-button').forEach(
      function(button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function() {
          activateSettingsTab(
            button.getAttribute('data-tab')
          );
        });
      }
    );

    function persistBirthdayToggleChoices() {
      var videoToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdayVideoEnabled'
        );

      var soundToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdaySoundEnabled'
        );

      var messageToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdayMessageEnabled'
        );

      var videoEnabled =
        videoToggle
          ? !!videoToggle.checked
          : kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false;

      var soundEnabled =
        soundToggle
          ? !!soundToggle.checked
          : kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false;

      var messageEnabled =
        messageToggle
          ? !!messageToggle.checked
          : kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false;

      /* Update local state first so Preview always follows the latest click. */
      kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled =
        videoEnabled;

      kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled =
        soundEnabled;

      kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled =
        messageEnabled;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(saved) {
          saved = saved || {};

          /* Only accept the server echo for these three fields. Do not call
             applyKioskSettings/populateSettingsForm, which would refresh tabs. */
          if (
            typeof saved.birthdayVideoEnabled ===
              'boolean'
          ) {
            kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled =
              saved.birthdayVideoEnabled;
          }

          if (
            typeof saved.birthdaySoundEnabled ===
              'boolean'
          ) {
            kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled =
              saved.birthdaySoundEnabled;
          }

          if (
            typeof saved.birthdayMessageEnabled ===
              'boolean'
          ) {
            kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled =
              saved.birthdayMessageEnabled;
          }

          updateBirthdaySettingsDisplay();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function() {
          /* Keep the current UI/local choice. A normal SAVE can retry later. */
        })
        .saveBirthdayToggleSettings(
          videoEnabled,
          soundEnabled,
          messageEnabled
        );
    }


    var birthdayVideoToggle =
      document.getElementById(
        'settingBirthdayVideoEnabled'
      );

    if (birthdayVideoToggle) {
      birthdayVideoToggle.addEventListener(
        'change',
        function() {
          kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled =
            !!birthdayVideoToggle.checked;

          /* Do not clear a successfully loaded video when toggled OFF.
             Keeping it warm means turning it back ON can preview immediately. */
          if (
            kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled &&
            !birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl
          ) {
            preloadBirthdayVideoAsset();
          }

          persistBirthdayToggleChoices();
        }
      );
    }

    var birthdaySoundToggle =
      document.getElementById(
        'settingBirthdaySoundEnabled'
      );

    if (birthdaySoundToggle) {
      birthdaySoundToggle.addEventListener(
        'change',
        function() {
          kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled =
            !!birthdaySoundToggle.checked;

          if (
            kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled &&
            !birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer
          ) {
            preloadBirthdaySoundAsset();
          }

          persistBirthdayToggleChoices();
        }
      );
    }


    var birthdayMessageToggle =
      document.getElementById(
        'settingBirthdayMessageEnabled'
      );

    if (birthdayMessageToggle) {
      birthdayMessageToggle.addEventListener(
        'change',
        function() {
          kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled =
            !!birthdayMessageToggle.checked;

          persistBirthdayToggleChoices();
        }
      );
    }


    function syncTitleOrderHiddenInput() {
      var list = document.getElementById('titleOrderList');
      var hidden = document.getElementById('settingTitleOrder');
      if (!list || !hidden) return;

      var first = list.querySelector('.title-order-item');
      hidden.value =
        first && first.getAttribute('data-title-part') === 'big'
          ? 'Big First'
          : 'Small First';
    }

    function applyTitleOrderToSettingsList(order) {
      var list = document.getElementById('titleOrderList');
      if (!list) return;

      var small = list.querySelector('[data-title-part="small"]');
      var big = list.querySelector('[data-title-part="big"]');
      if (!small || !big) return;

      if (order === 'Big First') {
        list.appendChild(big);
        list.appendChild(small);
      } else {
        list.appendChild(small);
        list.appendChild(big);
      }

      syncTitleOrderHiddenInput();
    }

    (function initTitleOrderDrag() {
      var list = document.getElementById('titleOrderList');
      if (!list) return;

      var dragged = null;

      list.querySelectorAll('.title-order-item').forEach(function(item) {
        item.addEventListener('dragstart', function() {
          dragged = item;
          item.classList.add('dragging');
        });

        item.addEventListener('dragend', function() {
          item.classList.remove('dragging');
          dragged = null;
          syncTitleOrderHiddenInput();
        });

        item.addEventListener('dragover', function(event) {
          event.preventDefault();
        });

        item.addEventListener('drop', function(event) {
          event.preventDefault();

          if (!dragged || dragged === item) return;

          var draggedWasBefore =
            !!(dragged.compareDocumentPosition(item) &
              Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);

          if (draggedWasBefore) {
            // Dragging the top row down: place it AFTER the other row.
            list.insertBefore(dragged, item.nextSibling);
          } else {
            // Dragging the bottom row up: place it BEFORE the other row.
            list.insertBefore(dragged, item);
          }

          syncTitleOrderHiddenInput();

          // Preview the new order immediately on the kiosk behind Settings.
          kioskSettings.titleOrder =
            document.getElementById('settingTitleOrder').value;
          renderTitles();
        });
      });
    })();


    function setAttendanceEnabledControls(value) {
      var normalized =
        value === true ||
        String(value || '')
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase() === 'ON'
          ? 'ON'
          : 'OFF';

      var displayControl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceEnabledDisplay'
        );

      var attendanceControl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceEnabledAttendance'
        );

      if (displayControl) {
        displayControl.value = normalized;
      }

      if (attendanceControl) {
        attendanceControl.value = normalized;
      }
    }

    function getAttendanceEnabledFromSettings() {
      var displayControl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceEnabledDisplay'
        );

      var attendanceControl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceEnabledAttendance'
        );

      var value =
        displayControl
          ? displayControl.value
          : (
              attendanceControl
                ? attendanceControl.value
                : (
                    attendanceSettings.enabled
                      ? 'ON'
                      : 'OFF'
                  )
            );

      return value === 'ON';
    }

    function syncAttendanceToggleFrom(sourceId) {
      var source =
        document.getElementById(sourceId);

      if (!source) return;

      var enabled =
        String(source.value || '')
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase() === 'ON';

      /* Whichever control the teacher changed most recently becomes
         authoritative. Immediately mirror that value into the other
         Attendance control. */
      setAttendanceEnabledControls(
        enabled
      );

      /* Update the live Attendance setting immediately too, so Display
         and Attendance are two controls for the exact same feature rather
         than two settings that only reconcile after Save. */
      attendanceSettings.enabled =
        enabled;

      var panel =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceSidePanel'
        );

      if (panel) {
        panel.classList.toggle(
          'hidden',
          !enabled
        );
      }

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'attendance-side-on',
        enabled
      );

      updatePassingPeriodPriority(
        bellScheduleStatus
      );

      /* Re-render from the current class so turning Attendance back ON
         restores the actual attendance menu immediately. */
      renderAttendanceSidePanel(
        preferredAttendanceGroup()
      );

      applyDisplayPanelSettings();

      /* Layout positions stay fixed; this simply lets child fitters respond
         to the panel's contents without moving the Hall Pass column. */
      if (
        typeof window.applyStableLayout ===
          'function'
      ) {
        window.applyStableLayout();
      }
    }


    function populateSettingsForm() {
      document.getElementById('settingTopTitle').value =
        kioskSettings.topTitle || "";

      document.getElementById('settingMainTitle').value =
        kioskSettings.mainTitle || "";

      applyTitleOrderToSettingsList(
        kioskSettings.titleOrder || "Small First"
      );

      populateMinuteSelect(
        'settingGreen',
        kioskSettings.greenThroughMinutes
      );

      populateMinuteSelect(
        'settingYellow',
        kioskSettings.yellowThroughMinutes
      );

      updateTimingExplanation();

      document.getElementById('settingMenuStyle').value =
        kioskSettings.studentMenuStyle;

      document.getElementById('settingClassSelectionMode').value =
        kioskSettings.classSelectionMode || "Manual";

      document.getElementById(
        'settingOutOfClassroomEnabled'
      ).value =
        kioskSettings.outOfClassroomEnabled === false
          ? 'OFF'
          : 'ON';

      document.getElementById(
        'settingDisplayedBellScheduleEnabled'
      ).value =
        kioskSettings.displayedBellScheduleEnabled === false
          ? 'OFF'
          : 'ON';

      document.getElementById(
        'settingLiveBellScheduleEnabled'
      ).value =
        kioskSettings.liveBellScheduleEnabled === false
          ? 'OFF'
          : 'ON';

      document.getElementById(
        'settingLiveBellScheduleUrl'
      ).value =
        kioskSettings.liveBellScheduleUrl ||
        "https://bell.plus/907263";

      setAttendanceEnabledControls(
        attendanceSettings.enabled
      );

      updateBirthdaySettingsDisplay();

      var confirmationEl =
        document.getElementById('settingAttendanceConfirmation');
      if (confirmationEl) {
        confirmationEl.value =
          String(attendanceSettings.confirmationMinutes || 2);

        if (!confirmationEl.value) {
          confirmationEl.value = '2';
        }
      }

      var tardyGraceEl =
        document.getElementById('settingTardyGrace');

      if (tardyGraceEl) {
        tardyGraceEl.value =
          String(
            attendanceSettings.tardyGraceSeconds == null
              ? 30
              : attendanceSettings.tardyGraceSeconds
          );
      }

      var thresholdEl =
        document.getElementById('settingAbsenceThreshold');
      if (thresholdEl) {
        thresholdEl.value =
          String(attendanceSettings.absenceAlertThreshold || 3);
      }

      var uncheckedOutEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingUncheckedOutMinutes'
        );

      if (uncheckedOutEl) {
        uncheckedOutEl.value =
          String(
            attendanceSettings.uncheckedOutMinutes == null
              ? 5
              : attendanceSettings.uncheckedOutMinutes
          );

        if (!uncheckedOutEl.value) {
          uncheckedOutEl.value = '5';
        }
      }

      var reportEnabledEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceReportEnabled'
        );

      if (reportEnabledEl) {
        reportEnabledEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.reportEnabled === false
            ? 'OFF'
            : 'ON';
      }

      var reportTimeEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceReportTime'
        );

      if (reportTimeEl) {
        reportTimeEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.reportTime ||
          '15:15';
      }

      var reportEmailEnabledEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceReportEmailEnabled'
        );

      if (reportEmailEnabledEl) {
        reportEmailEnabledEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.reportEmailEnabled === false
            ? 'OFF'
            : 'ON';
      }

      var reportEmailEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceReportEmail'
        );

      if (reportEmailEl) {
        reportEmailEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.reportEmail || '';
      }

      [
        [
          'settingReportIncludePresent',
          'reportIncludePresent'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeTardy',
          'reportIncludeTardy'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeAbsent',
          'reportIncludeAbsent'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeNeverReturned',
          'reportIncludeNeverReturned'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeEarlyDepartures',
          'reportIncludeEarlyDepartures'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeCounts',
          'reportIncludeCounts'
        ],
        [
          'settingReportIncludeAbsenceAlerts',
          'reportIncludeAbsenceAlerts'
        ]
      ].forEach(function(pair) {
        var input =
          document.getElementById(
            pair[0]
          );

        if (input) {
          input.checked =
            attendanceSettings[
              pair[1]
            ] !== false;
        }
      });

      var reportReconcileEl =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingAttendanceReportReconcile'
        );

      if (reportReconcileEl) {
        reportReconcileEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.reportReconcile === false
            ? 'OFF'
            : 'ON';
      }

      if (
        typeof loadAttendanceReportAutomationStatus ===
          'function'
      ) {
        loadAttendanceReportAutomationStatus();
      }


      var finalizationEl =
        document.getElementById('settingAttendanceFinalization');
      if (finalizationEl) {
        finalizationEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.finalization || 'Class End';
      }

      var emojiModeEl =
        document.getElementById('settingAttendanceEmojiMode');
      if (emojiModeEl) {
        emojiModeEl.value =
          attendanceSettings.emojiMode || 'Random Bank';
      }

      updateMenuStyleTiles();
      populateBackgroundSelect();
      renderFontOptions();

      document.getElementById('settingsMessage').textContent = '';

      var attendanceReportTestEmailStatus =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceReportTestEmailStatus'
        );

      if (attendanceReportTestEmailStatus) {
        attendanceReportTestEmailStatus.textContent = '';
      }

      var attendanceReportLiveStatus =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceReportLiveStatus'
        );

      if (attendanceReportLiveStatus) {
        attendanceReportLiveStatus.textContent = '';
      }

      var birthdayPreviewStatus =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdayPreviewStatus'
        );

      if (birthdayPreviewStatus) {
        birthdayPreviewStatus.textContent = '';
      }

      var birthdayVideoUploadStatus =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdayVideoUploadStatus'
        );

      if (birthdayVideoUploadStatus) {
        birthdayVideoUploadStatus.textContent = '';
      }

      var birthdaySoundUploadStatus =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdaySoundUploadStatus'
        );

      if (birthdaySoundUploadStatus) {
        birthdaySoundUploadStatus.textContent = '';
      }

      document.getElementById('backgroundUploadStatus').textContent = '';
      var fontUploadStatus = document.getElementById('fontUploadStatus');
      if (fontUploadStatus) fontUploadStatus.textContent = '';
      document.getElementById('backgroundUploadName').value = '';
      document.getElementById('backgroundUploadFile').value = '';
      var fontUploadFiles = document.getElementById('fontUploadFiles');
      if (fontUploadFiles) fontUploadFiles.value = '';

      activateSettingsTab(
        currentSettingsTab || 'appearance'
      );
    }

    function openSettings(event) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }

      settingsPanelOpen = true;
      currentSettingsTab = 'appearance';

      var panel = document.getElementById('settingsPanel');
      if (!panel) return false;

      panel.classList.remove('hidden');
      panel.style.display = 'block';
      panel.style.visibility = 'visible';
      panel.style.opacity = '1';
      panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

      try {
        populateSettingsForm();
        kioskFillReminderSettings();
        loadStudentPhotoOptions();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Settings form initialization error:', error);
        var message = document.getElementById('settingsMessage');
        if (message) {
          message.textContent = 'Settings opened. One or more controls could not be initialized.';
          message.style.color = '#990000';
        }
      }

      return false;
    }

    function closeSettings(event) {
      if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }

      settingsPanelOpen = false;
      // Settings inside the teacher view: closing goes back to the teacher view.
      if (document.body.hasAttribute('data-settings-only')) {
        // every frame above this one (Apps Script wraps each page in 3 layers, so the teacher view is 3 or more levels up) (2026-10-17: Cancel did nothing)
        try { var up = window; for (var lv = 0; lv < 6 && up.parent && up.parent !== up; lv++) { up = up.parent; up.postMessage({ kioskSettings: 'close' }, '*'); } } catch (err) {}
        return false;
      }
      var panel = document.getElementById('settingsPanel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.classList.add('hidden');
        panel.style.display = 'none';
        panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }

      var message = document.getElementById('settingsMessage');
      if (message) message.textContent = '';
      applyBackground();
      return false;
    }

    // Explicit global hooks make the fixed navigation controls reliable
    // inside the Apps Script web-app frame.
    window.openSettings = openSettings;
    window.closeSettings = closeSettings;
    window.handleBack = goBackOneStep;

    function fileToDataUrl(file, callback) {
      var reader = new FileReader();

      reader.onload = function(event) {
        callback(null, event.target.result);
      };

      reader.onerror = function() {
        callback(new Error('Could not read that file.'));
      };

      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function clearBirthdayCelebrationAssetCache(
      kind
    ) {
      if (
        !kind ||
        kind === 'video'
      ) {
        birthdayOverlayVideoDataUrl = '';
        birthdayVideoRequested = false;
        birthdayVideoLoadError = '';
      }

      if (
        !kind ||
        kind === 'sound'
      ) {
        birthdayOverlayAudioBuffer = null;
        birthdaySoundRequested = false;
      }
    }

    function updateBirthdaySettingsDisplay() {
      var videoName =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdayVideoSourceName'
        );

      var videoNote =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdayVideoSourceNote'
        );

      var soundName =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdaySoundSourceName'
        );

      var soundNote =
        document.getElementById(
          'birthdaySoundSourceNote'
        );

      var videoToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdayVideoEnabled'
        );

      var soundToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdaySoundEnabled'
        );

      var messageToggle =
        document.getElementById(
          'settingBirthdayMessageEnabled'
        );

      if (videoToggle) {
        videoToggle.checked =
          kioskSettings.birthdayVideoEnabled !== false;
      }

      if (soundToggle) {
        soundToggle.checked =
          kioskSettings.birthdaySoundEnabled !== false;
      }

      if (messageToggle) {
        messageToggle.checked =
          kioskSettings.birthdayMessageEnabled !== false;
      }

      if (videoName) {
        videoName.textContent =
          kioskSettings.birthdayCustomVideoFileName ||
          'Default Transparent Confetti Animation';
      }

      if (videoNote) {
        videoNote.textContent =
          kioskSettings.birthdayCustomVideoFileId
            ? 'Custom uploaded video'
            : 'Default celebration video';
      }

      if (soundName) {
        soundName.textContent =
          kioskSettings.birthdayCustomSoundFileName ||
          'Default Birthday Music';
      }

      if (soundNote) {
        soundNote.textContent =
          kioskSettings.birthdayCustomSoundFileId
            ? 'Custom uploaded sound'
            : 'Default celebration sound';
      }
    }

    function uploadBirthdayCelebrationAsset(
      kind
    ) {
      var isVideo =
        kind === 'video';

      var input =
        document.getElementById(
          isVideo
            ? 'birthdayVideoUploadFile'
            : 'birthdaySoundUploadFile'
        );

      var button =
        document.getElementById(
          isVideo
            ? 'uploadBirthdayVideoButton'
            : 'uploadBirthdaySoundButton'
        );

      var status =
        document.getElementById(
          isVideo
            ? 'birthdayVideoUploadStatus'
            : 'birthdaySoundUploadStatus'
        );

      var file =
        input &&
        input.files &&
        input.files[0];

      if (!file) {
        if (status) {
          status.textContent =
            'Choose a file first.';
          status.style.color =
            '#990000';
        }
        return;
      }

      var maxBytes =
        isVideo
          ? 15 * 1024 * 1024
          : 8 * 1024 * 1024;

      if (file.size > maxBytes) {
        if (status) {
          status.textContent =
            isVideo
              ? 'Video must be 15 MB or smaller.'
              : 'Sound must be 8 MB or smaller.';
          status.style.color =
            '#990000';
        }
        return;
      }

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      if (status) {
        status.textContent =
          'Preparing upload...';
        status.style.color =
          '#647386';
      }

      fileToDataUrl(
        file,
        function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (error) {
            if (button) {
              button.disabled = false;
            }

            if (status) {
              status.textContent =
                error.message;
              status.style.color =
                '#990000';
            }

            return;
          }

          if (status) {
            status.textContent =
              'Uploading...';
          }

          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(
              function(saved) {
                applyKioskSettings(
                  saved
                );

                clearBirthdayCelebrationAssetCache(kind);

                if (input) {
                  input.value = '';
                }

                if (button) {
                  button.disabled = false;
                }

                if (status) {
                  status.textContent =
                    isVideo
                      ? 'Custom birthday video uploaded.'
                      : 'Custom birthday sound uploaded.';
                  status.style.color =
                    '#20733b';
                }

                updateBirthdaySettingsDisplay();
              }
            )
            .withFailureHandler(
              function(uploadError) {
                if (button) {
                  button.disabled = false;
                }

                if (status) {
                  status.textContent =
                    uploadError &&
                    uploadError.message
                      ? uploadError.message
                      : 'Upload failed.';
                  status.style.color =
                    '#990000';
                }
              }
            )
            .saveBirthdayCelebrationUpload(
              kind,
              file.name,
              dataUrl
            );
        }
      );
    }

        .withFailureHandler(
          function(error) {

              button.disabled = false;
            }

            if (status) {
              status.textContent =
                error &&
                error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : 'Could not restore the default.';
              status.style.color =
                '#990000';
            }
          }
        )
        .restoreDefaultBirthdayCelebrationAsset(
          kind
        );
    }

    function prepareBackgroundForUpload(file, callback) {
      fileToDataUrl(file, function(error, dataUrl) {
        if (error) {
          callback(error);
          return;
        }

        var img = new Image();

        img.onload = function() {
          var ratio = img.width / img.height;
          var target = 16 / 9;

          if (Math.abs(ratio - target) > 0.035) {
            callback(
              new Error(
                'Backgrounds must be 16:9. Try 1920×1080, 1600×900, or 1280×720.'
              )
            );
            return;
          }

          var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 1280;
          canvas.height = 720;

          var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 1280, 720);

          callback(
            null,
            canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .84)
          );
        };

        img.onerror = function() {
          callback(new Error('Could not open that image.'));
        };

        img.src = dataUrl;
      });
    }

    document.getElementById('uploadBackgroundButton').addEventListener(
      'click',
      function() {
        var input = document.getElementById('backgroundUploadFile');
        var nameInput = document.getElementById('backgroundUploadName');
        var status = document.getElementById('backgroundUploadStatus');
        var button = document.getElementById('uploadBackgroundButton');
        var file = input.files && input.files[0];

        if (!file) {
          status.textContent = 'Choose an image first.';
          status.style.color = '#990000';
          return;
        }

        button.disabled = true;
        status.textContent = 'Preparing image...';
        status.style.color = '#647386';

        prepareBackgroundForUpload(
          file,
          function(error, dataUrl) {
            if (error) {
              button.disabled = false;
              status.textContent = error.message;
              status.style.color = '#990000';
              return;
            }

            status.textContent = 'Uploading...';

            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
                backgroundOptions = result.options || [];
                kioskSettings.backgroundName = result.name;
                populateBackgroundSelect();
                document.getElementById('settingBackground').value =
                  result.name;
                updateBackgroundPreview();

                status.textContent =
                  'Uploaded as “' + result.name + '”.';
                status.style.color = '#20733b';
                button.disabled = false;
                input.value = '';
                nameInput.value = '';
              })
              .withFailureHandler(function(serverError) {
                status.textContent =
                  serverError && serverError.message
                    ? serverError.message
                    : 'Upload failed.';
                status.style.color = '#990000';
                button.disabled = false;
              })
              .saveCustomBackgroundUpload(
                file.name,
                dataUrl,
                nameInput.value.trim()
              );
          }
        );
      }
    );

    function readFontFiles(fileList, callback) {
      var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(fileList || []);

      if (!files.length) {
        callback([]);
        return;
      }

      var remaining = files.length;
      var results = [];

      files.forEach(function(file, index) {
        fileToDataUrl(file, function(error, dataUrl) {
          if (!error) {
            results[index] = {
              name: file.name,
              dataUrl: dataUrl
            };
          }

          remaining--;

          if (remaining === 0) {
            callback(results.filter(Boolean));
          }
        });
      });
    }

            liveBellScheduleUrl: liveBellScheduleUrl,
            birthdayVideoEnabled: birthdayVideoEnabled,
            birthdaySoundEnabled: birthdaySoundEnabled,
            birthdayMessageEnabled: birthdayMessageEnabled
          }, {
                enabled: attendanceEnabled,
                confirmationMinutes: attendanceConfirmation,
                tardyGraceSeconds: tardyGraceSeconds,
                absenceAlertThreshold: absenceThreshold,
                finalization: attendanceFinalization,
                emojiMode: attendanceEmojiMode,
                uncheckedOutMinutes: uncheckedOutMinutes,
                reportEnabled: reportEnabled,
                reportTime: reportTime,
                reportEmailEnabled: reportEmailEnabled,
                reportEmail: reportEmail,
                reportIncludePresent: reportIncludePresent,
                reportIncludeTardy: reportIncludeTardy,
                reportIncludeAbsent: reportIncludeAbsent,
                reportIncludeNeverReturned: reportIncludeNeverReturned,
                reportIncludeEarlyDepartures: reportIncludeEarlyDepartures,
                reportIncludeCounts: reportIncludeCounts,
                reportIncludeAbsenceAlerts: reportIncludeAbsenceAlerts,
                reportReconcile: reportReconcile
              }, reminderToSave);
      }
    );



    var attendanceEmojiResetConfirmUntil = 0;

    function clearTodayAttendanceEmojiCaches() {
      attendanceAssignedEmojiByKey = {};

      Object.keys(
        attendanceStateByKey || {}
      ).forEach(function(key) {
        if (attendanceStateByKey[key]) {
          attendanceStateByKey[key].emoji = '';
        }
      });

      Object.keys(
        attendanceStateCacheByClass || {}
      ).forEach(function(classKey) {
        var states =
          attendanceStateCacheByClass[
            classKey
          ];

        if (!states) return;

        Object.keys(states).forEach(function(key) {
          if (states[key]) {
            states[key].emoji = '';
          }
        });
      });

      try {
        var prefix =
          'hallPassAttendanceSnapshot|' +
          attendanceLocalDateKey() +
          '|';

        var removeKeys = [];

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < localStorage.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var key =
            localStorage.key(i);

          if (
            key &&
            key.indexOf(prefix) === 0
          ) {
            removeKeys.push(key);
          }
        }

        removeKeys.forEach(function(key) {
          localStorage.removeItem(key);
        });
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function resetAttendanceEmojisFromSettings() {
      var button =
        document.getElementById(
          'resetAttendanceEmojisButton'
        );

      var message =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceEmojiResetMessage'
        );

      if (!button || !message) return;

      if (
        Date.now() >
        attendanceEmojiResetConfirmUntil
      ) {
        attendanceEmojiResetConfirmUntil =
          Date.now() + 5000;

        button.textContent =
          '⚠️ CLICK AGAIN TO CONFIRM';

        message.textContent =
          'This clears today’s emojis only. Attendance records and times stay the same.';

        setTimeout(function() {
          if (
            Date.now() >=
            attendanceEmojiResetConfirmUntil
          ) {
            button.textContent =
              '🎲 CLEAR / RESET TODAY’S EMOJIS';
            message.textContent = '';
          }
        }, 5100);

        return;
      }

      attendanceEmojiResetConfirmUntil = 0;
      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = 'CLEARING…';

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
          if (result && result.emojiPlan) {
            applyEmojiPlan(result.emojiPlan);
          }

          clearTodayAttendanceEmojiCaches();

          Object.keys(
            attendanceStateByKey || {}
          ).forEach(function(key) {
            if (attendanceStateByKey[key]) {
              attendanceStateByKey[key].emoji = '';
            }
          });

          renderAttendanceStates();

          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent =
            '🎲 CLEAR / RESET TODAY’S EMOJIS';

          message.textContent =
            String(
              result &&
              result.resetCount
                ? result.resetCount
                : 0
            ) +
            ' student emoji assignment(s) cleared for today.';

          if (selectedClass) {
            loadAttendanceForGroup(
              selectedClass
            );
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent =
            '🎲 CLEAR / RESET TODAY’S EMOJIS';

          message.textContent =
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : 'Could not reset today’s emojis.';
        })
        .resetAttendanceEmojisForToday();
    }

    var resetAttendanceEmojisButton =

      resetAttendanceEmojisButton

    function renderAttendanceReportAutomationStatus(
      result
    ) {
      var el =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceReportAutomationStatus'
        );

      var button =
        document.getElementById(
          'refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton'
        );

      if (!el) return;

      result = result || {};

      if (
        result.enabled === false &&
        !result.installed
      ) {
        el.textContent =
          'Automatic reports are OFF. No daily schedule is installed.';
        el.style.color =
          '#6d7480';

        if (button) {
          button.textContent =
            '⏰ ENABLE AUTOMATIC DAILY REPORT';
          button.dataset.automationAction =
            'install';
        }

        return;
      }

      var time =
        String(
          result.time || '15:15'
        );

      var parts =
        time.split(':');

      var hour =
        Number(
          parts[0] || 15
        );

      var minute =
        Number(
          parts[1] || 15
        );

      var suffix =
        hour >= 12
          ? 'PM'
          : 'AM';

      var displayHour =
        hour % 12 || 12;

      var displayTime =
        displayHour +
        ':' +
        String(minute).padStart(2, '0') +
        ' ' +
        suffix;

      if (result.installed) {
        el.textContent =
          'Installed • Daily around ' +
          displayTime +
          ' • ' +
          (
            result.emailEnabled
              ? (
                  result.recipient
                    ? 'Email to ' + result.recipient
                    : 'Email is ON but no recipient is saved'
                )
              : 'Email is OFF'
          );

        el.style.color =
          result.emailEnabled &&
          !result.recipient
            ? '#8a5a00'
            : '#20733b';

        if (button) {
          button.textContent =
            '🛑 TURN OFF AUTOMATIC DAILY REPORT';
          button.dataset.automationAction =
            'uninstall';
          button.classList.add(
            'attendance-report-automation-button-off'
          );
        }
      } else {
        el.textContent =
          'Automatic delivery is not enabled yet.';
        el.style.color =
          '#990000';

        if (button) {
          button.textContent =
            '⏰ ENABLE AUTOMATIC DAILY REPORT';
          button.dataset.automationAction =
            'install';
          button.classList.remove(
            'attendance-report-automation-button-off'
          );
        }
      }
    }

    function installAttendanceReportAutomation() {
      var button =
        document.getElementById(
          'refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton'
        );

      var action =
        button &&
        button.dataset &&
        button.dataset.automationAction ===
          'uninstall'
          ? 'uninstall'
          : 'install';

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      var el =
        document.getElementById(
          'attendanceReportAutomationStatus'
        );

      if (el) {
        el.textContent =
          action === 'uninstall'
            ? 'Turning off automatic daily reports…'
            : 'Enabling automatic daily reports…';

        el.style.color =
          '#65778a';
      }

      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
            if (button) {
              button.disabled = false;
            }

            renderAttendanceReportAutomationStatus(
              result
            );
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            if (button) {
              button.disabled = false;
            }

            if (el) {
              el.textContent =
                error &&
                error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : (
                      action === 'uninstall'
                        ? 'Could not turn off the automatic report.'
                        : 'Could not enable the automatic report.'
                    );

              el.style.color =
                '#990000';
            }
          });

      if (action === 'uninstall') {
        runner
          .uninstallAttendanceReportAutomation();
      } else {
        runner
          .installOrRefreshAttendanceReportAutomation();
      }
    }

    var refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton =
      document.getElementById(
        'refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton'
      );

    if (refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton) {
      refreshAttendanceReportAutomationButton
        .addEventListener(
          'click',
          installAttendanceReportAutomation
        );
    }

    /* Floating Bell Plus window — personal edition only. */
    function clampNumber(value, min, max) {
      return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    function saveBellPlusFloatingState() {
      var box = document.getElementById('bellPlusEmbed');
      if (!box) return;

      var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();

      try {
        localStorage.setItem(
          'hallPassBellPlusFloating',
          JSON.stringify({
            left: Math.round(rect.left),
            top: Math.round(rect.top),
            width: Math.round(rect.width),
            height: Math.round(rect.height)
          })
        );
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function restoreBellPlusFloatingState() {
      var box = document.getElementById('bellPlusEmbed');
      if (!box) return;

      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('hallPassBellPlusFloating');
        if (!raw) return;

        var state = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (!state) return;

        box.setAttribute('data-user-positioned', 'true');

        var width = clampNumber(
          Number(state.width) || 360,
          240,
          Math.max(240, window.innerWidth - 20)
        );

        var height = clampNumber(
          Number(state.height) || 220,
          150,
          Math.max(150, window.innerHeight - 20)
        );

        var left = clampNumber(
          Number(state.left) || 10,
          8,
          Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - width - 8)
        );

        var top = clampNumber(
          Number(state.top) || 10,
          8,
          Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - height - 8)
        );

        box.style.left = left + 'px';
        box.style.top = top + 'px';
        box.style.right = 'auto';
        box.style.bottom = 'auto';
        box.style.width = width + 'px';
        box.style.height = height + 'px';
      } catch (error) {}
    }

    function initializeBellPlusFloating() {
      // Bell Plus is fixed in place. Its embedded page remains scrollable.
      return;
    }
