    function loadClassCardImagesDeferred() {
      (studentRoster || []).forEach(
        function(group) {
          if (
            !group ||
            group.classImageUrl
          ) {
            return;
          }

          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(
              function(result) {
                var imageUrl =
                  result &&
                  result.imageUrl
                    ? String(result.imageUrl)
                    : '';

                if (!imageUrl) {
                  console.warn(
                    'No class image returned for ' +
                    group.key
                  );
                  return;
                }

                group.classImageUrl =
                  imageUrl;

                console.log(
                  'Class image loaded for ' +
                  group.key
                );

                refreshVisibleClassCardsAfterImageLoad();
              }
            )
            .withFailureHandler(
              function(error) {
                console.warn(
                  'Class image failed for ' +
                  group.key +
                  ':',
                  error
                );
              }
            )
            .getClassImageForDisplay(
              group.period,
              group.classTitle
            );
        }
      );
    }


    /* ===== Student photos: fast, cached, batched =====
       1. Photos remembered on this device show instantly (IndexedDB).
       2. Fresh photos are fetched in small batches, the class on screen
          first, so one slow photo can never block everyone else.
       3. Remembered copies are shrunk to kiosk size (288px) so they stay
          small. */
    var STUDENT_PHOTO_BATCH_SIZE = 10;
    var STUDENT_PHOTO_PARALLEL_BATCHES = 3;
    var STUDENT_PHOTO_CACHE_PX = 288;
    var studentPhotoMemory = {};
    var studentPhotoQueue = [];
    var studentPhotoQueued = {};
    var studentPhotoActiveBatches = 0;
    var studentPhotoRefreshTimer = null;

    function studentPhotoKey(student) {
      return (
        String(student && student.rowNumber || '') + '|' +
        String(student && (student.fullName || student.name) || '')
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase() + '|' +
        String(student && student.id || '').trim()
      );
    }

    var studentPhotoDbPromise = (function() {
      try {
        if (!window.indexedDB) return Promise.resolve(null);

        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
          var request;

          try {
            request = indexedDB.open('hallPassStudentPhotos', 1);
          } catch (err) {
            resolve(null);
            return;
          }

          request.onupgradeneeded = function() {
            request.result.createObjectStore('photos');
          };
          request.onsuccess = function() { resolve(request.result); };
          request.onerror = function() { resolve(null); };
          request.onblocked = function() { resolve(null); };
        });
      } catch (err) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }
    })();

    var studentPhotoCacheLoaded = studentPhotoDbPromise.then(function(db) {
      if (!db) return;

      return new Promise(function(resolve) {
        try {
          var store = db
            .transaction('photos', 'readonly')
            .objectStore('photos');
          var cursorRequest = store.openCursor();

          cursorRequest.onsuccess = function() {
            var cursor = cursorRequest.result;

            if (cursor) {
              if (!studentPhotoMemory[cursor.key]) {
                studentPhotoMemory[cursor.key] = cursor.value;
              }
              cursor.continue();
            } else {
              resolve();
            }
          };
          cursorRequest.onerror = function() { resolve(); };
        } catch (err) {
          resolve();
        }
      });
    });

    function writeStudentPhotoCache(key, value) {
      studentPhotoDbPromise.then(function(db) {
        if (!db) return;

        try {
          var store = db
            .transaction('photos', 'readwrite')
            .objectStore('photos');

          if (value) {
            store.put(value, key);
          } else {
            store.delete(key);
          }
        } catch (err) {}
      });
    }

    function shrinkStudentPhoto(dataUrl, callback) {
      if (!/^data:image\//i.test(String(dataUrl || ''))) {
        callback('');
        return;
      }

      var img = new Image();

      img.onload = function() {
        try {
          var scale = Math.min(
            1,
            STUDENT_PHOTO_CACHE_PX / Math.max(img.width, img.height)
          );
          var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * scale));
          canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));

          var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

          callback(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86));
        } catch (err) {
          callback('');
        }
      };

      img.onerror = function() { callback(''); };
      img.src = dataUrl;
    }

    function forEachRosterStudent(fn) {
      (studentRoster || []).forEach(function(group) {
        (group.students || []).forEach(function(student) {
          fn(student, group);
        });
      });
    }

    // Puts every photo we already know about onto the roster.
    function applyKnownStudentPhotos() {
      var changed = false;

      forEachRosterStudent(function(student) {
        var url = studentPhotoMemory[studentPhotoKey(student)];

        if (url && student.imageUrl !== url) {
          student.imageUrl = url;
          changed = true;
        }
      });

      return changed;
    }

    function refreshVisibleStudentPhotos() {
      if (selectedClass) {
        renderStudentCards(selectedClass);

        if (attendanceSettings.enabled) {
          renderAttendanceSidePanel(selectedClass);
        }
      } else {
        populateGroupedDropdown();
        renderStudentMenuStyle();

        if (
          attendanceSettings.enabled &&
          typeof preferredAttendanceGroup === 'function'
        ) {
          var attendanceGroup = preferredAttendanceGroup();

          if (attendanceGroup) {
            renderAttendanceSidePanel(attendanceGroup);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Several batches can finish close together; redraw once for all of them.
    function scheduleStudentPhotoRefresh() {
      if (studentPhotoRefreshTimer) return;

      studentPhotoRefreshTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        studentPhotoRefreshTimer = null;
        refreshVisibleStudentPhotos();
      }, 150);
    }

    function queueStudentPhotoRows(rows, toFront) {
      var fresh = [];

      rows.forEach(function(row) {
        row = Number(row);

        if (!row || studentPhotoQueued[row]) return;

        studentPhotoQueued[row] = true;
        fresh.push(row);
      });

      studentPhotoQueue = toFront
        ? fresh.concat(studentPhotoQueue)
        : studentPhotoQueue.concat(fresh);

      pumpStudentPhotoQueue();
    }

    function pumpStudentPhotoQueue() {
      while (
        studentPhotoActiveBatches < STUDENT_PHOTO_PARALLEL_BATCHES &&
        studentPhotoQueue.length
      ) {
        runStudentPhotoBatch(
          studentPhotoQueue.splice(0, STUDENT_PHOTO_BATCH_SIZE),
          0
        );
      }
    }

    function runStudentPhotoBatch(rows, attempt) {
      studentPhotoActiveBatches++;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(photos) {
          studentPhotoActiveBatches--;
          photos = photos || {};

          var rowLookup = {};
          rows.forEach(function(row) { rowLookup[row] = true; });

          var changed = false;

          forEachRosterStudent(function(student) {
            var row = Number(student.rowNumber);

            if (!rowLookup[row]) return;

            delete studentPhotoQueued[row];

            var key = studentPhotoKey(student);
            var url = photos[row] ? String(photos[row]) : '';

            if (!url) {
              // No photo in the sheet any more.
              if (student.imageUrl || studentPhotoMemory[key]) {
                student.imageUrl = '';
                delete studentPhotoMemory[key];
                writeStudentPhotoCache(key, null);
                changed = true;
              }
              return;
            }

            if (!/^data:image\//i.test(url)) {
              // A regular web link: use it as-is.
              studentPhotoMemory[key] = url;

              if (student.imageUrl !== url) {
                student.imageUrl = url;
                changed = true;
              }
              return;
            }

            shrinkStudentPhoto(url, function(small) {
              var finalUrl = small || url;
              var previous = studentPhotoMemory[key];

              studentPhotoMemory[key] = finalUrl;

              if (small) {
                writeStudentPhotoCache(key, small);
              }

              var needsRedraw = previous !== finalUrl;

              forEachRosterStudent(function(other) {
                if (
                  studentPhotoKey(other) === key &&
                  other.imageUrl !== finalUrl
                ) {
                  other.imageUrl = finalUrl;
                  needsRedraw = true;
                }
              });

              // Only redraw when the picture is actually different.
              if (needsRedraw) {
                scheduleStudentPhotoRefresh();
              }
            });
          });

          rows.forEach(function(row) { delete studentPhotoQueued[row]; });

          if (changed) scheduleStudentPhotoRefresh();

          pumpStudentPhotoQueue();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          studentPhotoActiveBatches--;

          if (attempt < 1) {
            // Try a failed batch once more after a short pause.
            setTimeout(function() {
              runStudentPhotoBatch(rows, attempt + 1);
            }, 2000);
          } else {
            console.warn('Some student photos did not load:', error);
            rows.forEach(function(row) { delete studentPhotoQueued[row]; });
          }

          pumpStudentPhotoQueue();
        })
        .getStudentPhotos(rows);
    }

    function groupRows(group) {
      return (group && group.students || []).map(function(student) {
        return Number(student.rowNumber);
      });
    }

    // Called after the roster loads: cached photos first, then fresh ones
    // in priority order (class on screen, attendance class, everyone else).
    function startStudentPhotoLoading() {
      studentPhotoCacheLoaded.then(function() {
        if (applyKnownStudentPhotos()) {
          refreshVisibleStudentPhotos();
        }

        var attendanceGroup =
          typeof preferredAttendanceGroup === 'function'
            ? preferredAttendanceGroup()
            : null;

        queueStudentPhotoRows(groupRows(selectedClass), true);

        if (attendanceGroup && attendanceGroup !== selectedClass) {
          queueStudentPhotoRows(groupRows(attendanceGroup), false);
        }

        var everyone = [];
        forEachRosterStudent(function(student) {
          everyone.push(Number(student.rowNumber));
        });
        queueStudentPhotoRows(everyone, false);
      });
    }

    function hydrateRosterImagesDeferred() {
      // Names/classes are already usable before this begins.
      // If image loading is slow or fails, the kiosk remains fully functional.
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(payload) {
          payload = payload || {};

          var studentImages =
            Array.isArray(payload.studentImages)
              ? payload.studentImages
              : [];

          var byRow = {};

          studentImages.forEach(function(item) {
            if (
              item &&
              item.rowNumber &&
              item.imageUrl
            ) {
              byRow[
                Number(item.rowNumber)
              ] = String(item.imageUrl);
            }
          });

          (studentRoster || []).forEach(function(group) {
            var normalizedClassImageKey =
              classImageLookupKey(
                group.period,
                group.classTitle
              );

            var hydratedClassImage =
              payload.classImages
                ? (
                    payload.classImages[
                      group.key
                    ] ||
                    payload.classImages[
                      normalizedClassImageKey
                    ] ||
                    payload.classImages[
                      classImagePeriodKey(
                        group.period
                      )
                    ] ||
                    ''
                  )
                : '';

            if (hydratedClassImage) {
              group.classImageUrl =
                hydratedClassImage;
            }

            var hydratedClassImageSettings =
              payload.classImageSettings
                ? (
                    payload.classImageSettings[
                      group.key
                    ] ||
                    payload.classImageSettings[
                      normalizedClassImageKey
                    ] ||
                    null
                  )
                : null;

            if (
              hydratedClassImageSettings
            ) {
              var classImageSettings =
                hydratedClassImageSettings;

              group.classImageZoom =
                Number(
                  classImageSettings.zoom
                ) || 1;

              group.classImageFocusX =
                Number(
                  classImageSettings.focusX
                );

              group.classImageFocusY =
                Number(
                  classImageSettings.focusY
                );

              if (
                !isFinite(
                  group.classImageFocusX
                )
              ) {
                group.classImageFocusX = 50;
              }

              if (
                !isFinite(
                  group.classImageFocusY
                )
              ) {
                group.classImageFocusY = 50;
              }
            }

            (group.students || []).forEach(function(student) {
              var imageUrl =
                byRow[
                  Number(student.rowNumber)
                ];

              if (imageUrl) {
                student.imageUrl =
                  imageUrl;
              }
            });
          });

          // Refresh only the currently visible roster/chooser after images arrive.
          if (selectedClass) {
            renderStudentCards(selectedClass);

            if (attendanceSettings.enabled) {
              renderAttendanceSidePanel(
                selectedClass
              );
            }
          } else {
            populateGroupedDropdown();
            renderStudentMenuStyle();
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          console.warn(
            'Deferred roster images did not load:',
            error
          );
        })
        .getDeferredRosterImages({
          skipStudentPhotos: true
        });
    }


    /* ===== Fast startup =====
       1. Draw the kiosk immediately from what this device saw last time.
       2. Ask the server for everything in ONE request.
       3. Replace anything that changed. Live data (who is out of the room,
          attendance taps, the bell clock) is never taken from memory. */
    var STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_KEY = 'hallPassStartupSnapshot|v1';
    var STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS = 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    var STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_PARTS = [
      'kioskSettings',
      'backgroundOptions',
      'fontOptions',
      'attendanceEmojiBank',
      'attendanceSettings',
      'roster',
      'destinations',
      'bellScheduleNames'
    ];
    var startupShownFromMemory = {};

    function startupLocalDayKey() {
      var d = new Date();
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + d.getDate();
    }

    function readStartupSnapshot() {
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem(STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_KEY);
        if (!raw) return null;

        var snapshot = JSON.parse(raw);

        if (
          !snapshot ||
          !snapshot.parts ||
          Date.now() - Number(snapshot.savedAt || 0) >
            STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MS
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        /* Birthday flags are only true on the day they were saved. */
        if (
          snapshot.day !== startupLocalDayKey() &&
          Array.isArray(snapshot.parts.roster)
        ) {
          snapshot.parts.roster.forEach(function(group) {
            (group && group.students || []).forEach(function(student) {
              student.birthdayObservedToday = false;
              student.birthdayMessage = '';
            });
          });
        }

        return snapshot;
      } catch (err) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function saveStartupSnapshot(bundle) {
      var parts = {};

      STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_PARTS.forEach(function(name) {
        if (bundle[name] != null) {
          parts[name] = bundle[name];
        }
      });

      function store(data) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({
            savedAt: Date.now(),
            day: startupLocalDayKey(),
            parts: data
          })
        );
      }

      try {
        store(parts);
      } catch (err) {
        /* Uploaded fonts can be too large to remember; keep the rest. */
        try {
          if (Array.isArray(parts.fontOptions)) {
            parts.fontOptions = parts.fontOptions.filter(function(font) {
              return !(font && font.dataUrl);
            });
          }
          store(parts);
        } catch (err2) {
          try {
            localStorage.removeItem(STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_KEY);
          } catch (err3) {}
        }
      }
    }

    function applyStartupBackgroundOptions(options) {
      backgroundOptions = options || [];
      applyBackground();

      if (settingsPanelOpen) {
        populateBackgroundSelect();
      }
    }

    function applyStartupFontOptions(options) {
      fontOptions = options || [];
      installCustomFontFaces();
      applyKioskFont();

      if (settingsPanelOpen) {
        renderFontOptions();
      }
    }

    function applyStartupEmojiBank(items) {
      var loaded = (items || [])
        .map(function(item) {
          return item && item.emoji
            ? String(item.emoji)
            : '';
        })
        .filter(Boolean);

      if (loaded.length) {
        attendanceEmojiOptions = loaded;
      }
    }

    function applyStartupAttendanceSettings(settings) {
      attendanceSettings = settings || attendanceSettings;

      applyAttendanceDisplayMode();

      if (
        typeof attendanceSettings.enabled !==
        'boolean'
      ) {
        attendanceSettings.enabled = true;
      }

      var panel =
        document.getElementById('attendanceSidePanel');

      if (panel) {
        panel.classList.toggle(
          'hidden',
          !attendanceSettings.enabled
        );
      }

      document.body.classList.toggle(
        'attendance-side-on',
        !!attendanceSettings.enabled
      );

      updatePassingPeriodPriority(
        bellScheduleStatus
      );

      applyDisplayPanelSettings();

      var attendanceGroup =
        preferredAttendanceGroup();

      if (attendanceGroup) {
        renderAttendanceSidePanel(
          attendanceGroup
        );
      }
    }

    function showStartupRoster(roster) {
      studentRoster = roster || [];
      applyKnownStudentPhotos();
      populateGroupedDropdown();
      renderStudentMenuStyle();
    }

    /* Photo, class-image and birthday loading: only once, and only after
       the real roster has arrived from the server. */
    function startRosterBackgroundLoading() {
      var hasBirthdayToday =
        studentRoster.some(function(group) {
          return (
            group &&
            Array.isArray(group.students) &&
            group.students.some(function(student) {
              return !!(
                student &&
                student.birthdayObservedToday
              );
            })
          );
        });

      /* The celebration image is large. Never let it compete with the
         roster/schedule/attendance startup calls. Only fetch it on an
         actual birthday day, after the usable kiosk is already painted. */
      if (hasBirthdayToday) {
        setTimeout(
          preloadBirthdayConfettiGif,
          1200
        );
      }

      // Do not let photos block the usable roster.
      setTimeout(
        startStudentPhotoLoading,
        0
      );

      setTimeout(
        hydrateRosterImagesDeferred,
        250
      );

      setTimeout(
        loadClassCardImagesDeferred,
        900
      );
    }

    function showRosterLoadError(error) {
      console.error(
        'Student roster failed:',
        error
      );

      /* If a remembered roster is on screen, leave it usable. */
      if (studentRoster && studentRoster.length) return;

      var chooser =
        document.getElementById(
          'classChooser'
        );

      if (chooser) {
        chooser.innerHTML =
          '<div style="padding:16px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;">' +
          'Class data could not load.<br><span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;">' +
          escapeHtml(
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : 'Unknown server error'
          ) +
          '</span></div>';
      }
    }

    function applyStartupDestinations(items) {
      destinations = items || [];
      renderDestinationCards();
    }

    function applyStartupActivePasses(passes) {
      applyActivePassServerSnapshot(
        passes,
        true
      );

      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();

      if (
        typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal ===
        'function'
      ) {
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      }
    }

    /* The original one-request-per-item startup. Used for any item the
       combined request could not provide (or if it fails entirely). */
    var startupSeparateRequests = {
      backgroundOptions: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupBackgroundOptions)
          .getBackgroundOptions();
      },
      fontOptions: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupFontOptions)
          .getFontOptions();
      },
      kioskSettings: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(settings) {
            applyKioskSettings(settings);
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            console.error(
              'Kiosk settings failed:',
              error
            );
          })
          .getKioskSettings();
      },
      attendanceEmojiBank: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupEmojiBank)
          .withFailureHandler(function() {})
          .getAttendanceEmojiBank();
      },
      emojiPlan: function() {
        refreshEmojiPlanIfNewDay();
      },
      attendanceSettings: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupAttendanceSettings)
          .withFailureHandler(function() {})
          .getAttendanceSettings();
      },
      roster: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(roster) {
            showStartupRoster(roster);
            loadBellScheduleNames();
            refreshBellScheduleStatus();
            startRosterBackgroundLoading();
          })
          .withFailureHandler(showRosterLoadError)
          .getStudentRoster();
      },
      destinations: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupDestinations)
          .getDestinationList();
      },
      activePasses: function() {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(applyStartupActivePasses)
          .getActivePasses();
      }
    };

    function sameStartupData(a, b) {
      try {
        return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
      } catch (err) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    function applyStartupFromMemory(snapshot) {
      var parts = snapshot.parts;

      function show(name, fn) {
        if (parts[name] == null) return;

        try {
          fn(parts[name]);
          startupShownFromMemory[name] = parts[name];
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('Remembered ' + name + ' could not be shown:', err);
        }
      }

      show('backgroundOptions', applyStartupBackgroundOptions);
      show('fontOptions', applyStartupFontOptions);
      show('kioskSettings', function(settings) {
        applyKioskSettings(settings);
      });
      show('attendanceEmojiBank', applyStartupEmojiBank);
      show('attendanceSettings', applyStartupAttendanceSettings);
      show('roster', function(roster) {
        /* Work on a copy so the remembered version stays untouched for
           the "did anything change?" comparison. */
        showStartupRoster(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(roster)));

        studentPhotoCacheLoaded.then(function() {
          if (applyKnownStudentPhotos()) {
            refreshVisibleStudentPhotos();
          }
        });
      });
      show('destinations', applyStartupDestinations);
      show('bellScheduleNames', function(names) {
        bellScheduleNames = names || [];
        populateDayTypeDropdown();
      });
    }

    function applyStartupBundle(bundle) {
      bundle = bundle || {};

      /* Apply an item only if the server sent it, and skip the redraw
         when it is identical to what is already on screen from memory. */
      function fresh(name, fn) {
        if (bundle[name] == null) {
          if (startupSeparateRequests[name]) {
            startupSeparateRequests[name]();
          }
          return false;
        }

        if (
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            startupShownFromMemory,
            name
          ) &&
          sameStartupData(startupShownFromMemory[name], bundle[name])
        ) {
          return true;
        }

        try {
          fn(bundle[name]);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Startup ' + name + ' failed:', err);
        }

        return true;
      }

      fresh('backgroundOptions', applyStartupBackgroundOptions);
      fresh('fontOptions', applyStartupFontOptions);
      fresh('kioskSettings', function(settings) {
        applyKioskSettings(settings);
      });
      fresh('attendanceEmojiBank', applyStartupEmojiBank);
      fresh('emojiPlan', applyEmojiPlan);
      fresh('teacherPinSet', function(v) { kioskSetPinStatus(!!v); });
      fresh('reminderSettings', function(v) { if (v) kioskReminderSettings = v; });
      fresh('passQueue', kioskSetQueue);
      fresh('seating', kioskSetSeating);
      fresh('attendanceSettings', applyStartupAttendanceSettings);

      var rosterArrived = fresh('roster', showStartupRoster);

      if (rosterArrived) {
        if (bundle.bellScheduleNames != null) {
          bellScheduleNames = bundle.bellScheduleNames || [];
          populateDayTypeDropdown();
        } else {
          loadBellScheduleNames();
        }

        if (
          bundle.bellScheduleDisplay &&
          bundle.bellScheduleDisplay.scheduleName
        ) {
          schedulePreviewMemo[
            bundle.bellScheduleDisplay.scheduleName
          ] = {
            at: Date.now(),
            data: bundle.bellScheduleDisplay
          };
        }

        if (bundle.bellScheduleStatus != null) {
          if (attendanceScheduleCheckedKey) {
            clearAttendanceScheduleAlert();
          }

          applyBellScheduleStatus(bundle.bellScheduleStatus);
        } else {
          refreshBellScheduleStatus();
        }

        startRosterBackgroundLoading();
      }

      fresh('destinations', applyStartupDestinations);
      fresh('activePasses', applyStartupActivePasses);

      saveStartupSnapshot(bundle);
    }

    // ?settings=1 (the teacher view's Settings button): open Settings once the
    // saved settings have arrived from the server, so the form shows them.
    var kioskSettingsLinkWanted = document.body.hasAttribute('data-settings-only') ? true : null;
    try {
      google.script.url.getLocation(function(where) {
        if (kioskSettingsLinkWanted === null) kioskSettingsLinkWanted = !!(where && where.parameter && where.parameter.settings === '1');
        if (kioskSettingsLinkWanted && kioskSettingsLinkWanted !== 'done' && kioskStartupArrived) kioskOpenSettingsFromLink();
      });
    } catch (err) {}
    var kioskStartupArrived = false;
    function kioskOpenSettingsFromLink() {
      kioskStartupArrived = true;
      if (kioskSettingsLinkWanted !== true) return;
      kioskSettingsLinkWanted = 'done';
      openSettings();
    }

    function loadInitialData() {
      var snapshot = readStartupSnapshot();

      if (snapshot) {
        applyStartupFromMemory(snapshot);
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(bundle) {
          applyStartupBundle(bundle);
          kioskOpenSettingsFromLink();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          setTimeout(kioskOpenSettingsFromLink, 4000);
          console.warn(
            'Combined startup request failed; loading items separately:',
            error
          );

          Object.keys(startupSeparateRequests).forEach(function(name) {
            startupSeparateRequests[name]();
          });
        })
        .getStartupBundle(dayTypeOverride);
    }

    loadInitialData();

    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
      initializeBellPlusFloating();
    });
    });
    });

    setInterval(updateLiveTimers, 1000);

    /* ===== One background check every 10 seconds =====
       Passes, settings, the bell schedule and the teacher's attendance
       corrections all come back in one server call (getKioskPoll)
       instead of four separate ones. Each part says how often it is
       needed; a new check never starts while the last one is waiting. */
    var kioskPollParts = window.kioskPollParts = [];
    var kioskPollBusy = false;

    function addKioskPollPart(part) {
      part.last = 0;
      kioskPollParts.push(part);
    }

    function runKioskPoll() {
      if (kioskPollBusy) return;

      var now = Date.now();
      var request = {};
      var asked = [];

      kioskPollParts.forEach(function(part) {
        if (now - part.last < part.every - 500) return;
        var args = part.build();
        if (args === undefined) return;
        request[part.name] = args;
        asked.push(part);
        part.last = now;
      });

      if (!asked.length) return;

      kioskPollBusy = true;
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(result) {
          kioskPollBusy = false;
          result = result || {};
          asked.forEach(function(part) {
            try {
              if (result[part.name + 'Error'] != null || !(part.name in result)) {
                if (part.fail) part.fail(result[part.name + 'Error']);
              } else {
                part.apply(result[part.name]);
              }
            } catch (err) {
              console.error('Background check ' + part.name + ' failed:', err);
            }
          });
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          kioskPollBusy = false;
          asked.forEach(function(part) {
            try { if (part.fail) part.fail(error); } catch (err) {}
          });
        })
        .getKioskPoll(request);
    }

    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'passes',
      every: 10000,
      build: function() {
        var hasPending = activePasses.some(function(pass) {
          return pass.pending;
        });
        return hasPending ? undefined : true;
      },
      apply: function(passes) {
        applyActivePassServerSnapshot(passes, false);
      }
    });

    // Sheet -> open app sync.
    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'settings',
      every: 10000,
      build: function() {
        return settingsSaveInProgress ? undefined : true;
      },
      apply: function(serverSettings) {
        if (
          serverSettings &&
          !settingsEqual(kioskSettings, serverSettings)
        ) {
          applyKioskSettings(serverSettings);
        }
      }
    });

    // This week's counted minutes and trips per student (getWeekPassMinutes)
    // and the reminder settings (Settings > Attendance > Out-of-class reminders).
    var kioskWeekMinutes = { limit: 6, tripLimit: 3, graceMinutes: 5, offClasses: [], students: {}, minutes: {} };
    var kioskReminderSettings = { minutes: 6, trips: 3, graceMinutes: 5, offClasses: [] };

    function kioskClassKey(group) {
      return group ? String(group.period || '') + '|' + String(group.classTitle || group.label || '') : '';
    }

    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'week',
      every: 60000,
      build: function() { return true; },
      apply: function(week) {
        if (!week || !week.minutes) return;
        kioskWeekMinutes = week;
        if (week.limit != null) {
          kioskReminderSettings = { minutes: week.limit, trips: week.tripLimit, graceMinutes: week.graceMinutes, offClasses: week.offClasses || [] };
        }
      }
    });

    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'seating',
      every: 300000,
      build: function() { return true; },
      apply: kioskSetSeating
    });

    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'queue',
      every: 10000,
      build: function() { return true; },
      apply: kioskSetQueue
    });

    addKioskPollPart({
      name: 'bell',
      every: 15000,
      build: function() {
        if (attendanceScheduleCheckedKey) {
          clearAttendanceScheduleAlert();
        }
        return { override: dayTypeOverride };
      },
      apply: function(status) {
        applyBellScheduleStatus(status);
      },
      fail: function() {
        updateScheduleStatusBar({
          schoolDay: true,
          scheduleName: '',
          label: 'Bell schedule unavailable'
        });
        renderSchedulePreview(null);
      }
    });

    setInterval(runKioskPoll, 10000);


    /* ===== Auto-Fit Typography + Fast Local Shuffle ===== */
    var accentSafeIndexCache = Object.create(null);
    var autoFitResizeTimer = null;

    function fitSingleLineText(el, minSize, maxSize, horizontalPadding) {
      if (!el) return;

      var parent = el.parentElement;
      var available = Math.max(40, (parent ? parent.clientWidth : el.clientWidth) - (horizontalPadding || 0));
      var size = maxSize;

      el.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
      el.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';

      while (size > minSize && el.scrollWidth > available) {
        size -= 1;
        el.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
      }
    }

    function fitClassCardTypography() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.class-card').forEach(function(card) {
        fitSingleLineText(card.querySelector('.class-period'), 22, 30, 22);
        fitSingleLineText(card.querySelector('.class-title-text'), 16, 24, 22);
      });

      var selectedHeading = document.getElementById('selectedClassHeading');
      if (selectedHeading && selectedHeading.textContent.trim()) {
        fitSingleLineText(selectedHeading, 14, 19, 18);
      }
    }

    function fitStudentCardNames() {
      document.querySelectorAll(
        '#studentGrid .student-card-name'
      ).forEach(function(nameEl) {
        var card =
          nameEl.closest(
            '.student-card'
          );

        if (!card) return;

        /* Give every name the real usable width of its own card.
           Font size is then reduced until the complete name fits. */
        var computed =
          window.getComputedStyle(card);

        var horizontalPadding =
          (
            parseFloat(
              computed.paddingLeft || '0'
            ) || 0
          ) +
          (
            parseFloat(
              computed.paddingRight || '0'
            ) || 0
          );

        var maxWidth =
          Math.max(
            40,
            card.clientWidth -
            horizontalPadding -
            6
          );

        var startSize = 34;
        var minSize = 12;

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'max-width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'white-space',
          'nowrap',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'overflow',
          'hidden',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'text-overflow',
          'clip',
          'important'
        );

        nameEl.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          startSize + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        var size =
          startSize;

        while (
          size > minSize &&
          nameEl.scrollWidth >
            maxWidth
        ) {
          size -= 1;

          nameEl.style.setProperty(
            'font-size',
            size + 'px',
            'important'
          );
        }

        /* Fractional sizing gives long names one last chance to fit
           without an unnecessary whole-pixel drop. */
        while (
          size > minSize &&
          nameEl.scrollWidth >
            maxWidth
        ) {
          size -= 0.25;

          nameEl.style.setProperty(
            'font-size',
            size.toFixed(2) + 'px',
            'important'
          );
        }
      });

      applyStudentNameContrast();
    }

    function fitDestinationLabelStable(
      label,
      minSize,
      maxSize
    ) {
      if (!label) return 0;

      var text =
        String(
          label.textContent || ''
        ).trim();

      if (!text) {
        label.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          '0px',
          'important'
        );
        return 0;
      }

      var card =
        label.closest(
          '.destination-card'
        );

      if (!card) return 0;

      var cardWidth =
        Math.max(
          80,
          card.clientWidth ||
          card.getBoundingClientRect().width
        );

      var cardHeight =
        Math.max(
          70,
          card.clientHeight ||
          card.getBoundingClientRect().height
        );

      /* The pill is allowed to occupy only the lower third of the card.
         If a two-line label needs more room, shrink the measured text
         instead of letting the pill climb farther over the artwork. */
      var pillHeightBudget =
        Math.max(
          34,
          Math.floor(
            cardHeight * .33
          )
        );

      var horizontalMargin =
        6;

      var maxPillWidth =
        Math.max(
          70,
          cardWidth -
          horizontalMargin * 2
        );

      var preferredMax =
        Math.min(
          Number(
            maxSize || 34
          ),
          34
        );

      var minimumOneLine =
        30;

      function applyBaseGeometry() {
        label.style.setProperty(
          'position',
          'absolute',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'left',
          '50%',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'right',
          'auto',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'top',
          'auto',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'bottom',
          '5px',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'width',
          'max-content',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'max-width',
          maxPillWidth + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'min-width',
          '0',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'height',
          'auto',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'min-height',
          '0',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'max-height',
          'none',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'line-height',
          '.98',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'transform',
          'translateX(-50%)',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'word-break',
          'normal',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'overflow-wrap',
          'normal',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'overflow',
          'visible',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'text-overflow',
          'clip',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'text-shadow',
          'none',
          'important'
        );

        label.style.setProperty(
          'filter',
          'none',
          'important'
        );
      }

      function currentFitsOneLine() {
        var rect =
          label.getBoundingClientRect();

        var computed =
          window.getComputedStyle(
            label
          );

        var paddingTop =
          parseFloat(
            computed.paddingTop || '0'
          ) || 0;

        var paddingBottom =
          parseFloat(
            computed.paddingBottom || '0'
          ) || 0;

        var lineHeight =
          parseFloat(
            computed.lineHeight || '0'
          );

        if (
          !isFinite(lineHeight) ||
          lineHeight <= 0
        ) {
          lineHeight =
            parseFloat(
              computed.fontSize || '0'
            ) * .98;
        }

        var oneLineHeight =
          lineHeight +
          paddingTop +
          paddingBottom +
          2;

        return (
          label.scrollWidth <=
            label.clientWidth + 1 &&
          label.scrollHeight <=
            oneLineHeight + 1 &&
          rect.width <=
            maxPillWidth + 1 &&
          rect.height <=
            pillHeightBudget
        );
      }

      function currentFitsTwoLines() {
        var rect =
          label.getBoundingClientRect();

        var computed =
          window.getComputedStyle(
            label
          );

        var paddingTop =
          parseFloat(
            computed.paddingTop || '0'
          ) || 0;

        var paddingBottom =
          parseFloat(
            computed.paddingBottom || '0'
          ) || 0;

        var lineHeight =
          parseFloat(
            computed.lineHeight || '0'
          );

        if (
          !isFinite(lineHeight) ||
          lineHeight <= 0
        ) {
          lineHeight =
            parseFloat(
              computed.fontSize || '0'
            ) * .98;
        }

        var twoLineHeight =
          lineHeight * 2 +
          paddingTop +
          paddingBottom +
          3;

        return (
          label.scrollWidth <=
            label.clientWidth + 1 &&
          label.scrollHeight <=
            twoLineHeight + 1 &&
          rect.width <=
            maxPillWidth + 1 &&
          rect.height <=
            Math.min(
              twoLineHeight + 1,
              pillHeightBudget
            )
        );
      }

      applyBaseGeometry();

      /* Pass 1: every label gets the same preferred maximum.
         Shrink only according to ACTUAL rendered fit. */
      label.style.setProperty(
        'white-space',
        'nowrap',
        'important'
      );

      label.style.setProperty(
        'text-wrap',
        'nowrap',
        'important'
      );

      var size =
        preferredMax;

      while (
        size >= minimumOneLine
      ) {
        label.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          size + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        if (
          currentFitsOneLine()
        ) {
          return size;
        }

        size -= 1;
      }

      /* Pass 2: if a readable single line is impossible, allow no more
         than two lines and again fit by measured width AND height. */
      label.style.setProperty(
        'white-space',
        'normal',
        'important'
      );

      label.style.setProperty(
        'text-wrap',
        'balance',
        'important'
      );

      size =
        Math.min(
          preferredMax,
          31
        );

      var minimumTwoLine =
        Math.max(
          20,
          Math.min(
            24,
            Number(
              minSize || 20
            )
          )
        );

      while (
        size >= minimumTwoLine
      ) {
        label.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          size + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        if (
          currentFitsTwoLines()
        ) {
          return size;
        }

        size -= 1;
      }

      /* Last-resort fallback: keep reducing rather than clip. */
      while (
        size >= 14
      ) {
        label.style.setProperty(
          'font-size',
          size + 'px',
          'important'
        );

        if (
          currentFitsTwoLines()
        ) {
          return size;
        }

        size -= 1;
      }

      label.style.setProperty(
        'font-size',
        '14px',
        'important'
      );

      return 14;
    }


    function fitDestinationTextBox(
      nameEl,
      minSize,
      maxSize
    ) {
      return fitDestinationLabelStable(
        nameEl,
        minSize,
        maxSize
      );
    }

    function fitDestinationCardTypography() {
      document
        .querySelectorAll(
          '#destinationGrid .destination-name-full-editable'
        )
        .forEach(function(label) {
          fitDestinationLabelStable(
            label,
            20,
            34
          );
        });
    }

    function runKioskAutoFit() {
      fitClassCardTypography();
      fitStudentCardNames();
      fitDestinationCardTypography();
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      clearTimeout(autoFitResizeTimer);
      autoFitResizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(runKioskAutoFit);
      }, 90);
    });

    function paletteShuffleCacheKey(option) {
      if (!option || !option.palette) return '';
      var p = option.palette;
      return [
        option.name || '',
        p.highContrast || '',
        p.strongContrast || '',
        p.popColor || '',
        p.softSupport || '',
        p.lowContrast || ''
      ].join('|');
    }

    function roleMapIsSafeForPalette(palette, candidate) {
      function c(role, fallback) {
        return paletteSlotColor(palette, candidate[role] || fallback);
      }

      var panel = c('panelFill', 'low');
      var card = c('cardFill', 'soft');
      var panelBorder = c('panelBorder', 'strong');
      var cardBorder = c('cardBorder', 'strong');
      var button = c('primaryButton', 'high');

      return (
        contrastRatio(panel, card) >= 1.18 &&
        contrastRatio(panel, panelBorder) >= 1.28 &&
        contrastRatio(card, cardBorder) >= 1.28 &&
        contrastRatio(panel, button) >= 1.30
      );
    }

    function getSafeAccentIndices(option) {
      var key = paletteShuffleCacheKey(option);
      if (!key) return [];
      if (accentSafeIndexCache[key]) return accentSafeIndexCache[key];

      var safe = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length; i++) {
        var map = defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(i);
        if (roleMapIsSafeForPalette(option.palette, map)) {
          safe.push(i);
        }
      }

      if (!safe.length) {
        safe = ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.map(function(_, index) {
          return index;
        });
      }

      accentSafeIndexCache[key] = safe;
      return safe;
    }

    // No starting value on purpose: the page can paint colors before this
    // line runs, and a starting value would erase what it noted.
    var lastShownAccentKey;

    function accentRoleMapKey(map) {
      if (!map) return '';
      return Object.keys(map).sort().map(function(role) {
        return role + ':' + map[role];
      }).join('|');
    }

    function nextSafeAccentIndex(option, currentIndex) {
      var safe = getSafeAccentIndices(option);
      if (!safe.length) return 0;

      var currentPosition = safe.indexOf(Number(currentIndex));
      if (currentPosition === -1) {
        for (var i = 0; i < safe.length; i++) {
          if (safe[i] > Number(currentIndex || 0)) return safe[i];
        }
        return safe[0];
      }

      return safe[(currentPosition + 1) % safe.length];
    }

    function shuffleAccentColors() {
      var option = getCurrentBackgroundOption();
      if (!option || !option.palette) return;

      var button = document.getElementById('shuffleAccentButton');
      if (button) {
        button.classList.add('shuffle-pressed');
        setTimeout(function() {
          button.classList.remove('shuffle-pressed');
        }, 110);
      }

      var nextIndex = nextSafeAccentIndex(
        option,
        currentAccentLayoutIndex
      );

      // The first press used to land on the layout already showing (the page
      // had quietly skipped ahead to it), so it looked like nothing happened.
      for (
        var tries = 0;
        tries < ALL_ACCENT_PERMUTATIONS.length &&
        accentRoleMapKey(defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(nextIndex)) === lastShownAccentKey;
        tries++
      ) {
        nextIndex = nextSafeAccentIndex(option, nextIndex);
      }

      currentAccentLayoutIndex = nextIndex;
      currentAccentBackgroundName = option.name || '';
      currentAdvancedAccentMap = null;

      // Pass the already-resolved safe map so applyPaletteTheme does not
      // scan permutations on every tap. The visible repaint stays local.
      applyPaletteTheme(
        option.palette,
        currentAccentLayoutIndex,
        defaultRoleMapFromPermutation(currentAccentLayoutIndex)
      );

      var lockButton = document.getElementById('lockAccentButton');
      if (lockButton) {
        lockButton.classList.remove('locked');
        lockButton.textContent = '🔒 LOCK LOOK';
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(runKioskAutoFit);
    }

    // Re-fit after the app and web fonts have settled.
    window.addEventListener('load', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(runKioskAutoFit);
      setTimeout(runKioskAutoFit, 250);
      setTimeout(runKioskAutoFit, 900);
    });

  </script>

<script>
(function () {
  var fitTimer = null;

  function clampNumber(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function isElementVisible(el) {
    if (!el) return false;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    return style.display !== 'none' &&
           style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
           el.getClientRects().length > 0;
  }

  function fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('studentGrid');
    var chooser = document.getElementById('studentChooser');

    if (!grid || !chooser || !isElementVisible(chooser)) return;

    var count = grid.children.length;
    if (!count) return;

    var rect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();
    var width = Math.max(320, grid.clientWidth || rect.width || 320);
    var availableHeight = Math.max(
      260,
      window.innerHeight - rect.top - 12
    );

    var gap = width < 760 ? 6 : 8;

    /* For the normal 20–30 student class, prefer six columns.
       Only add columns when the current zoom/viewport needs them to
       keep the full roster visible without crushing the cards. */
    var preferred =
      count >= 21 ? 6 :
      count >= 16 ? 5 :
      count >= 10 ? 4 :
      count >= 7  ? 3 : 2;

    var maxColumns = Math.min(8, count);
    var candidates = [];

    for (var cols = preferred; cols <= maxColumns; cols++) {
      var rows = Math.ceil(count / cols);
      var cellWidth =
        (width - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
      var cellHeight =
        (availableHeight - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;

      var cardHeight = Math.min(
        cellHeight,
        cellWidth * 1.12
      );

      var photoSize = Math.min(
        cellWidth - 12,
        cardHeight - 43
      );

      var fitsComfortably =
        cellWidth >= 104 &&
        cardHeight >= 118 &&
        photoSize >= 72;

      /* Strong preference for six columns, but visibility wins. */
      var score =
        photoSize -
        Math.abs(cols - preferred) * 7 +
        (fitsComfortably ? 30 : 0);

      candidates.push({
        cols: cols,
        rows: rows,
        cellWidth: cellWidth,
        cardHeight: cardHeight,
        photoSize: photoSize,
        fitsComfortably: fitsComfortably,
        score: score
      });
    }

    var fitting = candidates.filter(function (c) {
      return c.fitsComfortably;
    });

    var pool = fitting.length ? fitting : candidates;
    pool.sort(function (a, b) {
      return b.score - a.score;
    });

    var best = pool[0];
    if (!best) return;

    var cardHeight = clampNumber(
      Math.floor(best.cardHeight),
      118,
      184
    );

    var photoSize = clampNumber(
      Math.floor(
        Math.min(
          best.photoSize,
          cardHeight - 42
        )
      ),
      72,
      132
    );

    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--student-fit-columns',
      String(best.cols)
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--student-fit-gap',
      gap + 'px'
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--student-fit-card-height',
      cardHeight + 'px'
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--student-fit-photo-size',
      photoSize + 'px'
    );

    if (typeof window.fitStudentCardNames === 'function') {
      window.fitStudentCardNames();
    }

    if (
      typeof window.centerIncompleteGridRows ===
        'function'
    ) {
      window.centerIncompleteGridRows();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      if (
        typeof window.fitStudentCardNames ===
          'function'
      ) {
        window.fitStudentCardNames();
      }

      if (
        typeof window.centerIncompleteGridRows ===
          'function'
      ) {
        window.centerIncompleteGridRows();
      }
    });
  }

  function scheduleStudentGridFit() {
    clearTimeout(fitTimer);
    fitTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport();

        /* Re-run once after layout settles; this is inexpensive and
           makes browser zoom changes feel immediate. */
        requestAnimationFrame(
          fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport
        );
      });
    }, 35);
  }

  window.fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport =
    fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport;

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    scheduleStudentGridFit,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    scheduleStudentGridFit,
    { passive: true }
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      var grid = document.getElementById('studentGrid');
      var attendanceGrid =
        document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid');

      if (grid && window.MutationObserver) {
        new MutationObserver(
          scheduleStudentGridFit
        ).observe(
          grid,
          { childList: true }
        );
      }

      if (
        attendanceGrid &&
        window.ResizeObserver
      ) {
        new ResizeObserver(function () {
          /* CSS auto-fit handles attendance columns. The callback
             simply lets the main roster reclaim its best geometry
             if the side rail changes available space. */
          scheduleStudentGridFit();
        }).observe(attendanceGrid);
      }

      scheduleStudentGridFit();
    }
  );
})();
</script>



<script>
/* ===== Center incomplete final rows =====
   Applies to class choices, checkout students, and attendance students.
   Example with 6 columns and 2 remaining cards:
   [ ][ ][X][X][ ][ ]
*/
(function () {
  var centerRowTimer = null;

  function visibleChildren(grid) {
    return Array.prototype.filter.call(
      grid ? grid.children : [],
      function (child) {
        if (!child || child.nodeType !== 1) return false;
        var s = window.getComputedStyle(child);
        return s.display !== 'none' &&
               s.visibility !== 'hidden';
      }
    );
  }

  function computedColumnCount(grid) {
    if (!grid) return 1;

    var style = window.getComputedStyle(grid);
    var template = String(
      style.gridTemplateColumns || ''
    ).trim();

    if (!template || template === 'none') {
      return 1;
    }

    /* Browsers normally return resolved track widths here,
       e.g. "145px 145px 145px 145px 145px 145px". */
    var tracks = template
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean);

    return Math.max(1, tracks.length);
  }

  function centerIncompleteLastRow(grid) {
    if (!grid) return;

    var items = visibleChildren(grid);

    if (!items.length) return;

    /* Always wipe every previous placement first. We use !important
       here because older student-card rules also used !important. */
    items.forEach(function(item) {
      item.style.removeProperty(
        'grid-column-start'
      );
      item.style.removeProperty(
        'grid-column-end'
      );
      item.style.removeProperty(
        'transform'
      );
      item.style.removeProperty(
        'width'
      );
      item.style.removeProperty(
        'justify-self'
      );
    });

    var cols =
      computedColumnCount(grid);

    if (cols <= 1) return;

    var remainder =
      items.length % cols;

    if (!remainder) return;

    var style =
      window.getComputedStyle(grid);

    var columnGap =
      parseFloat(
        style.columnGap ||
        style.gap ||
        '0'
      ) || 0;

    var gridWidth =
      grid.clientWidth ||
      grid.getBoundingClientRect().width ||
      0;

    var trackWidth =
      (
        gridWidth -
        columnGap * (cols - 1)
      ) / cols;

    var emptyTracks =
      cols - remainder;

    var startColumn =
      Math.floor(
        emptyTracks / 2
      ) + 1;

    /* If the number of empty tracks is odd, integer grid columns
       cannot center the row exactly. Shift the whole final row by
       half of one track + half of the gap. This works for:
       4 cols -> 1,2,3 remaining
       5 cols -> 1,2,3,4 remaining
       and any future responsive column count. */
    var halfTrackOffset =
      emptyTracks % 2
        ? (trackWidth + columnGap) / 2
        : 0;

    var firstLastRowIndex =
      items.length - remainder;

    items
      .slice(firstLastRowIndex)
      .forEach(function(item, index) {
        item.style.setProperty(
          'width',
          '100%',
          'important'
        );

        item.style.setProperty(
          'justify-self',
          'stretch',
          'important'
        );

        item.style.setProperty(
          'grid-column-start',
          String(
            startColumn + index
          ),
          'important'
        );

        item.style.setProperty(
          'grid-column-end',
          'auto',
          'important'
        );

        item.style.setProperty(
          'transform',
          halfTrackOffset
            ? (
                'translateX(' +
                halfTrackOffset.toFixed(2) +
                'px)'
              )
            : 'none',
          'important'
        );
      });
  }

  function centerAllIncompleteRows() {
    [
      document.querySelector('.class-grid'),
      document.getElementById('studentGrid'),
      document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid')
    ].forEach(centerIncompleteLastRow);
  }

  function scheduleCenterIncompleteRows() {
    clearTimeout(centerRowTimer);
    centerRowTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        centerAllIncompleteRows();

        /* Run once more after the responsive fitter has had a
           chance to change column count. */
        requestAnimationFrame(
          centerAllIncompleteRows
        );
      });
    }, 60);
  }

  window.centerIncompleteGridRows =
    centerAllIncompleteRows;

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    scheduleCenterIncompleteRows,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    scheduleCenterIncompleteRows,
    { passive: true }
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      [
        document.querySelector('.class-grid'),
        document.getElementById('studentGrid'),
        document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid')
      ].forEach(function (grid) {
        if (grid && window.MutationObserver) {
          new MutationObserver(function (records) {
            if (kioskRealChange(records)) scheduleCenterIncompleteRows();
          }).observe(
            grid,
            {
              childList: true,
              subtree: false,
              attributes: true,
              attributeOldValue: true,
              attributeFilter: ['class', 'style']
            }
          );
        }
      });

      scheduleCenterIncompleteRows();
    }
  );
})();
</script>



<script>
/* =====================================================================
   Mockup layout + Out-of-the-Room rail behavior
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  var layoutTimer = null;

  function clampOutRoom(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function elementIsVisible(el) {
    if (!el) return false;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    return !el.classList.contains('hidden') &&
      style.display !== 'none' &&
      style.visibility !== 'hidden';
  }

  function normalizePersonName(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }

  function studentFullNameForRail(student) {
    if (!student) return '';

    return String(
      student.fullName ||
      (
        String(student.firstName || '').trim() +
        ' ' +
        String(student.lastName || '').trim()
      ).trim() ||
      student.name ||
      student.displayName ||
      ''
    ).trim();
  }

  function findStudentForOutPass(pass) {
    var target = normalizePersonName(
      pass && (
        pass.name ||
        pass.fullName ||
        pass.studentName
      )
    );

    if (!target) return null;

    var groups = [];

    if (selectedClass && Array.isArray(selectedClass.students)) {
      groups.push(selectedClass);
    }

    (studentRoster || []).forEach(function (group) {
      if (group !== selectedClass) groups.push(group);
    });

    for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g += 1) {
      var students = groups[g] && groups[g].students;
      if (!Array.isArray(students)) continue;

      for (var s = 0; s < students.length; s += 1) {
        var student = students[s];

        if (
          normalizePersonName(
            studentFullNameForRail(student)
          ) === target
        ) {
          return student;
        }
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  function activePassPhotoHtml(pass) {
    var student = findStudentForOutPass(pass);

    if (student && student.imageUrl) {
      return (
        '<div class="out-room-photo-wrap">' +
          '<img class="out-room-photo" src="' +
            escapeAttribute(student.imageUrl) +
          '" alt="">' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    var display = String(
      (pass && (pass.displayName || pass.name)) ||
      ''
    ).trim();

    var initial = display ?
      display.charAt(0).toUpperCase() :
      '•';

    return (
      '<div class="out-room-photo-wrap">' +
        '<div class="out-room-initial">' +
          escapeHtml(initial) +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }

  /* Replaces the old long list below the destination area.
     The whole square is now the return button. */
  window.renderActivePasses = function () {
    var container =
      document.getElementById('activeContainer');

    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = '';

    var stage = container.closest(
      '.active-pass-stage'
    );

    if (stage) {
      stage.classList.add('out-room-rail');

      var heading = stage.querySelector('h3');
      if (heading) {
        heading.textContent = 'Currently Out of the Classroom';
      }
    }

    if (
      !activePasses ||
      activePasses.length === 0
    ) {
      container.innerHTML =
        '<p class="muted">Everyone is currently in class.</p>';

      if (
        typeof syncAttendanceSidePassStates ===
        'function'
      ) {
        syncAttendanceSidePassStates();
      }

      scheduleMockupLayout();
      return;
    }

    activePasses.forEach(
      function (pass, index) {
        var elapsed =
          getElapsedSeconds(pass);

        var statusClass =
          getStatusClass(elapsed);

        var item =
          document.createElement('div');

        item.className =
          'active-item out-room-student-card ' +
          statusClass +
          (pass.pending
            ? ' out-room-syncing'
            : '');

        item.setAttribute(
          'data-pass-index',
          String(index)
        );

        item.setAttribute(
          'role',
          pass.pending ? 'status' : 'button'
        );

        if (!pass.pending) {
          item.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
          item.setAttribute(
            'aria-label',
            'Check ' +
            String(
              pass.displayName ||
              pass.name ||
              'student'
            ) +
            ' back into class'
          );
        }

        item.innerHTML =
          activePassPhotoHtml(pass) +
          '<span class="student-name">' +
            escapeHtml(
              pass.displayName ||
              pass.name
            ) +
          '</span>' +
          '<span class="destination-text">' +
            escapeHtml(
              pass.destination || ''
            ) +
          '</span>' +
          '<div class="timing-line">' +
            '<span class="live-timer" data-pass-index="' +
              index +
            '">' +
              formatLiveElapsed(elapsed) +
            '</span>' +
          '</div>';

        if (!pass.pending) {
          item.addEventListener(
            'click',
            function () {
              /* Existing handleCheckIn is optimistic:
                 it removes the card immediately, then
                 saves the return in the background. */
              handleCheckIn(index);
            }
          );

          item.addEventListener(
            'keydown',
            function (event) {
              if (
                event.key === 'Enter' ||
                event.key === ' '
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                handleCheckIn(index);
              }
            }
          );
        }

        container.appendChild(item);
      }
    );

    if (
      typeof syncAttendanceSidePassStates ===
      'function'
    ) {
      syncAttendanceSidePassStates();
    }

    scheduleMockupLayout();
  };

  function layoutMockupColumns() {
      return;
}

  function scheduleMockupLayout() {
      return;
}

  window.layoutMockupColumns =
    layoutMockupColumns;

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    scheduleMockupLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    scheduleMockupLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      var stage =
        document.querySelector(
          '.active-pass-stage'
        );

      if (stage) {
        stage.classList.add(
          'out-room-rail'
        );

        var heading =
          stage.querySelector('h3');

        if (heading) {
          heading.textContent =
            'Currently Out of the Classroom';
        }
      }

      /* Watch attendance being enabled/disabled and roster/stage
         changes, because those change how much horizontal room the
         center column receives. */
      if (
        window.MutationObserver &&
        document.body
      ) {
        new MutationObserver(
          scheduleMockupLayout
        ).observe(
          document.body,
          {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['class']
          }
        );
      }

      var active =
        document.getElementById(
          'activeContainer'
        );

      if (
        active &&
        window.MutationObserver
      ) {
        new MutationObserver(
          scheduleMockupLayout
        ).observe(
          active,
          { childList: true }
        );
      }

      scheduleMockupLayout();

      /* Active passes may already have rendered before this final
         enhancement script loaded. Redraw them into the new rail. */
      if (
        typeof window.renderActivePasses ===
        'function'
      ) {
        window.renderActivePasses();
      }
    }
  );
})();
</script>



<script>
(function () {
  var destinationFitTimer = null;
  var controlPositionTimer = null;

  function clampFinal(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function visibleFinal(el) {
    if (!el) return false;
    var s = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    return s.display !== 'none' &&
      s.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
      el.getClientRects().length > 0;
  }

  /* Put Shuffle/Lock exactly beside the Back/Reset row like the mockup.
     This uses actual rendered geometry, so it stays correct at iPad and
     desktop zoom levels. */
  function positionAccentButtonsFromMockup() {
      return;
}

  function scheduleAccentButtonPosition() {
      return;
}

  /* Fit a five-column destination grid into the actual remaining viewport.
     For the normal 15 destinations this produces 3 compact rows. */
  function fitDestinationGridToViewport() {
    var chooser =
      document.getElementById('destinationChooser');
    var grid =
      document.getElementById('destinationGrid');

    if (
      !chooser ||
      !grid ||
      !visibleFinal(chooser)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    var count = grid.children.length;
    if (!count) return;

    var columns =
      window.innerWidth <= 760 ? 2 : 3;

    var rows =
      Math.ceil(count / columns);

    var rect =
      grid.getBoundingClientRect();

    var availableHeight =
      Math.max(
        260,
        window.innerHeight -
        rect.top -
        12
      );

    var gap =
      window.innerHeight < 760 ? 5 : 7;

    var rowHeight =
      (
        availableHeight -
        gap * Math.max(0, rows - 1)
      ) / rows;

    /* The upper bound keeps the grid pleasantly compact even on a
       27-inch monitor. Extra room becomes breathing room instead of
       returning to giant destination cards. */
    var cardHeight =
      clampFinal(
        Math.floor(rowHeight),
        118,
        166
      );

    var cardWidth =
      (
        grid.clientWidth -
        gap * Math.max(0, columns - 1)
      ) / columns;

    /* Leave room for one or two lines of destination text. */
    var iconSize =
      clampFinal(
        Math.floor(
          Math.min(
            cardWidth * .56,
            cardHeight - 54
          )
        ),
        62,
        104
      );

    var fontSize =
      clampFinal(
        Math.floor(
          Math.min(
            cardWidth * .17,
            cardHeight * .22
          )
        ),
        22,
        35
      );

    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--destination-fit-gap',
      gap + 'px'
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--destination-fit-card-height',
      cardHeight + 'px'
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--destination-fit-icon-size',
      iconSize + 'px'
    );
    grid.style.setProperty(
      '--destination-fit-font-size',
      fontSize + 'px'
    );

    /* Existing destination label fitter can still handle especially
       long labels after the overall responsive dimensions are chosen. */
    if (
      typeof window.fitDestinationNames ===
      'function'
    ) {
      window.fitDestinationNames();
    } else if (
      typeof fitDestinationNames ===
      'function'
    ) {
      fitDestinationNames();
    }
  }

  function scheduleDestinationFit() {
    clearTimeout(destinationFitTimer);
    destinationFitTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        fitDestinationGridToViewport();
        requestAnimationFrame(
          fitDestinationGridToViewport
        );
      });
    }, 30);
  }

  window.fitDestinationGridToViewport =
    fitDestinationGridToViewport;

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    function () {
      scheduleAccentButtonPosition();
      scheduleDestinationFit();
    },
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    function () {
      scheduleAccentButtonPosition();
      scheduleDestinationFit();
    },
    { passive: true }
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      var grid =
        document.getElementById(
          'destinationGrid'
        );

      if (
        grid &&
        window.MutationObserver
      ) {
        new MutationObserver(
          scheduleDestinationFit
        ).observe(
          grid,
          {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
          }
        );
      }

      scheduleAccentButtonPosition();
      scheduleDestinationFit();
    }
  );
})();
</script>
