<script>
(function () {
  function restartLeaveClassroomPop(button) {
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;

    button.style.animation = 'none';

    // Force a reflow so the one-time ready animation can replay.
    void button.offsetWidth;

    button.style.animation = '';
  }

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      var button =
        document.getElementById('checkoutButton');

      if (
        !button ||
        !window.MutationObserver
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var lastDisabled =
        !!button.disabled;

      new MutationObserver(function () {
        var nowDisabled =
          !!button.disabled;

        if (
          lastDisabled &&
          !nowDisabled
        ) {
          restartLeaveClassroomPop(
            button
          );
        }

        lastDisabled =
          nowDisabled;
      }).observe(
        button,
        {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ['disabled']
        }
      );
    }
  );
})();
</script>



<script>
(function () {
  var finalLayoutTimer = null;
  var absentRefreshTimer = null;

  function clampFinalLayout(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function parseClockMinutesFinal(value) {
    var clock = String(value || '').trim();

    var match = clock.match(
      /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*(AM|PM)?$/i
    );

    if (!match) return null;

    var hour = Number(match[1]);
    var minute = Number(match[2]);
    var suffix = String(match[3] || '').toUpperCase();

    if (suffix) {
      if (hour === 12) hour = 0;
      if (suffix === 'PM') hour += 12;
    }

    if (
      !isFinite(hour) ||
      !isFinite(minute)
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    return hour * 60 + minute;
  }

  function classHasReachedUncheckedOutThresholdFinal() {
    if (
      !selectedClass ||
      !bellScheduleStatus ||
      bellScheduleStatus.phase !== 'class'
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    if (
      bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod &&
      String(
        bellScheduleStatus.activeRosterPeriod
      ) !== String(
        selectedClass.period || ''
      )
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    var lateBellMinutes =
      parseClockMinutesFinal(
        bellScheduleStatus.lateBell
      );

    if (lateBellMinutes == null) {
      return false;
    }

    var now = new Date();

    var currentMinutes =
      now.getHours() * 60 +
      now.getMinutes() +
      now.getSeconds() / 60;

    var threshold =
      Number(
        attendanceSettings.uncheckedOutMinutes
      );

    if (!isFinite(threshold)) {
      threshold = 5;
    }

    threshold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          30,
          threshold
        )
      );

    return (
      currentMinutes -
      lateBellMinutes
    ) >= threshold;
  }

  function nameForAbsentFinal(student) {
    return String(
      student &&
      (
        student.fullName ||
        (
          String(student.firstName || '') +
          ' ' +
          String(student.lastName || '')
        ).trim() ||
        student.name ||
        student.displayName
      ) ||
      ''
    ).trim();
  }

  function absentStudentsForOutRailFinal() {
    if (
      !attendanceSettings.enabled ||
      !selectedClass ||
      !Array.isArray(
        selectedClass.students
      )
    ) {
      return [];
    }

    var afterThreshold =
      classHasReachedUncheckedOutThresholdFinal();

    return selectedClass.students.filter(
      function(student) {
        var key =
          attendanceStudentKey(student);

        var state =
          attendanceStateByKey[key];

        var sticky =
          getStickyAttendanceOut(student);

        if (sticky) {
          return true;
        }

        if (
          state &&
          (
            state.status === 'Absent' ||
            state.status === 'Pending Departure'
          )
        ) {
          return true;
        }

        return (
          afterThreshold &&
          !state
        );
      }
    );
  }

  function appendAbsentStudentsFinal() {
    var container =
      document.getElementById(
        'activeContainer'
      );

    if (!container) return;

    container
      .querySelectorAll(
        '.out-classroom-absence-divider,' +
        '.out-classroom-absent-card'
      )
      .forEach(function(node) {
        node.remove();
      });

    var students =
      absentStudentsForOutRailFinal();

    if (!students.length) return;

    // If the standard renderer showed "everyone in class", remove it now.
    container
      .querySelectorAll('.muted')
      .forEach(function(node) {
        if (
          /everyone is currently in class/i.test(
            node.textContent || ''
          )
        ) {
          node.remove();
        }
      });

    var divider =
      document.createElement('div');

    divider.className =
      'out-classroom-absence-divider';

    divider.textContent =
      'Absent';

    container.appendChild(divider);

    students.forEach(function(student) {
      var card =
        document.createElement('div');

      var state =
        attendanceStateByKey[
          attendanceStudentKey(student)
        ];

      var sticky =
        getStickyAttendanceOut(student);

      var isPendingDeparture =
        (
          state &&
          state.status === 'Pending Departure'
        ) ||
        (
          sticky &&
          sticky.mode === 'pending'
        );

      var isEarlyDeparture =
        (
          state &&
          state.status === 'Absent' &&
          state.earlyDeparture
        ) ||
        (
          sticky &&
          sticky.mode === 'left'
        );

      card.className =
        'out-classroom-absent-card' +
        (
          isPendingDeparture ||
          isEarlyDeparture
            ? ' out-classroom-left-early-card'
            : ''
        );

      card.innerHTML =
        '<div>' +
          '<div class="out-classroom-absent-name">' +
            escapeHtml(
              nameForAbsentFinal(student)
            ) +
          '</div>' +
          '<span class="out-classroom-absent-label">' +
            (
              isPendingDeparture
                ? 'Leaving early'
                : (
                    isEarlyDeparture
                      ? 'Left early'
                      : 'Not in classroom'
                  )
            ) +
          '</span>' +
        '</div>';

      container.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  /* Wrap the current final active-pass renderer rather than replacing its
     photo/timer behavior. */
  var previousRenderActivePasses =
    window.renderActivePasses;

  if (
    typeof previousRenderActivePasses ===
    'function'
  ) {
    window.renderActivePasses =
      function() {
        activePasses =
          typeof filterRecentlyReturnedPasses === 'function'
            ? filterRecentlyReturnedPasses(
                activePasses || []
              )
            : (activePasses || []);

        previousRenderActivePasses();
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();

        var heading =
          document.querySelector(
            '.active-pass-stage h3'
          );

        if (heading) {
          heading.textContent =
            'Currently Out of the Classroom';
        }
      };
  }

  /* Keep the absence section synchronized whenever attendance states repaint. */
  var previousRenderAttendanceStates =
    window.renderAttendanceStates;

  if (
    typeof previousRenderAttendanceStates ===
    'function'
  ) {
    window.renderAttendanceStates =
      function() {
        previousRenderAttendanceStates();
        appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
      };
  }

  function positionColorControlsFinal() {
    // Permanently positioned by CSS.
    return;
  }


  function alignBellPlusToScheduleFinal() {
    var dock =
      document.getElementById(
        'rightSideDock'
      );

    var bell =
      document.getElementById(
        'bellPlusEmbed'
      );

    if (!dock || !bell) return;

    var dockRect =
      dock.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!dockRect.width) return;

    bell.classList.add(
      'bell-plus-column-aligned'
    );

    // Override any old saved width/left coordinate at startup so Bell Plus
    // immediately lines up with the bell-schedule column.
    bell.style.setProperty(
      'width',
      Math.round(dockRect.width) + 'px',
      'important'
    );

    bell.style.setProperty(
      'right',
      Math.round(
        window.innerWidth -
        dockRect.right
      ) + 'px',
      'important'
    );

    bell.style.setProperty(
      'left',
      'auto',
      'important'
    );
  }

  function layoutFinalColumns() {
      return;
}

  function scheduleFinalLayout() {
      return;
}

  window.layoutFinalColumns =
    layoutFinalColumns;

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    scheduleFinalLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    scheduleFinalLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'load',
    function() {
      layoutFinalColumns();
      setTimeout(
        layoutFinalColumns,
        150
      );
      setTimeout(
        layoutFinalColumns,
        650
      );
    }
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function() {
      var nav =
        document.querySelector(
          '.top-left-row-nav'
        );

      if (
        nav &&
        window.ResizeObserver
      ) {
        new ResizeObserver(
          scheduleFinalLayout
        ).observe(nav);
      }

      var dock =
        document.getElementById(
          'rightSideDock'
        );

      if (
        dock &&
        window.ResizeObserver
      ) {
        new ResizeObserver(
          scheduleFinalLayout
        ).observe(dock);
      }

      layoutFinalColumns();

      /* Active-pass cards are rendered by their data loader.
         Do not redraw them here; rebuilding identical cards causes a visible
         flash in the Currently Out rail. */

      absentRefreshTimer =
        setInterval(function() {
          appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
        }, 5000);
    }
  );
})();
</script>



<script>
(function () {
  var destinationFillTimer = null;

  function clampDestinationFill(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function fitDestinationCardsFilled() {

      document.getElementById('destinationGrid');

  function scheduleDestinationCardsFilled() {
    clearTimeout(destinationFillTimer);

    destinationFillTimer =
      setTimeout(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          fitDestinationCardsFilled();

            fitDestinationCardsFilled

        });
      }, 25);

  window.fitDestinationCardsFilled =
    fitDestinationCardsFilled;

<script>
(function () {
  function attendancePanelEvent(event) {
    var panel =
      document.getElementById(
        'attendanceSidePanel'
      );

    if (
      !panel ||
      !event.target ||
      !panel.contains(event.target)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Never allow an attendance gesture to become a click on the main
    // checkout/destination controls after a rerender.
    event.__attendanceOnlyGesture = true;
  }

  function blockAttendanceBubble(event) {
    if (
      !event.__attendanceOnlyGesture
    ) {
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  [
    'pointerdown',
    'pointerup',
    'click',
    'touchstart',
    'touchend'
  ].forEach(function(type) {
    document.addEventListener(
      type,
      attendancePanelEvent,
      true
    );

    document.addEventListener(
      type,
      blockAttendanceBubble,
      false
    );
  });
})();
</script>



<script>
(function () {
  var stableResizeTimer = null;
  var lastStableSignature = '';

  function clampStable(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function attendanceVisibleStable() {
    var panel = document.getElementById('attendanceSidePanel');
    return !!(
      panel &&
      !panel.classList.contains('hidden') &&
      document.body.classList.contains('attendance-side-on')
    );
  }

  function applyStableLayout() {
    var viewport =
      document.documentElement.clientWidth ||
      window.innerWidth ||
      1366;

    if (viewport < 1180) {
      document.body.classList.add('stable-layout-ready');
      return;
    }

    document.body.classList.add('kiosk-column-layout');

    var attendanceOn =
      attendanceVisibleStable();

    var edge = 12;
    var gap = 9;

    /* Reserve the attendance column even when that panel is hidden.
       Hiding a panel should never cause the Hall Pass system or right-side
       panels to slide into its former space. */
    var attendanceWidth =
      clampStable(
        Math.round(viewport * 0.315),
        400,
        540
      );

    var outWidth =
      clampStable(
        Math.round(viewport * 0.155),
        190,
        255
      );

    var dockWidth =
      clampStable(
        Math.round(viewport * 0.185),
        245,
        350
      );

    /* The center receives what's left, but is capped so desktop monitors
       do not let it swell back to the old oversized width. */
    var gapCount = 3;

    var mainWidth =
      viewport -
      edge * 2 -
      gap * gapCount -
      attendanceWidth -
      outWidth -
      dockWidth;

    mainWidth =
      clampStable(
        mainWidth,
        390,
        575
      );

    /* If the clamps put us over the viewport, shrink center first. */
    var used =
      edge * 2 +
      gap * gapCount +
      attendanceWidth +
      mainWidth +
      outWidth +
      dockWidth;

    if (used > viewport) {
      mainWidth = Math.max(
        360,
        mainWidth - (used - viewport)
      );
    }

    var mainLeft =
      edge +
      attendanceWidth +
      gap;

    var outLeft =
      mainLeft +
      mainWidth +
      gap;

    var signature = [
      viewport,
      attendanceWidth,
      mainWidth,
      outWidth,
      dockWidth
    ].join('|');

    /* Do nothing if the geometry has not actually changed. This is the main
       anti-blink protection during noisy browser zoom/resize events. */
    if (signature === lastStableSignature) {
      document.body.classList.add('stable-layout-ready');
      return;
    }

    lastStableSignature = signature;

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-attendance-width',
      attendanceWidth + 'px'
    );

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-main-width',
      mainWidth + 'px'
    );

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-main-left',
      mainLeft + 'px'
    );

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-out-left',
      outLeft + 'px'
    );

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-out-width',
      outWidth + 'px'
    );

    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--stable-dock-width',
      dockWidth + 'px'
    );

    document.body.classList.add('stable-layout-ready');

    /* Run child fitters once after the column widths settle. */
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      if (
        typeof window.fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport ===
        'function'
      ) {
        window.fitCheckoutStudentGridToViewport();
      }

      if (
        typeof window.fitDestinationGridToViewport ===
        'function'
      ) {
        window.fitDestinationGridToViewport();
      }

      if (
        typeof window.centerIncompleteGridRows ===
        'function'
      ) {
        window.centerIncompleteGridRows();
      }

      if (
        typeof positionBellPlusBelowSchedule ===
          'function'
      ) {
        positionBellPlusBelowSchedule();
      }

      if (
        typeof fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards ===
          'function'
      ) {
        fitPassingAttendancePriorityCards();
      }
    });
  }

  function scheduleStableLayout() {
    clearTimeout(stableResizeTimer);

    stableResizeTimer =
      setTimeout(
        applyStableLayout,
        120
      );
  }

  window.applyStableLayout =
    applyStableLayout;

  document.addEventListener(
    'DOMContentLoaded',
    function () {
      /* One early layout pass, then one final pass after fonts/images settle.
         No ResizeObserver loop. */
      applyStableLayout();

      setTimeout(
        applyStableLayout,
        220
      );
    }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'load',
    function () {
      applyStableLayout();
    },
    { once: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'resize',
    scheduleStableLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  window.addEventListener(
    'orientationchange',
    scheduleStableLayout,
    { passive: true }
  );

  /* Body-class changes are still observed for any real layout changes,
     but hidden display panels no longer change the desktop column budget. */
  if (
    window.MutationObserver &&
    document.body
  ) {
    new MutationObserver(function (records) {
      if (kioskRealChange(records)) scheduleStableLayout();
    }).observe(
      document.body,
      {
        attributes: true,
        attributeOldValue: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class']
      }
    );
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ===== Selected destination: unmistakable in any color theme ===== -->
<!-- ===== Fill-the-screen card sizing =====
     One final pass that sizes the name cards and attendance cards from the
     space actually available and the number of students: fewer students =
     bigger cards, photos and text; a full class still fits without scrolling. -->
<script>
(function () {
  var fillTimer = null;
  var measureCanvas = null;

  function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function shown(el) {
    return !!(el && el.getClientRects().length);
  }

  function columnLayoutActive() {
    return document.body.classList.contains('kiosk-column-layout');
  }

  /* Width of the widest name at a 100px font, so one shared font size can
     be chosen that fits every name on its card. */
  function widestNameAt100(nameEls) {
    if (!nameEls.length) return 0;

    if (!measureCanvas) {
      measureCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    }

    var ctx = measureCanvas.getContext('2d');
    var cs = window.getComputedStyle(nameEls[0]);

    ctx.font =
      (cs.fontStyle || 'normal') + ' ' +
      (cs.fontWeight || '700') + ' 100px ' +
      (cs.fontFamily || 'sans-serif');

    var spacing = parseFloat(cs.letterSpacing) || 0;
    var size = parseFloat(cs.fontSize) || 16;
    var widest = 0;

    nameEls.forEach(function (el) {
      var text = String(el.textContent || '').trim();
      var width =
        ctx.measureText(text).width +
        text.length * spacing * (100 / size);

      if (width > widest) widest = width;
    });

    return widest;
  }

  /* Try every sensible column count and keep the one that gives the
     largest photo while the whole class still fits. */
  function bestLayout(count, width, height, opts) {
    var best = null;
    var maxCols = Math.min(count, opts.maxCols);

    for (var cols = 1; cols <= maxCols; cols++) {
      var rows = Math.ceil(count / cols);
      var gap = opts.gap;
      var cellW = (width - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
      var cellH = (height - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;

      if (cellW < opts.minCellW) continue;

      /* Very tall, thin cards look odd; cap the height. */
      cellH = Math.min(cellH, cellW * opts.maxAspect);

      var pad = clamp(Math.min(cellW, cellH) * .055, 3, 12);
      var inner = clamp(cellH * .025, 1, 8);
      var nameSize = clamp(cellH * opts.nameShare, opts.minName, opts.maxName);
      var extraSize = opts.extraLines
        ? clamp(nameSize * opts.extraShare, opts.minExtra, opts.maxExtra)
        : 0;

      var textHeight =
        nameSize * opts.nameLine +
        opts.extraLines * extraSize * 1.2 +
        inner * (1 + opts.extraLines);

      var photo = Math.floor(
        Math.min(
          cellW - pad * 2 - opts.border,
          cellH - pad * 2 - opts.border - textHeight
        )
      );

      /* Slightly prefer layouts whose last row is full. */
      var score = Math.min(photo, 260) - ((cols * rows - count) / cols) * 2;

      if (!best || score > best.score) {
        best = {
          cols: cols,
          rows: rows,
          gap: gap,
          cellW: cellW,
          cellH: Math.floor(cellH),
          pad: pad,
          inner: inner,
          nameSize: nameSize,
          extraSize: extraSize,
          photo: clamp(photo, opts.minPhoto, 260),
          score: score
        };
      }
    }

    return best;
  }

  /* The column count may have just changed, so the centering of a short
     last row must be recalculated from the new columns. */
  function recenterLastRows() {
    if (typeof window.centerIncompleteGridRows === 'function') {
      window.centerIncompleteGridRows();
    }

  }

  /* Width of one name at a 1px font (same font as the cards use). */
  function nameWidthPerPx(nameEls) {
    if (!nameEls.length) return [];

    if (!measureCanvas) {
      measureCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    }

    var ctx = measureCanvas.getContext('2d');
    var cs = window.getComputedStyle(nameEls[0]);

    ctx.font =
      (cs.fontStyle || 'normal') + ' ' +
      (cs.fontWeight || '700') + ' 100px ' +
      (cs.fontFamily || 'sans-serif');

    var spacing = parseFloat(cs.letterSpacing) || 0;
    var size = parseFloat(cs.fontSize) || 16;

    return nameEls.map(function (el) {
      var text = String(el.textContent || '').trim();

      return (
        ctx.measureText(text).width / 100 +
        text.length * (spacing / size)
      );
    });
  }

  /* For one card size, work out the largest photo and name that fit.
     Every student gets the SAME name size: the largest size at which the
     longest name in the class still fits its card. The photo is a square
     that takes all the room the name does not need. */
  function studentCardPlan(cellW, cellH, hasId, widths, nameOnly) {
    var pad = clamp(Math.min(cellW, cellH) * .03, 2, 7);
    var gap = clamp(cellH * .012, 1, 4);
    var border = 6;
    var innerW = cellW - pad * 2 - border;
    var innerH = cellH - pad * 2 - border;

    var idSize = hasId ? clamp(innerH * .07, 8, 15) : 0;
    var idH = hasId ? idSize * 1.15 + gap : 0;

    var NAME_LINE = 1.12;

    /* Widest name in the class decides the size for everyone. */
    var widest = 0;

    widths.forEach(function (w) {
      if (w > widest) widest = w;
    });

    var widthLimit = widest > 0 ? (innerW - 4) / widest : 72;

    if (nameOnly) {
      gap = 0;
    }

    /* Height left for photo + name. */
    var available = innerH - idH - gap;

    /* The name always gets at least a fifth of the card, and on small
       cards enough for a readable ~13px name (never more than 40%). */
    var minNameH = Math.max(
      innerH * .2,
      Math.min(15, innerH * .4)
    );

    var nameSize;
    var photo;
    var rawPhoto;

    if (nameOnly) {
      /* Cramped fallback: no photo, the name gets the whole card. */
      nameSize = clamp(Math.min(widthLimit, available / NAME_LINE), 9, 72);
      photo = 0;
      rawPhoto = 0;
    } else {
      /* Name height: whatever a full-width photo leaves over, but never
         less than the guaranteed minimum, and never larger than the
         longest name can use. */
      var nameH = Math.max(minNameH, available - innerW);

      nameSize = clamp(Math.min(widthLimit, nameH / NAME_LINE), 9, 72);

      /* The photo takes everything the name does not use. */
      rawPhoto = Math.floor(
        Math.min(innerW, available - nameSize * NAME_LINE)
      );

      photo = Math.max(18, rawPhoto);
    }

    return {
      pad: pad,
      gap: gap,
      photo: photo,
      rawPhoto: rawPhoto,
      idSize: idSize,
      nameSize: Math.floor(nameSize * 4) / 4
    };
  }

  var studentFillState = {
    signature: '',
    overflowKey: '',
    overflowFix: 0,
    correcting: false
  };

  function fillStudentGrid() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('studentGrid');
    var chooser = document.getElementById('studentChooser');

    if (!grid) return false;

    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(
      grid.querySelectorAll('.student-card')
    );

    if (
      !columnLayoutActive() ||
      !shown(chooser) ||
      !cards.length ||
      grid.classList.contains('attendance-grid-mode')
    ) {
      grid.classList.remove('kf-fill');
      return false;
    }

    grid.classList.add('kf-fill');

    var container = document.querySelector('body > .container');
    var gridRect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();

    /* Positions are measured from the top of the PAGE, not from the
       scrolled view. (Measuring from the view made the cards grow whenever
       the page was scrolled even slightly, which made the page taller,
       which let it scroll more: a constant up-and-down wobble.) */
    var scrollTop =
      window.pageYOffset ||
      document.documentElement.scrollTop ||
      0;

    var gridTop = gridRect.top + scrollTop;

    /* Space that must stay below the grid: the panel's own padding and
       borders, plus the page's bottom margin. Measured, not assumed. */
    var below = 18;
    var bottomMargins = 0;

    if (container) {
      var containerStyle = window.getComputedStyle(container);
      var bodyStyle = window.getComputedStyle(document.body);

      bottomMargins =
        (parseFloat(containerStyle.marginBottom) || 0) +
        (parseFloat(bodyStyle.paddingBottom) || 0);

      below +=
        Math.max(
          0,
          container.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - gridRect.bottom
        ) +
        bottomMargins;
    }

    var width = grid.clientWidth;

    /* If an earlier pass found the panel still reaching past the bottom of
       the window, that extra amount is remembered (for this window size
       and class size) and only ever grows, so the layout settles instead
       of flip-flopping. */
    var overflowKey =
      window.innerWidth + 'x' + window.innerHeight + ':' + cards.length;

    if (studentFillState.overflowKey !== overflowKey) {
      studentFillState.overflowKey = overflowKey;
      studentFillState.overflowFix = 0;
    }

    var height =
      window.innerHeight -
      gridTop -
      below -
      studentFillState.overflowFix;

    if (width < 80 || height < 80) return true;

    var hasId = !!grid.querySelector('.student-id');
    var count = cards.length;

    var nameEls = cards.map(function (card) {
      return card.querySelector('.student-card-name');
    });

    var presentNames = nameEls.filter(Boolean);

    /* Nothing changed since the last pass (same class, same names, same
       space within 2px)? Then leave the cards exactly as they are. */
    var signature = [
      count,
      hasId ? 1 : 0,
      Math.round(width / 2),
      Math.round(height / 2),
      presentNames.map(function (el) {
        return el.textContent;
      }).join('\u0001')
    ].join('|');

    var alreadySized =
      cards[0].getAttribute('data-kf-sized') === '1' &&
      cards[cards.length - 1].getAttribute('data-kf-sized') === '1';

    if (
      studentFillState.signature === signature &&
      alreadySized
    ) {
      return true;
    }

    presentNames.forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.removeProperty('font-size');
      el.style.removeProperty('width');
      el.style.removeProperty('max-width');
    });

    var widthList = nameWidthPerPx(presentNames);
    var widths = [];
    var widthIndex = 0;

    nameEls.forEach(function (el) {
      widths.push(el ? widthList[widthIndex++] : 0);
    });

    /* FIRST PRIORITY: the whole class fits on one screen. Every column
       count is tried; the card size comes from the space available.
       THEN, within that card size, the photo and name are maximised and
       the column count with the best result wins. */
    var gap = count > 24 ? 4 : 6;
    var maxCols = Math.min(count, 10);
    var best = null;

    for (var cols = 1; cols <= maxCols; cols++) {
      var rows = Math.ceil(count / cols);
      var cellW = (width - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
      var cellH = (height - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;

      if (cellW < 54) continue;

      /* Very tall, thin cards look odd; cap the height. */
      cellH = Math.floor(Math.min(cellH, cellW * 1.9));

      /* Normal card first. If the card is too small for a real photo,
         drop the ID line; if it is still too small, show the name only.
         A readable name always wins over a postage-stamp photo. */
      var plan = studentCardPlan(cellW, cellH, hasId, widths, false);
      var mode = 'full';
      var penalty = 0;

      if (plan.rawPhoto < 30 && hasId) {
        plan = studentCardPlan(cellW, cellH, false, widths, false);
        mode = 'noId';
        penalty = 6;
      }

      if (plan.rawPhoto < 30) {
        plan = studentCardPlan(cellW, cellH, false, widths, true);
        mode = 'nameOnly';
        penalty = 40;
      }

      var score =
        (mode === 'nameOnly' ? 0 : plan.rawPhoto) +
        plan.nameSize * 1.6 -
        penalty -
        ((cols * rows - count) / cols) * 2;

      if (!best || score > best.score) {
        best = {
          score: score,
          cols: cols,
          cellH: cellH,
          plan: plan,
          mode: mode
        };
      }
    }

    if (!best) return true;

    var plan = best.plan;

    grid.classList.toggle('kf-no-id', best.mode !== 'full');
    grid.classList.toggle('kf-name-only', best.mode === 'nameOnly');

    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-cols', String(best.cols));
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-row', best.cellH + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-gap', gap + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-pad', plan.pad.toFixed(1) + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-inner', plan.gap.toFixed(1) + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-photo', plan.photo + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-name', plan.nameSize + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-s-id', plan.idSize.toFixed(1) + 'px');

    /* One size for every name (inline so no older rule can override). */
    nameEls.forEach(function (el) {
      if (!el) return;

      el.style.setProperty(
        'font-size',
        plan.nameSize + 'px',
        'important'
      );
    });

    cards.forEach(function (card) {
      card.setAttribute('data-kf-sized', '1');
    });

    studentFillState.signature = signature;

    recenterLastRows();

    /* Safety net: the panel must end inside the window. If it does not
       (a theme, font or extra element this code did not account for),
       shrink the grid by exactly that much and lay it out once more. */
    if (container && !studentFillState.correcting) {
      var panelBottom =
        container.getBoundingClientRect().bottom +
        scrollTop +
        bottomMargins;

      var over = Math.ceil(panelBottom - (window.innerHeight - 4));

      if (over > 0 && studentFillState.overflowFix < 240) {
        studentFillState.overflowFix += over + 2;
        studentFillState.signature = '';
        studentFillState.correcting = true;

        try {
          fillStudentGrid();
        } finally {
          studentFillState.correcting = false;
        }
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  function fillAttendanceGrid() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid');
    var panel = document.getElementById('attendanceSidePanel');

    if (!grid) return false;

    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(
      grid.querySelectorAll('.attendance-side-card')
    ).filter(shown);

    var solid =
      typeof attendanceUsesSolidColors === 'function' &&
      attendanceUsesSolidColors();

    if (
      !columnLayoutActive() ||
      solid ||
      !shown(panel) ||
      !cards.length
    ) {
      grid.classList.remove('kf-fill');
      return false;
    }

    grid.classList.add('kf-fill');

    var panelStyle = window.getComputedStyle(panel);
    var width = grid.clientWidth;
    var height =
      panel.clientHeight -
      grid.offsetTop -
      (parseFloat(panelStyle.paddingBottom) || 0) -
      4;

    if (width < 80 || height < 80) return true;

    var count = cards.length;

    var layout = bestLayout(count, width, height, {
      gap: count > 24 ? 4 : 6,
      maxCols: 8,
      minCellW: 58,
      maxAspect: 1.9,
      nameShare: .125,
      nameLine: 1.6,
      minName: 10,
      maxName: 34,
      /* Status line plus a two-line "tap again to undo" hint. */
      extraLines: 3,
      extraShare: .44,
      minExtra: 7,
      maxExtra: 14,
      border: 8,
      minPhoto: 18
    });

    if (!layout) return true;

    var nameEls = cards
      .map(function (card) {
        return card.querySelector('.attendance-side-name');
      })
      .filter(Boolean);

    nameEls.forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.removeProperty('font-size');
    });

    var widest = widestNameAt100(nameEls);
    var nameSize = layout.nameSize;

    if (widest > 0) {
      nameSize = Math.min(
        nameSize,
        ((layout.cellW - layout.pad * 2 - 12) / widest) * 100
      );
    }

    nameSize = Math.max(9, Math.floor(nameSize * 4) / 4);

    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-cols', String(layout.cols));
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-row', layout.cellH + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-gap', layout.gap + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-pad', layout.pad.toFixed(1) + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-inner', layout.inner.toFixed(1) + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-photo', layout.photo + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-name', nameSize + 'px');
    grid.style.setProperty('--kf-a-state', layout.extraSize.toFixed(1) + 'px');

    recenterLastRows();

    return true;
  }

  /* Keep a long custom title on one line by shrinking it if needed. */
  function fitCompactTitle() {
    var title = document.getElementById('mainTitle');

    if (!title || !columnLayoutActive() || !shown(title)) return;

    document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--kf-title-size');

    var size = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(title).fontSize) || 30;
    var guard = 0;

    while (
      title.scrollWidth > title.clientWidth + 1 &&
      size > 14 &&
      guard < 60
    ) {
      size -= 1;
      guard += 1;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
        '--kf-title-size',
        size + 'px'
      );
    }
  }

  function fillAll() {
    fitCompactTitle();
    fillStudentGrid();
    fillAttendanceGrid();
    recenterLastRows();
  }

  function scheduleFill() {
    clearTimeout(fillTimer);
    fillTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      requestAnimationFrame(fillAll);
    }, 40);
  }

  window.kioskFillCards = fillAll;

  /* The older name-fitting helpers set fixed font sizes. Route them through
     the new sizing so every existing code path ends with filled cards. */
  var oldFitStudentNames = window.fitStudentCardNames;

  window.fitStudentCardNames = function () {
    if (fillStudentGrid()) {
      if (typeof applyStudentNameContrast === 'function') {
        applyStudentNameContrast();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (typeof oldFitStudentNames === 'function') {
      oldFitStudentNames();
    }
  };

  var oldFitAttendanceNames = window.fitAttendanceCardNames;

  window.fitAttendanceCardNames = function () {
    if (fillAttendanceGrid()) return;

    if (typeof oldFitAttendanceNames === 'function') {
      oldFitAttendanceNames();
    }
  };

  /* The older attendance centering assumes exactly 5 columns. When the new
     sizing is active, centre from the real column count instead. */
  var oldCenterAttendance = window.centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow;

  window.centerAttendanceIncompleteLastRow = function () {
    var grid = document.getElementById('attendanceSideGrid');

    if (grid && grid.classList.contains('kf-fill')) {
      recenterLastRows();
      return;
    }

    if (typeof oldCenterAttendance === 'function') {
      oldCenterAttendance();
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleFill, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    scheduleFill();
    setTimeout(fillAll, 400);
    setTimeout(fillAll, 1200);
  });

  /* Re-fill when cards are added or the panels switch (class chosen,
     passing period starts/ends, attendance toggled). */
  if (window.MutationObserver) {
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function (records) {
      if (kioskRealChange(records)) scheduleFill();
    });

    ['studentGrid', 'attendanceSideGrid'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) observer.observe(el, { childList: true });
    });

    ['studentChooser', 'attendanceSidePanel', 'titleArea'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        observer.observe(el, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeOldValue: true,
          attributeFilter: ['class']
        });
      }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeOldValue: true,
      attributeFilter: ['class']
    });

    /* The Hall Pass panel moves down during passing periods; re-fill when
       its position changes. */
    var mainContainer = document.querySelector('body > .container');

    if (mainContainer) {
      observer.observe(mainContainer, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
      });
    }

    ['topTitle', 'mainTitle'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        observer.observe(el, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
      }
    });
  }
})();
</script>


<!-- ===== Late arrival pop-up: "I have a pass" / "I'm tardy" ===== -->
<div id="kioskLatePopup" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="klpTitle">
  <div class="klp-card">
    <p class="klp-title" id="klpTitle"></p>
    <p class="klp-sub" id="klpSub"></p>
    <div class="klp-buttons">
      <button type="button" class="klp-pass" id="klpPass"><span class="klp-icon">🎟️</span>I have a pass</button>
      <button type="button" class="klp-tardy" id="klpTardy"><span class="klp-icon">⏰</span>I'm tardy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="klp-bar"><div class="klp-fill" id="klpFill"></div></div>
    <p class="klp-note" id="klpNote"></p>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  // Seconds a late student has to answer before the kiosk records "tardy".
  var ANSWER_SECONDS = 10;
  var LATE_PASS = 'Late with Pass';
  var LATE_TARDY = 'Tardy';

  var popup = document.getElementById('kioskLatePopup');
  var titleEl = document.getElementById('klpTitle');
  var subEl = document.getElementById('klpSub');
  var noteEl = document.getElementById('klpNote');
  var fillEl = document.getElementById('klpFill');
  var passBtn = document.getElementById('klpPass');
  var tardyBtn = document.getElementById('klpTardy');
  if (!popup || !passBtn || !tardyBtn) return;

  var queue = [];
  var current = null;
  var tickTimer = null;

  function clockMinutes(text) {
    var m = String(text || '').trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*([AaPp])?[Mm]?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    var h = Number(m[1]), min = Number(m[2]);
    if (m[4]) {
      var pm = m[4].toLowerCase() === 'p';
      if (h === 12) h = pm ? 12 : 0; else if (pm) h += 12;
    }
    if (h > 23 || min > 59) return null;
    return h * 60 + min;
  }

  // Returns minutes late (>= 1) when the tap is past the grace period, else 0.
  function minutesLateFor(lateBellText, tapMillis) {
    var bell = clockMinutes(lateBellText);
    if (bell == null) return 0;
    var d = new Date(tapMillis);
    var now = d.getHours() * 60 + d.getMinutes() + d.getSeconds() / 60;
    var grace = 30;
    try {
      if (typeof attendanceSettings !== 'undefined' && attendanceSettings &&
          attendanceSettings.tardyGraceSeconds != null) {
        grace = Number(attendanceSettings.tardyGraceSeconds);
        if (!isFinite(grace)) grace = 30;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    if (now < bell + grace / 60) return 0;
    return Math.max(1, Math.round(now - bell));
  }

  function saveLateType(stateRef, lateType, attempt) {
    attempt = attempt || 0;
    if (!stateRef) return;
    stateRef.lateType = lateType;
    if (lateType !== LATE_PASS) return;          // tardy is already the saved default
    if (String(stateRef.status || '') === 'Cancelled') return;
    if (!stateRef.eventId) {
      // The check-in is still being saved. Try again shortly (up to ~2 minutes).
      if (attempt < 300) setTimeout(function () { saveLateType(stateRef, lateType, attempt + 1); }, 400);
      return;
    }
    try {
      google.script.run
        .withFailureHandler(function () {
          if (attempt < 320) setTimeout(function () { saveLateType(stateRef, lateType, 318); }, 2500);
        })
        .setAttendanceLateType(stateRef.eventId, lateType);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function finish(lateType) {
    if (!current) return;
    var item = current;
    current = null;
    if (tickTimer) { clearInterval(tickTimer); tickTimer = null; }
    popup.classList.remove('open');
    saveLateType(item.stateRef, lateType);
    setTimeout(showNext, 150);
  }

  function showNext() {
    if (current || !queue.length) return;
    current = queue.shift();
    var first = current.firstName ? ', ' + current.firstName : '';
    titleEl.textContent = 'You are late' + first + '.';
    subEl.textContent =
      'Class started at ' + current.lateBell + ' — that was ' +
      current.minutes + (current.minutes === 1 ? ' minute' : ' minutes') + ' ago. Which is it?';
    popup.classList.add('open');
    var started = Date.now();
    var total = ANSWER_SECONDS * 1000;
    function tick() {
      var left = Math.max(0, total - (Date.now() - started));
      fillEl.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (left / total) + ')';
      noteEl.textContent = 'No answer in ' + Math.ceil(left / 1000) + ' seconds counts as tardy.';
      if (left <= 0) finish(LATE_TARDY);
    }
    tick();
    tickTimer = setInterval(tick, 100);
  }

  passBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); finish(LATE_PASS); });
  tardyBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); finish(LATE_TARDY); });
  // Taps on the dimmed background must not reach the cards underneath.
  ['click', 'pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'touchstart', 'touchend', 'mousedown', 'mouseup'].forEach(function (type) {
    popup.addEventListener(type, function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
  });

  var original = window.beginStudentAttendance;
  if (typeof original !== 'function') return;

  window.beginStudentAttendance = function (student, card) {
    var tapMillis = Date.now();
    var result = original.apply(this, arguments);
    try {
      var ctx = attendanceContextForStudent(student) || {};
      var minutes = minutesLateFor(ctx.lateBell, tapMillis);
      // Commuters (Students tab) are never tardy, so no late screen.
      if (minutes > 0 && !student.commuter) {
        var key = attendanceStudentKey(student);
        queue.push({
          stateRef: attendanceStateByKey[key] || null,
          firstName: String(student.displayName || student.firstName || student.name || '').trim(),
          lateBell: String(ctx.lateBell || '').trim(),
          minutes: minutes
        });
        showNext();
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return result;
  };

  window.kioskLatePopupInfo = function () {
    return { open: !!current, waiting: queue.length, seconds: ANSWER_SECONDS };
  };
})();
</script>

<!-- ===== Teacher dashboard -> kiosk: show the teacher's attendance corrections ===== -->
<script>
(function kioskTeacherSync() {
  'use strict';
  var since = Date.now();
  var busy = false;

  // What to ask the server for, or undefined when there is nothing to check.
  function request() {
    if (busy || document.hidden) return undefined;
    try {
      if (typeof attendanceSettings === 'undefined' || !attendanceSettings || attendanceSettings.enabled === false) return undefined;
      if (typeof selectedClass === 'undefined' || !selectedClass) return undefined;
    } catch (e) { return undefined; }
    return { period: selectedClass.period, className: selectedClass.classTitle, since: since };
  }

  function apply(result, period, className) {
    if (!result) return;
    if (result.stamp) since = Math.max(since, Number(result.stamp));
    if (!result.changed || !result.teacherKeys || !result.teacherKeys.length) return;
    try {
      if (!selectedClass || selectedClass.period !== period || selectedClass.classTitle !== className) return;
      var byKey = {};
      (result.states || []).forEach(function (state) { byKey[state.studentKey] = state; });
      result.teacherKeys.forEach(function (key) {
        // The teacher's decision replaces whatever this screen showed.
        delete attendanceLocallyTouchedKeys[key];
        if (byKey[key]) attendanceStateByKey[key] = byKey[key];
        else delete attendanceStateByKey[key];
      });
      renderAttendanceStates();
      if (typeof appendAbsentStudentsFinal === 'function') appendAbsentStudentsFinal();
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Right away, on its own (used after the teacher view changes something).
  function check() {
    var args = request();
    if (!args) return;
    busy = true;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function (result) { busy = false; apply(result, args.period, args.className); })
      .withFailureHandler(function () { busy = false; })
      .getTeacherAttendanceChanges(args);
  }

  // Every 15 seconds, as part of the kiosk's one background check.
  var asked = null;
  if (window.kioskPollParts) {
    window.kioskPollParts.push({
      name: 'teacher', every: 15000, last: 0,
      build: function () { asked = request(); return asked; },
      apply: function (result) { if (asked) apply(result, asked.period, asked.className); }
    });
  } else {
    setInterval(check, 15000);
  }
  window.kioskTeacherSyncNow = check;
})();
</script>

    document.getElementById('prnTitle').textContent = (name ? name + ': ' : '') + 'escort only';
    box.classList.add('open');
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(function () { box.classList.remove('open'); }, 3500);
  };
})();
</script>
<button type="button" id="kioskTeacherLink" title="Teacher view: press and hold" aria-label="Teacher view (press and hold)">🍎<span class="ring"></span></button>
<script>
  // Teacher view link on the kiosk (Colleen, 2026-10-17): press and hold 2 seconds; opens the teacher view (this app's address + ?view=teacher) in a new tab
  (function () {
    var btn = document.getElementById('kioskTeacherLink'), url = '', timer = null;
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function (u) { url = String(u || '').replace(/\?view=drill$/, '?view=teacher'); }).getDrillLink();
    function cancel() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; btn.classList.remove('holding'); }
    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); cancel(); btn.classList.add('holding'); timer = setTimeout(function () { cancel(); if (url) window.open(url, '_blank'); }, 2000); });
    ['pointerup', 'pointerleave', 'pointercancel'].forEach(function (ev) { btn.addEventListener(ev, cancel); });
    btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  })();
</script>
